programme.title: Lou / Lou
programme.desc: Animated series about the daily life of the 12-year-old girl Lou and her friends who are on the threshold of adolescence. Based on the comic series of the same name by Julien Neel. / Animatiereeks over het dagelijkse leven van het 12-jarige meisje Lou en haar vrienden die op de drempel van de adolescentie staan. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige stripreeks van Julien Neel.

programme.title: Dodo / Dodo
programme.desc: It's Christmas and Joe accidentally breaks Grandma's dollhouse. When Jamie gets the blame, Joe is overjoyed. But then he discovers that the whole thing was filmed. / Het is Kerstmis en Joe breekt per ongeluk het poppenhuis van oma. Als Jamie de schuld krijgt, is Joe dolgelukkig. Maar dan ontdekt hij dat het hele gebeuren gefilmd is.

programme.title: De Faker / De Faker
programme.desc: At first glance it seems like an ordinary family, but something is not right. One of the family members has been replaced by an actor. But who is that? / Op het oog lijkt het een doodgewoon gezin maar er klopt iets niet. Een van de gezinsleden is vervangen door een acteur. Maar wie dat is?

programme.title: Karrewiet With VGT / Karrewiet Met VGT
programme.desc: Information magazine for youth. Interpreted in Flemish Sign Language (VGT). Also available on Ketnet.be, via the KetnetVideo app and via Net Missed. / Infomagazine voor de jeugd. Getolkt in Vlaamse Gebarentaal (VGT). Ook beschikbaar op Ketnet.be, via de KetnetVideo-app en via Net gemist.

programme.title: Hello Kroket / Hallo Kroket
programme.desc: Daily live show in which the KETNET wrappers draw you into the world of KETNET and that of the Ketnetters. Expect famous guests, crazy scoops, fun performances, exciting games and so much more. HELLO CROQUETTE! / Dagelijkse liveshow waarin de KETNET-wrappers je meetrekken in de wereld van KETNET en die van de Ketnetters. Verwacht je aan bekende gasten, zotte primeurs, leuke optredens, spannende spelletjes en nog zo veel meer. HALLO KROKET!

programme.title: #IkLome / #LikeMe
programme.desc: Camille's parents are in debt, but she does everything she can to hide this from the outside world. There is a study grant at school and Yemi has cupid ambitions. Emma and Scott grow closer and find each other more and more. Titin is confused. / Camille haar ouders hebben schulden, maar ze doet er alles aan om dat te verbergen voor de buitenwereld. Op school is er een studiekeuze-beurs en Yemi heeft cupido-ambities. Emma en Scott brossen en vinden mekaar steeds meer. Titin is verward.

programme.title: Girls: Back to school special / Meisjes: Back to school special
programme.desc: Amelie and Fleur are starting secondary education. Amelie is eagerly looking forward to a promising adult life. Fleur, on the other hand, starts high school more intimidated. The changes scare her a bit. While Amelie sometimes imagines the new school as too idyllic, she is tempered by Fleur's realism. And where Fleur puts on the brakes too much because she assumes the worst, there is Amelie to take her along. / Amelie en Fleur starten aan het middelbaar onderwijs. Amelie kijkt reikhalzend uit naar het beloftevolle volwassen leven. Fleur daarentegen start eerder geïntimideerd aan de middelbare school. De veranderingen schrikken haar toch wel wat af. Waar Amelie zich de nieuwe school soms te idyllisch voorstelt, wordt ze getemperd door Fleurs realisme. En waar Fleur teveel op de rem staat omdat ze uitgaat van het slechtste, is er Amelie om haar mee op sleeptouw te nemen.

programme.title: The Council of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Most students feel down because they don't know what they want to be when they grow up. Soekie wants to help them choose to find their passion by inviting a successful former student to school. The ex-student is a well-known actor from the soap "Morgenzon". Soekie's action has the opposite effect: all students want to become actors to be rich and famous. They can all audition for "Morgenzon" but none of them are good enough. Everyone is now even deeper in the hole. / De meeste leerlingen zitten in de put omdat ze niet weten wat ze later willen worden. Soekie wil hen helpen bij hun keuze om hun passie te vinden, door een succesvolle ex-leerling uit te nodigen op school. De ex-leerling is een bekende acteur uit de soap "Morgenzon". Soekies actie heeft een averechts effect: alle leerlingen willen acteur worden om ook rijk en beroemd te zijn. Ze mogen allemaal auditie doen voor "Morgenzon" maar niemand van hen is goed genoeg. Iedereen zit nu nog dieper in de put.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Esra wants to become a cartoonist. She draws a comic strip with Daria in the leading role. However, Esra cannot draw. Daria fears that everyone will laugh at Esra. Does Daria dare to tell her the truth? / Esra wil striptekenaar worden. Ze tekent een stripverhaal met Daria in de hoofdrol. Esra kan echter niet tekenen. Daria vreest dat iedereen Esra zal uitlachen. Durft Daria haar de waarheid te zeggen?

programme.title: Animal doctors 24/7 / Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: The skull of dog Apso is completely shattered. A very delicate operation is his only chance of survival. A horse is being castrated. And that doesn't happen in the operating room today. The students must learn how to perform this type of intervention in the meadow. The tiger's skeleton is almost completely finished. Except for a small, mysterious penis bone... / De schedel van hondje Apso is helemaal verbrijzeld. Een heel delicate operatie is zijn enige kans op overleven. Er wordt een paard gecastreerd. En dat gebeurt vandaag niet in de operatiezaal. De studenten moeten leren hoe ze dit soort ingreep ook in de weide kunnen uitvoeren. Het skelet van de tijger is bijna helemaal klaar. Op een klein, mysterieus penisbotje na...

programme.title: Cops Maastricht / Flikken Maastricht
programme.desc: Eva has been taken hostage by the Albanians who have been defrauded by Bols. They hope that Bols will come and free her. But Bols is smart enough not to do that alone; he puts Wolfs in front of his cart... / Eva is gegijzeld door de Albanezen die door Bols zijn opgelicht. Ze hopen dat Bols haar komt bevrijden. Maar Bols is slim genoeg om dat niet alleen te doen; hij spant Wolfs voor zijn karretje...

programme.title: The house / Het huis
programme.desc: This week Eric Goens receives singer Isabelle A. / Deze week ontvangt Eric Goens zangeres Isabelle A.

programme.title: Cops / Flikken
programme.desc: Now in prison, Roman Dashi fears for his daughter Selina's life. Through Johan he asks the police for protection. Britt is not inclined to give in to her old enemy, but still sends Nick and Bruno after the girl. Nadine tells Pasmans that she has heard from the zone manager that he is facing a particularly severe sanction. He is completely distraught, but continues to refuse to reveal the true circumstances of the accident. Raymond begins to realize what his indifference could lead to and he talks to Merel / Nu hij in de gevangenis zit, vreest Roman Dashi voor het leven van zijn dochter Selina. Via Johan vraagt hij aan de politie om bescherming. Britt is niet geneigd toe te geven aan haar oude vijand, maar stuurt toch Nick en Bruno achter het meisje aan. Nadine vertelt Pasmans dat zij van de zonechef heeft opgevangen dat hem een bijzonder zware sanctie boven het hoofd hangt. Hij is helemaal van de kaart, maar blijft weigeren de ware toedracht van het ongeval te verklappen. Bij Raymond begint het te dagen waartoe zijn onverschilligheid kan leiden en hij praat met Merel

programme.title: The reading club / De voorleesclub
programme.desc: Hanne Decoutere reads from Dromer by Mark Janssen. There are thinkers and there are doers... and then there are dreamers. These are very special people with a lot of imagination who make the world more beautiful and happier. A book that goes straight to the heart. / Hanne Decoutere leest voor uit Dromer van Mark Janssen. Er zijn denkers en er zijn doeners... en dan heb je dromers. Dat zijn heel bijzondere mensen met veel verbeelding die de wereld mooier en vrolijker maken. Een boek dat recht naar het hart gaat.

programme.title: For heaven's sake / In hemelsnaam
programme.desc: Sister Katharina welcomes Annemie to the private world of the castle monastery. The sisters live off the proceeds from their soap factory, but with the gigantic renovation works ahead, that income is not enough. Sister Caritas is seriously ill and goes to the hospital for a check-up. Fortunately, there is Sister Monica-Maria, the convent driver who can take her away. The young and enthusiastic Sister Maria-Magdalena takes Annemie to the garden for a good conversation. / Zuster Katharina verwelkomt Annemie in de besloten wereld van het slotklooster. De zusters leven van de opbrengst van hun zeepfabriekje, maar met de gigantische verbouwingswerken voor de boeg volstaan die inkomsten niet. Zuster Caritas is ernstig ziek en gaat op controle naar het ziekenhuis. Gelukkig is er zuster Monica-Maria, de kloosterchauffeur die haar kan wegbrengen. De jonge en enthousiaste zuster Maria-Magdalena neemt Annemie mee naar de tuin voor een goed gesprek.

programme.title: Speed ​​24/7 / Spoed 24/7
programme.desc: Luc probably broke his foot. Although he doesn't feel this himself because Luc has been completely paralyzed down to his waist since he was a teenager. Malik comes to the emergency room with his grandfather. The boy fell while skating, resulting in a hole in his knee. And 2-year-old Elena is known for epilepsy and now has a very high fever. / Luc heeft waarschijnlijk zijn voet gebroken. Al voelt hij dit zelf niet want Luc is al sinds zijn tienerjaren volledig verlamd tot aan zijn middel. Malik komt samen met zijn opa naar spoed. Bij het schaatsen kwam de jongen ten val met een gat in zijn knie tot gevolg. En de 2-jarige Elena is gekend voor epilepsie en heeft nu zeer hoge koorts.

programme.title: Traveling Waes: the bucket list / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: Tom continues his journey through the countries that used to be Yugoslavia. In Serbia, Waes takes the night train for the most beautiful train ride in Europe. The trail takes him to the least visited country in Europe: Kosovo. A country where the war still leaves deep marks. Tom concludes his journey through ex-Yugoslavia in a country with a new name: North Macedonia. He visits the kitschy capital Skopje and ends his road trip on a high: with a dip in the oldest lake in Europe. / Tom zet zijn reis verder door de landen die vroeger Joegoslavië uitmaakten. In Servië neemt Waes de nachttrein voor de mooiste treinrit van Europa. Het spoor brengt hem richting het minst bezochte land van Europa: Kosovo. Een land waar de oorlog nog altijd diepe sporen nalaat. Tom besluit zn reis door ex-Joegoslavië in een land met een nieuwe naam: Noord-Macedonië. Hij bezoekt er de kitscherige hoofdstad Skopje en eindigt zijn road trip op een hoogtepunt: met een duik in het oudste meer van Europa.

programme.desc: For the competition "The Strafste School" Soekie makes a video in which she introduces the BROL. Rosa, Karin en Femke denken een oplossing te hebben gevonden voor hun bedrijf.

programme.title: Clips / Clips
programme.desc: Clips. / Clips.

programme.title: Cops Maastricht / Flikken Maastricht
programme.desc: A woman comes to report the kidnapping of her child by Maastricht drug traffickers. It soon turns out that there is much more to the report and it is no longer possible to tell the victim and perpetrators apart. Romeo and Marion are confronted with a missing person. An alcoholic woman has disappeared after being evicted from her home. / Een vrouw komt aangifte doen van de ontvoering van haar kind door Maastrichtse drugshandelaren. Al gauw blijkt er veel meer achter de aangifte te zitten en zijn slachtoffer en daders niet meer uit elkaar te houden. Romeo en Marion krijgen met een vermissing te maken. Een alcoholistische vrouw is verdwenen nadat ze haar huis is uitgezet.

programme.title: For heaven's sake / In hemelsnaam
programme.desc: Sister Katharina welcomes Annemie to the private world of the castle monastery. The sisters live off the proceeds from their soap factory, but with the gigantic renovation works ahead, that income is not enough. Sister Caritas is seriously ill and goes to the hospital for a check-up. Fortunately, there is Sister Monica-Maria, the convent driver who can take her away. The young and enthusiastic Sister Maria-Magdalena takes Annemie to the garden for a good conversation. / Zuster Katharina verwelkomt Annemie in de besloten wereld van het slotklooster. De zusters leven van de opbrengst van hun zeepfabriekje, maar met de gigantische verbouwingswerken voor de boeg volstaan die inkomsten niet. Zuster Caritas is ernstig ziek en gaat op controle naar het ziekenhuis. Gelukkig is er zuster Monica-Maria, de kloosterchauffeur die haar kan wegbrengen. De jonge en enthousiaste zuster Maria-Magdalena neemt Annemie mee naar de tuin voor een goed gesprek.

programme.title: Hotel Romance / Hotel Romantiek
programme.desc: Gloria, Sven and Philippe let some couples decorate a cake today, assisted by love tips that they hear through an earpiece. The other bachelors explore an off-road course in a jeep. Does going up and down in the back seat give you the jitters? Which couple gets closer to each other and gets to spend the night together in Poland's most romantic location? / Gloria, Sven en Philippe laten enkele koppels vandaag een taart versieren, bijgestaan door liefdestips die ze via een oortje te horen krijgen. De andere vrijgezellen verkennen in een jeep een offroadparcours. Zorgt het op en neer gaan op de achterbank voor de nodige kriebels? Welk koppel komt dichter tot elkaar, en mag de nacht samen doorbrengen op de meest romantische locatie van Polen?

programme.title: Cops / Flikken
programme.desc: The cop team is determined to find Selina's killers. Roman Dashi is inconsolable and out of compassion for the stricken father, Johan ensures that he can greet the remains of his daughter Selina. Only later do Johan and the agents discover that Dashi considers only one person responsible for his own fate and that of his daughter: Britt. But then the damage has already been done... / Het flikkenteam is vastbesloten de moordenaars van Selina te vinden. Roman Dashi is ontroostbaar en uit medeleven met de getroffen vader zorgt Johan dat hij het stoffelijk overschot van zijn dochter Selina kan begroeten. Slechts later ontdekken Johan en de agenten dat Dashi maar een persoon verantwoordelijk acht voor zijn eigen lot en dat van zijn dochter: Britt. Maar dan is het kwaad al geschied...

programme.title: The reading club / De voorleesclub
programme.sub-title: Karl Meesters - Dino Dre en het zelfverzonnen snoepjesavontuur
programme.desc: Presenter Karl Meesters is visually impaired and is therefore not a classic reading dad. But he can make up stories, together with Chat GPT and his son Dre. An exciting adventure about dinosaurs and sweets. Fan of magical trees full of drip sticks? Then this story is really something for you! / Presentator Karl Meesters is slechtziend en is dus geen klassieke voorleespapa. Maar verhalen verzinnen, dat kan hij wel, samen met Chat GPT en zijn zoon Dre. Een spannend avontuur over dinos en snoepjes. Fan van magische bomen vol lekstokken? Dan is dit verhaal echt iets voor jou!

Pano wil focussen op sterke, menselijke beeldverhalen maar evengoed harde onderzoeksjournalistiek.Het brengen van eigen verhalen en nieuws is prioriteit. programme.desc: Pieter (33) has been living in a former bank office in his native village of Wingene for 6 years. 2 years ago he met Maxim (31) who moved in with him. Today Maxim is tired of living in a house where the former offices serve as a wardrobe and dining area. He wants to move and make a new start somewhere else. But Pieter is stable and does not want to just leave his beloved Wingene. To get out of this impasse, architect Tim and real estate agent Kristien come to the couple's aid. / Pieter (33) woont al 6 jaar in een voormalig bankkantoor in zijn geboortedorp Wingene. 2 jaar geleden ontmoette hij Maxim (31) die bij hem introk. Vandaag is Maxim het beu om te wonen in een huis waar de voormalige kantoren dienstdoen als kleerkast en eetruimte. Hij wil dan ook verhuizen en ergens anders een nieuwe start maken. Maar Pieter is honkvast en wil zijn geliefde Wingene niet zomaar verlaten. Om uit deze impasse te geraken komen architect Tim en makelaar Kristien het koppel te hulp.

programme.desc: An infotainment show that listens to the most current social topics and events that we comment on with guests from all social spheres. We bring viewers interesting things from the world of entertainment, culture, and art, and we often have regional stars as guests. The show is edited and hosted by Dragana Božić and Milica Nogo. / Infotaiment emisija koja osluškuje najaktuelnije društvene teme i događaje koje komentarišemo sa gostima iz svih društenih sfera. Gledaocima donosimo zanimljivosti iz sveta zabave, kulture, i umjetnosti, a često su nam u gostima i regionalne zvijezde. Emisiju uređuju i vode Dragana Božić i Milica Nogo.

programme.title: The world of agriculture / Svijet poljoprivrede
programme.desc: An agricultural show with a long tradition and author's project of the editor and presenter Dejan Jovanović brings verified information of knowledge and experience that is of interest to every farmer. / Poljoprivredna emisija dugogodišnje tradicije i autorski projekat urednika i voditelja Dejana Jovanovića donosi provjerene informacije znanja i iskustva koja interesuju svakog poljoprivrednika.

programme.title: On the edge of the field / Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: In the mix zone / U mix zoni
programme.desc: In the mix zone / U mix zoni

programme.title: Agrarian / Agrar
programme.desc: The show is dedicated to farmers, but also to those who live in urban areas, have gardens, orchards, greenhouses. To those who want to learn something new and useful, they want to improve production and increase yields. / Emisija je posvećena poljoprivrednicima, ali i onima koji žive u urbanim sredinama, imaju baštu, vrt, voćnjak, plastenik. Onima koji žele da nauče nešto novo i korisno, žele da unaprijede proizvodnju i povećaju prinose.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Club energy / Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: ATV news / ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most watched show of Alternative Television _ Central News exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news provides an overview of events in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on current topics of the day. Journalists of the ATV newsroom research, discover and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city current affairs, sports and weather. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

Prve dnevne informacije, prvi jutarnji raporti sa terena širom Republike Srpske, zanimljivi prilozi iz svijeta politike, kulture i sporta, posvećeni ljudima i zanimljivim dešavanjima.

programme.title: Aloa face the forehead / Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Blood flowers / Krvavo cvijeće
programme.desc: The story of Dilan and Baran, two young people who are forced to enter the port of marriage. Despite numerous conflicts, their unwanted marriage gives birth to a strong love. / Priča o Dilan i Baranu, dvoje mladih ljudi koji su prisiljeni uploviti u bračnu luku. Unatoč brojnim sukobima, njihov neželjeni brak iznjedriće snažnu ljubav.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: How the Earth was formed / Kako je nastala Zemlja
programme.desc: With the help of top geologists and various scientists, "How the Earth Was Made" is a documentary series that explores the powerful forces and events that shaped our planet. Through stunning, computer-generated cinematography, viewers go back billions of years to learn how the Earth was formed and the drastic changes it went through. / Uz pomoć vrhunskih geologa i različitih naučnika, "Kako je Zemlja nastala" je dokumentarna serija koja istražuje moćne sile i događaje koji su oblikovali naš planet. Kroz zadivljujuću, kompjuterski generisanu kinematografiju, gledatelji se vraćaju milijardama godina unazad kako bi saznali kako je Zemlja nastala i kroz koje je drastične promjene prolazila.

programme.title: Club energy / Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: Business club / Biznis klub
programme.desc: With a new concept, the business club will bring the economy closer to you and provide you with relevant current events in the field of economy and business, monitor economic developments and trends at the global level and investigate their impact on the growth and development of the economy in Srpska. We will reveal to you successful entrepreneurs and their experiences in business, and affirm those who are just at the beginning of developing their business ideas. Along with regular reports from stock exchanges and the gold market, one of the priorities will be reports from regional economic forums, where we will seek answers to key questions from eminent experts. / Biznis klub novim konceptom približiće vam ekonomiju i pružiti vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti ekonomije i privrede, ispratiti ekonomska kretanja i trendove na globalnom nivou i istražiti njihov uticaj na rast i razvoj ekonomije u Srpskoj. Otkrićemo vam uspješne preduzetnike i njihova iskustva u poslovanju, te afirmisati one koji tek na početku razvoja svojih poslovnih ideja. Uz redovne izvještaje sa berzi i tržišta zlata, jedan od prioriteta biće i izvještaji sa regionalnih ekonomskih foruma, gdje ćemo od eminentnih stručnjaka potražiti odgovore na ključna pitanja.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: BHT 1 live / BHT 1 uživo
programme.desc: The motto of the BHT 1 live show is "News plus". In the show, information, analysis, predictions and the background of the event. Experts, analysts and citizens speak live for BHT 1. Comments on what is being talked about on social networks, and analysis of the topic of the day. Part of the content of the show are reports about lesser-known places, but also stories about beautiful and unusual regions of our country, and valuable and interesting people. / Moto emisije BHT 1 uživo je "Vijest plus". U emisiji informacije, analize, predviđanja i pozadina događaja. Za BHT 1 uživo govore stručnjaci, analitičari i građani. Komentari o čemu se priča na društvenim mrežama, i analiza teme dana. Dio sadržaja emisije su i reportaže o manje poznatim mjestima, ali i priče o lijepim i neobičnim predjelima naše zemlje, te vrijednim i zanimljivim ljudima.

programme.title: Morning for everyone / Jutro za sve
programme.desc: "Jutro za sve" is a show of the BHT1 morning program that guides viewers through the most current and interesting topics of the day, with plenty of useful information, local, regional and world news from all areas, live reporters from all parts of BiH, publishing stories about BiH citizens, tourism, culture, sports and music. / "Jutro za sve" emisija je jutarnjeg programa BHT1 koja gledatelje voditi kroz najaktuelnije i najinteresantnije teme dana, uz obilje korisnih informacija, lokalnih, regionalnih i svjetskih vijesti iz svih oblasti, javljanja reportera uživo iz svih dijelova BiH, objavljujući priče o građanima BiH, turizmu, kulturi, sportu i muzici.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Zafari / Zafari
programme.desc: A baby elephant with zebra stripes, a giraffe with peacock feathers, a lion the color of a pink flamingo... these are just some of the unique animals that live in Zafari, the valley at the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro... Sometimes, being different makes all the difference... / Beba slon sa zebrinim prugama, žirafa sa paunovim perjem, lav boje ružićastog flaminga…to su samo neke od jedinstvenih životinja koje žive u Zafariju, dolini u podnožju planine Kilimandžaro... Ponekad, biti drugačiji čini svu razliku...

programme.title: Mummies / Mumijevi
programme.desc: They are apparently an ordinary family.. they look like hippos and live in the Valley of the Mummies. They bring numerous ordinary and unusual adventures, both at home and on trips and excursions, where they meet various interesting beings and persons. / Oni su naizgled obična porodica.. liče na nilske konje i žive u dolini Mumijeva. Oni donose brojne obične i neobične dogodovštine, kako u kući, tako i na putovanjima i izletima, gdje upoznaju razna interesantna bića i osobe.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Eli Shane's life is ordinary, except for one thing. He comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the underworld of Slugterra to protect the special world of slugs. Now it's Eli's turn to visit the underworld and protect it from the enemy, whether he's ready or not. Eli is determined to become a hero in order to resist the forces of evil. Together with his friends Trixie, Korda and Pronto, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, which have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Corrado discovers that his former housekeeper has started her own business, so he decides to visit her and apologize for his behavior towards her. He also offers her to come back to work for him and his family. Maffei surprises him when she says she can't do that because she's always been in love with him. Meanwhile, Nanà discovers that the Prizzi family lives in Carrara. When she was a child, she was raised by Anna, who suddenly ran away from Sicily without telling the girl why. Maddalena learns that in the household of the Counts Farnesi they are looking for a cook. Apply for a job and get it. The head of the Corradi family defends Alessandro during the hospital board meeting and thus helps him to be appointed as the boss. A surprised Alessandro asks the director Agnes for an explanation, but she skilfully avoids it. Silvia Corradi finds out that Brando will marry Lucrezia and that they are expecting a child. Cast: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis / Corrado otkriva da je njegova bivša domaćica pokrenula vlastiti biznis, pa odlučuje da je posjeti i izvini se zbog svoga ponašanja prema njoj. Ponudi joj i da se vrati raditi za njega i njegovu obitelj. Maffei ga iznenadi kada kaže da to ne može učiniti zato što je oduvijek zaljubljena u njega. U međuvremenu, Nanà otkrije da obitelj Prizzi živi u Carrari. Kada je bila dijete, odgajala ju je Anna, koja je iznenada pobjegla sa Sicilije ne rekavši djevojčici razlog. Maddalena sazna da u kućanstvu grofova Farnesi traže kuharicu. Javi se za posao i dobije ga. Glava obitelji Corradi brani Alessandra tokom sastanka uprave bolnice i tako mu pomogne da ga imenuju za šefa. Iznenađeni Alessandro zatraži objašnjenje od direktorice Agnese, no ona to vješto izbjegne. Silvia Corradi saznaje da će se Brando vjenčati s Lucrezijom i da čekaju dijete. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

The magazine is dedicated, among other things, to contemporary art. Most of the content consists of reports and reportages that talk about cultural events, presentations of projects and artists. Reportaže, portreti, prilozi koji problematiziraju određenu temu ili pojavu, i intervjui.

programme.desc: This year's edition of the Mostar Blues And Rock Festival brought top performances by local and foreign artists, but also a recognizable atmosphere that has made Mostar one of the most important musical centers of the region for years. With authentic scenes from the concerts, which confirm that Mostar still plays its recognizable rhythm _ the rhythm of freedom, togetherness and music that connects those conversations with musicians and organizers, feel the positive energy of the festival. / Ovogodišnje izdanje Mostar Blues And Rock festivala donijelo je vrhunske nastupe domaćih i stranih izvođača, ali i prepoznatljivu atmosferu koja Mostar već godinama čini jednim od najvažnijih muzičkih središta regije. Uz autentične prizore s koncerata, koji potvrđuju da Mostar i dalje svira svoj prepoznatljivi ritam _ ritam slobode, zajedništva i muzike koja povezuje te razgovore sa muzičarima i organizatorima, osjetite pozitivnu energiju festivala.

programme.title: Sports Focus / Sport Fokus
programme.desc: Magazine about sports in Bosnia and Herzegovina and in the world. Overviews of the most popular league competitions, with a special focus on domestic sports, reports from derby matches, thematic guest appearances, and articles on amateur, mass and disabled sports, as well as a special column in which former, current, top or young athletes whose time is yet to come will be presented. An indispensable part of the show's content is the section on international sports. / Magazin o sportu u BiH i u svijetu. Pregledi dešavanja najpopularnijih ligaških natjecanja, sa posebnim osvrtom na domaći sport, izvještaji sa derbi utakmica, tematska gostovanja, te prilozi o amaterskim, masovnim i sportovima lica s invaliditetom, kao i posebna rubrika u kojoj će biti predstavljeni bivši, aktuelni, vrhunski ili mladi sportisti čije vrijeme tek dolazi. programme.desc: The series of shows dedicated to economic trends provides insight into the most important processes, trends and indicators that shape the domestic economy and the broader market context in a clear and professional manner. Kroz aktuelne vijesti, analize, razgovore sa ekspertima, emisija daje sveobuhvatnu sliku savremenih ekonomskih kretanja i uvid u tržište Bosne i Hercegovine.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Brando returned to live in Carrara. He asks Annibale Lucchesi if he could come back to work with him. Lucchesi offers him to manage the affairs of two marble mines that he owns, so Brando gathers a group of miners, including his friend Saverio, and starts working in Lucchesi's quarries. Brando and the Lucchesi decide to share the profits from the marble together with the workers and it becomes the first cooperative in Carrara. Anna admits to Maddalena that she knows Nana from before. Together with Tommaso, they go to see a play in the theater, but there they are shocked by the role she plays. Livio cannot accept the fact that his sister has fallen in love with a miner and fears that Brando is only interested in the family fortune. In order to protect his interests, Livio confronts his father and asks him to hand over part of his inheritance to him. As the wedding approaches, it's time for Lucrezia to meet Brando's family. Everyone is enchanted by her, but Vito's father still has doubts about his son's future. Silvia is desperate for Brando's return and his imminent wedding to Lucrezia. He decides to confide in Maddalena and ask if she should reveal the truth to Brando about how she sacrificed herself for him. Cast: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis / Brando se vratio živjeti u Carraru. Annibaleu Lucchesiju pita bi li se mogao vratiti kod njega na posao. Lucchesi mu ponudi da vodi poslove dva rudnika mramora koji su u njegovom posjedu, pa Brando okuplja grupu kopača, uključujući i svog prijatelja Saverija, te počne raditi u Lucchesijevim kamenolomima. Brando i Lucchesi odluče dijeliti zaradu od mramora zajedno s radnicima i to postane prva kooperativa u Carrari. Anna prizna Maddaleni da otprije poznaje Nanu. Zajedno s Tommasom odlaze gledati predstavu u pozorištu, no tamo se šokiraju ulogom koju ona tumači. Livio ne može prihvatiti činjenicu da se njegova sestra zaljubila u rudara i strahuje da Branda zanima jedino obiteljski imetak. Kako bi zaštitio svoje interese, Livio se sukobi s ocem i zatraži od njega da mu prepiše dio nasljedstva. Kako se bliži vjenčanje, vrijeme je i da Lucrezija upozna Brandovu obitelj. Svi su očarani njome, no otac Vito i dalje ima sumnji u budućnost svoga sina. Silvia je očajna zbog Brandova povratka i njegova skorašnjeg vjenčanja s Lucrezijom. Odluči se povjeriti Maddaleni i pitati je bi li trebala Brandu otkriti istinu o tome kako se za njega žrtvovala. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.title: Three mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about the adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten Keksić lives with his big brother Čoka and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and spending time with their best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they overcome all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: Don't leave me / Ne ostavljaj me
programme.desc: The missing boy Angelo manages to escape from the farmhouse, but he doesn't get far. He was stopped by his torturer, who then drove away in a tractor. The police arrived too late at the farmhouse, and there they found many items belonging to the missing children. Andrea, the torturer, reports the incident to Francesco, his boss. Andrea was abused as a child himself, and sympathizes with the victims, but is forced to leave Angelo in a small house on the water. In the farmhouse, Elena recognizes the drawings made by little Nicola. The police realize that Andrea and Tomà were friends and attended the Pentelli Institute, an orphanage that was closed due to scandal in the early 1990s. Elena goes to the location alone and finds the records. On the way back, the car goes off the road, the brakes are damaged... / Nestali dječak Angelo uspije pobjeći iz seoske kuće, ali ne stiže daleko. Zaustavio ga je njegov mučitelj, koji se potom odvezao traktorom. Policija je stigla prekasno do seoske kuće, a tamo su pronašli mnogo predmeta koji su pripadali nestaloj djeci. Andrea, mučitelj, prijavljuje incident Francescu, svom šefu. Andrea je i sam bio zlostavljan kao dijete, i saosjeća sa žrtvama, ali je prisiljen ostaviti Angela u maloj kući na vodi. U seoskoj kući, Elena prepoznaje crteže koje je napravio mali Nicola. Policija shvata da su Andrea i Tomà bili prijatelji i da su pohađali Institut Pentelli, sirotište koje je zatvoreno zbog skandala početkom 1990-ih. Elena sama odlazi na lokaciju i pronalazi zapise. U povratku, autom slijeće s ceste, kočnice su oštećene...

programme.title: A game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: From an informal conversation between Nehir and Ferida, Aziz learns that there is a chance for Feride to go to Italy for training. He tries to find out who is behind this idea and if Feride will really leave. Firat comes to Salih-baba's antique shop and everyone is surprised. The situation becomes even stranger when, in his presence, the people gathered in the antique shop continue with the game of "Chess of the Wise", because the Traveler has returned again. Tahsin tells Hasiba that she is waiting for her in their neighborhood and that she must definitely come and bring him what he asked of her. But Hasibe has no idea that Feride, Firat, and even Aziz will witness that meeting... Cast: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Director: Murat Onbul / Iz neformalnog razgovora između Nehir i Feride, Aziz saznaje da postoji šansa da Feride ode U Italiju na usavršavanje. Pokušava saznati ko stoji iza te zamisli i da li će Feride zaista otići. U Salih-babinu antikvarnicu dolazi Firat i svi su iznenađeni. Situacija postaje još čudnija kada u njegovom prisustvu, okupljeni u antikvarnici nastavljau sa igrom "Šah mudrih", jer se Putnik ponovo vratio. Tahsin govori Hasibe da je čeka u njihovom naselju i da svakako mora doći i donijeti mu ono što je od nje tražio. Ali, Hasibe ni ne sluti da će tom susretu svjedočiti Feride, Firat, pa čak i Aziz.. Uloge: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Režija: Murat Onbul

programme.title: Zafari / Zafari
programme.desc: A baby elephant with zebra stripes, a giraffe with peacock feathers, a lion the color of a pink flamingo... these are just some of the unique animals that live in Zafari, the valley at the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro... Sometimes, being different makes all the difference... / Beba slon sa zebrinim prugama, žirafa sa paunovim perjem, lav boje ružićastog flaminga…to su samo neke od jedinstvenih životinja koje žive u Zafariju, dolini u podnožju planine Kilimandžaro... Ponekad, biti drugačiji čini svu razliku...

programme.title: Mummies / Mumijevi
programme.desc: They are apparently an ordinary family.. they look like hippos and live in the Valley of the Mummies. They bring numerous ordinary and unusual adventures, both at home and on trips and excursions, where they meet various interesting beings and persons. / Oni su naizgled obična porodica.. liče na nilske konje i žive u dolini Mumijeva. Oni donose brojne obične i neobične dogodovštine, kako u kući, tako i na putovanjima i izletima, gdje upoznaju razna interesantna bića i osobe.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Eli Shane's life is ordinary, except for one thing. He comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the underworld of Slugterra to protect the special world of slugs. Now it's Eli's turn to visit the underworld and protect it from the enemy, whether he's ready or not. Eli is determined to become a hero in order to resist the forces of evil. Together with his friends Trixie, Korda and Pronto, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, which have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: While working with Carlotta to organize the construction of the train station, Silvia is visited by Lucrezia and wants to interview her for a women's magazine, since they are the only women in Italy working in such important jobs. Meanwhile, a passionate relationship develops between Dr. Lucchesi and Nana. Sister Agnese asks Dr. Lucchesi not to tarnish the reputation of the hospital by having a relationship with a dancer. At the hospital council meeting, Leopoldo Corradi continues to support the innovative ideas of Dr. Alessandro Lucchesi. Out of malice, Guendalina reveals to the doctor that Reverend Mother Agnese is his birth mother. A shocked Alessandro asks the venerable mother for an explanation and she is forced to reveal the truth to him. Meanwhile, at the Corradi house, Guendalina witnesses a tender moment between Albert and little Nora and suspects that he is her father. / Dok s Carlottom radi na organizaciji izgradnje željezničke stanice, Silviju posjećuje Lucrezia i želi je intervjuirati za ženski časopis, budući da su njih dvije jedine žene u Italiji koje rade na tako važnim poslovima. U međuvremenu se između doktora Lucchesija i Nane razvije strastvena veza. Sestra Agnese zatraži od dr. Lucchesija da ne ukalja ugled bolnice time što će se upustiti u vezu s plesačicom. Na sastanka vijeća bolnice, Leopoldo Corradi i dalje podržava inovativne ideje doktora Alessandra Lucchesija. Guendalina iz zlobe otkrije liječniku da mu je časna majka Agnese rođena majka. Šokirani Alessandro zatraži objašnjenje od časne majke i ona je prisiljena otkriti mu istinu. U međuvremenu, u kući Corradijevih, Guendalina svjedoči nježnom trenutku između Alberta i malene Nore i posumnja da joj je on otac.

programme.title: Three mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about the adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten Keksić lives with his big brother Čoka and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and spending time with their best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they overcome all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a format of TV stories whose themes are Bosnia and Herzegovina. cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of the valuable cultural treasures kept by museums throughout the country. The best promotion of the country is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots store thousands of valuable objects and exhibits, among which are numerous world rarities. Collections are in no way behind the settings in prestigious European and world museums. With this form, BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories cover only the basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit the museums and institutions where the exhibits are located for more information. In Fundus, you will see interesting things that you did not know until now, objects that you have not seen before, and it will also present a part of the tradition about which there is no recorded information. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Countdown / Odbrojavanje
programme.desc: State property is one of the key, unresolved issues in Bosnia and Herzegovina. There has been no solution for thirty years, and the obstruction continues today. During this time, the natural wealth is hijacked and looted by whoever arrives. How will this issue be resolved, by political trade or by legal means? Has the property already been divided? How seriously is the sovereignty of Bosnia and Herzegovina, which is inextricably linked to the ownership of land and resources, undermined? / Državna imovina jedno je od ključnih, neriješenih pitanja u Bosni i Hercegovini. Trideset godina nema rješenja, a opstrukcija traje i danas. Za to vrijeme, prirodno bogatstvo otima i pljačka ko stigne. Kako će biti riješeno ovo pitanje, političkom trgovinom ili pravnim sredstvima? Je li podjela imovine već izvršena? Koliko je ozbiljno potkopan suverenitet Bosne i Hercegovine, koji je neraskidivo povezan sa vlasništvom nad zemljom i resursima?

programme.title: Don't leave me / Ne ostavljaj me
programme.desc: Elena managed to jump out of the car before it plunged off the cliff. In the hospital, as soon as she recovered, she told Daniele that she had discovered that Tomà's friend and Angelo's kidnapper was named Andrea Maffetti. However, the documents found in the orphanage have disappeared. The team shot Maffetti in Milan, but he escaped, shooting policeman Luigi Fornari in the process. Not long after, Maffetti was killed, and found in an underpass. Upon returning to Venice, Daniele told Elena about the events in Milan. When Daniele is informed of Maffetti's alleged suicide, they decide to continue their own investigation, focusing on the reasons behind the closure of the orphanage. / Elena je uspjela iskočiti iz automobila prije nego što se strmoglavio niz liticu. U bolnici, čim se oporavila, rekla je Danieleu da je otkrila da se Tomàov prijatelj i Angelov otmičar zove Andrea Maffetti. Međutim, dokumenti pronađeni u sirotištu su nestali. Tim je pronšao Maffettija u Milanu, ali je pobjegao i pri tome upucao policajca Luigija Fornarija. Nedugo zatim, Maffetti je ubijen, i pronađen u podvožnjaku. Po povratku u Veneciju, Daniele je Eleni ispričao o dešavanjima u Milanu. Kada je Daniele obaviješten o Maffettijevom navodnom samoubistvu, odlučuju da sami nastave istragu, i da će se fokusirati na razloge zatvaranja sirotišta.

programme.title: A game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: Emine avoids Feride more and more, because she feels guilty for hiding important things from her. Feride is suspicious, so she decides to follow her friend. Of course, all roads lead to Altan. The problem is that at that moment Aziz was also in Altan's company. Kerem informs Firat that he saw through him and knows the reason for his strange behavior, while Gulten asks for help from Ahmet, because he believes that only he can reach Sultan and calm her down. Hasibe is surprised when Faik announces that he wants to go to his tailor shop. He has no idea that Hasibe sold her. / Emine sve više izbjegava Feride, jer osjeća krivicu zbog toga što od nje krije važne stvari. Feride je to sumnjivo, pa odlučuje pratiti prijateljicu. Naravno, svi putevi vode do Altana. Problem je u tome što se u tom trenutku u Altanovom društvu našao i Aziz. Kerem saopštava Firatu da ga je prozreo i da zna razlog njegovog čudnog ponašanja, dok Gulten traži pomoć od Ahmeta, jer smatra da jedino on može doprijeti do Sultan i smiriti je. Hasibe je iznenađena kada Faik saopšti da želi otići u svoju krojačku radnju. On ni ne sluti da ju je Hasibe prodala.

programme.desc: This 13-episode series tells the story of King Arthur's famous wizard Merlin. Even before it became known as the place of the Knights of the Round Table, the mythical city of Camelot was home to men, beasts and mythical creatures. However, in this world, magic is banned by the tyrant Uther Pedragón. When a young man named Merlin arrives in the city, he quickly makes many enemies because of the mystical and incredible powers he possesses. Among the enemies is Uther's heir, Prince Arthur. With the help of a doctor named Gaius, Merlin will be able to start using his talents not only to survive, but also to unlock the secrets of Camelot. The first thing that Merlin will discover is that his fate is closely connected with the young Arthur. / Този сериал от 13 епизода разказва историята на именития магьосник на крал Артур Мерлин. В митичния град Камелот още преди той да стане известен като мястото на рицарите на кръглата маса, живеят хора, зверове и митични създания. В този свят обаче магията е забранена от тиранина Утър Педрагон.Когато млад мъж на име Мерлин пристига в града, той бързо си спечелва много врагове заради мистичните и невероятни сили, които притежава. Сред враговете е и наследника на Утър принц Артур. С помощта на един лекар на име Гайъс Мерлин ще успее да започне да използва талантите си не само, за да оцелява, но и за да отключи тайните на Камелот.Първото нещо, което ще открие Мерлин, че съдбата му е близко свързана с младия Артур.

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La promesa - (S04, E54, Drama Series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is in turmoil, life at the noble estate of La Promesa owned by the Luján family could not be more peaceful - or so it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish high society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján, and the daughter of one of the wealthiest families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is an arranged marriage that should save the family from financial ruin. Meanwhile, the enigmatic young Jana (20) starts working on La Promesa and helps as a maid during the wedding preparations. While wandering around the building, he meets Manuel (23), the count's youngest son and Tomás' half-brother. It is a meeting that she will not be able to forget... On the day of the wedding, the countess cannot hide her displeasure since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction grows more and more, and after her outburst of anger, Jana is fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel puts on a show with his biplane and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is cut short when he loses control and crashes not far from the estate. Jana saw what happened and rushed to the scene of the accident to save Manuel. The count offers Jana a generous reward as a sign of gratitude, but she only asks to be put back to work. The family doesn't know it, but Jana has always had a plan to avenge the murder of her mother, which happened 15 years ago, and she wants to find her younger brother, who was kidnapped the same night. The only clue that Jana has leads to the magnificent building of La Promesa, where she wants to infiltrate and find the killer... But also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day, another unfortunate event brings turmoil to the estate. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined to find the killer. All evidence points to Jana because she is the last person Tomás spoke to before his death. R.: Miguel Cond... / La promesa - (S04, E54, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The dance of fate / Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Alem da Ilusao - (E26, telenovela, Brazil, 2022) Joaquim returns from Sao Paulo. Eugenio comes up with a trip with Violeta so they can be alone. Úrsula tries to distract them, but Rafael stops her. Isadora and Rafael want to open a movie theater in a working-class neighborhood. Bento finds Lorenzo in the hospital. Violeta and Eugenio spend another romantic night. Margo and Iolanda arrive in Campos and discover the impostor Rafael. Santa comes to Enrico's hotel and Lindinho imitates him by slandering Santa and their engagement is broken off. Enrico sleeps with Emilia. Joaquim invites Isadora to make models for Margo's new magazine. Father Tenorio asks Olivia for help. Arthur visits Rafael and tells him about the news regarding Elisa's case. He tells his friend to surrender. Margo and Úrsula meet, and Margo threatens to tell the truth about Joaquim's real mother. Director: Luiz Henrique Rios Street: Antonio Calloni (Matias Tapajos), Paloma Duarte (Heloísa Camargo), Malu Galli (Violeta Camargo Tapajos), Larissa Manoela (Isadora Camargo Tapajos / Elisa Camargo Tapajos), Danilo Mesquita (Joaquim)... / Alem da Ilusao - (E26, telenovela, Brazil, 2022) Joaquim se vraća iz Sao Paula. Eugenio smisli putovanje s Violetom kako bi bili sami. Úrsula ih pokuša omesti, ali Rafael je spriječi. Isadora i Rafael žele otvoriti kino u radničkom naselju. Bento nađe Lorenza u bolnici. Violeta i Eugenio provedu još jednu romantičnu noć. Margo i Iolanda stižu u Campos i otkriju varalicu Rafaela. Santa dolazi u Enricov hotel, a Lindinho ga oponaša kako kleveće Santu i dogodi se prekid njihovih zaruka. Enrico spava s Emílijom. Joaquim pozove Isadoru da napravi modele za Margoin novi časopis. Otac Tenorio zamoli Olíviju za pomoć. Arthur posjeti Rafaela i govori mu o novostima u vezi s Elisinim slučajem. Kaže prijatelju neka se preda. Margo i Úrsula se upoznaju, a Margo prijeti da će reći istinu o Joaquimovoj pravoj majci. R.: Luiz Henrique Rios Ul.: Antonio Calloni (Matias Tapajos), Paloma Duarte (Heloísa Camargo), Malu Galli (Violeta Camargo Tapajos), Larissa Manoela (Isadora Camargo Tapajos / Elisa Camargo Tapajos), Danilo Mesquita (Joaquim)...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E22, drama series, Portugal, 2024) The telenovela tells the life of a beautiful, brave and unrestrained 22-year-old girl, Cacau, who lives on the estate where her Portuguese parents, Joaquim and Filomena, live. They are the hosts and trusted people of the rich boss Justin Vaz Pereira, also Portuguese, who is old and sick, so he follows the business from Portugal. Cacau's best friends are Pitty and Guto who help her realize the idea that Brazil tastes the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works in a chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia, where he likes to surf. She is a gifted chocolate maker, and her biggest dream is to get an international diploma in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that it is unattainable for her because her family does not have the necessary money for this very expensive course. Director: Ricardo Carreira Street: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)... / Cacao - (S02, E22, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)...

programme.title: The third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The third age - (educational program, Croatia) All stereotypes about life in retirement, and unfortunately there are a lot of them and they are mostly related to poverty and diseases, are destroyed by the heroes of the stories of our show this week. Regardless of whether they live in their own home or in a home for the elderly. Pensioners from Rijeka told us about discovering talents in retirement, and kindergarteners mingled with users of the St. Anthony's home in Karlovac. The married couple Lazić testified to us about their longevity, both in life and in marriage. Marjan Majdak showed us his models and reminded us that the beauty of life is in a series of details. Lucija Kuljiš and Viktorija Mardešić told us a story about returning to their old and happy old age after many years of living in America... / Treća dob - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Sve stereotipe o životu u mirovini, a na žalost ih je puno i uglavnom su vezani uz siromaštvo i bolesti, ruše junaci priča naše ovotjedne emisije. Bez obzira na to žive li u svom ili u domu za starije. O otkrivanju talenata u mirovini govorili su nam riječki umirovljenici, a vrtićarci su se družili s korisnicima doma sveti Antun u Karlovcu. Bračni par Lazić svjedočio nam je o dugovječnosti, životnoj i bračnoj. Svoje makete izložio nam je Marjan Majdak i podsjetio nas da je ljepota života u nizu detalja. O povratku na svoj škoj i sretnoj starosti nakon dugogodišnjeg života u Americi priču su nam ispričale Lucija Kuljiš i Viktorija Mardešić...

programme.title: Dr. Beck / Dr. Beck
programme.desc: dr. Beck - (show magazine, Croatia) Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is often mistakenly considered exclusively a children's disorder. However, if it is not recognized and diagnosed in time, it can cause great difficulties for adults in their daily functioning. In this episode, we find out why early detection of ADHD is important and what the possibilities and success of treatment are. Author: Gordana Škaljac Narančić Producer: Vesna Luković Žarn Show editor: Ivana Vilović Project editor: Gordana Škaljac Narančić Producer: Dario Jakiša Host: dr. med. Natko Beck... / Dr. Beck - (show magazin, Hrvatska) Poremećaj hiperaktivnosti i deficita pažnje (ADHD) često se pogrešno smatra isključivo dječjim poremećajem. No, ako se ne prepozna i ne dijagnosticira na vrijeme, može odraslima uzrokovati velike poteškoće u svakodnevnom funkcioniranju. U ovoj epizodi doznajemo zašto je važno rano otkrivanje ADHD-a te kakve su mogućnosti i uspješnost liječenja. Autorica: Gordana Škaljac Narančić Realizatorica: Vesna Luković Žarn Urednica emisije: Ivana Vilović Urednica projekta: Gordana Škaljac Narančić Producent: Dario Jakiša Voditelj: dr. med. programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidia's Kitchen - (S11, E25, doc series, USA, 2023) Episode 25 - Risotto is on the menu The Risotto is On Today Lidia will be creative and prepare a bright yellow seafood and leek risotto with saffron. Then we will learn how to refine the stock with leftover vegetables from the freezer. At the end of the day dedicated to risotto, Lidia will show us that we don't always have to use arborio rice. He will prepare a hearty version of risotto using barley, to which he will add cabbage and sausage meat. Join Lidia in the kitchen and perfect the preparation of risotto her way. Chosen by: Mira Vočinkić Director: Erika Heymann Ul.: Erminia Motika (Self)... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E25, dok. serija, SAD, 2023) 25. nastavak - Na jelovniku je rižoto The Risotto is On Lidia će danas biti kreativna i pripremiti jarkožuti rižoto od morskih plodova i poriluka sa šafranom. Potom ćemo naučiti kako se temeljac oplemeni ostacima povrća iz zamrzivača. Na kraju dana posvećenog rižotu, Lidia će nam pokazati da ne moramo uvijek koristiti rižu arborio. Pripremit će zasitnu inačicu rižota upotrebom ječma, u koji će dodati kupus i meso kobasica. Pridružite se Lidiji u kuhinji i usavršite pripremu rižota na njezin način. Odabrala: Mira Vočinkić R.: Erika Heymann Ul.: Erminia Motika (Self)...

programme.title: Golden League / Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Zlatna liga - (educational program, Croatia) It is not about football, but about something completely different, although, indirectly, it has something to do with the First League, the Premiership or Serie A. Namely, we will host only players from the first league, i.e. golden league players, people from public, cultural, media, artistic, sports life who have marked our lives and yours, and who have well stepped into their retirement days, and what is most beautiful, they are still interesting, active, engaged and full of life's joy and strength. You will be happy to watch them and enjoy chatting with them, remember the past times, but also learn more about what they are doing today and what they dream about in the future. R.: Mladen Šimunov... / Zlatna liga - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Nije riječ o nogometu, već o nečem sasvim drugome, iako, posredno, ima veze s Prvom ligom, Premiershipom ili Serijom A. Naime, ugostit ćemo samo prvoligaše, tj. zlatnoligaše, osobe iz javnoga, kulturnoga, medijskoga, umjetničkoga, sportskoga života koji su obilježili naše i vaše živote, a koji su dobrano zagazili u umirovljeničke dane, i što je najljepše, i dalje su zanimljivi, aktivni, angažirani i prepuni životne radosti i snage. Rado ćete ih gledati i uživati u čavrljanju s njima, sjetiti se prošlih vremena, ali i saznati više o tome što danas rade i o čemu snuju u budućnosti. R.: Mladen Šimunov...

programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E26, doc. series, USA, 2023) Through 26 episodes, the series follows Lidia Bastianich on another culinary journey full of discoveries. Join Lidia, who will prepare simple, seasonal and economical dishes with lots of charm, trust and love. It will show viewers that they can find inspiration in their roots, that they should be spontaneous and that they should cultivate a sense of home in the kitchen. With a wealth of tips and methods that are the result of years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate her passion for teaching into a fun and credible curriculum that encompasses kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "feeding yourself, your family and friends is one of the most important things in life". Famous American chef, restaurant owner, author of several cooking books, author of culinary series Lidia Bastianich is a native of Croatia, more precisely from Pula. ... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E26, dok. serija, SAD, 2023) Serija kroz 26 nastavaka prati Lidiju Bastianich na još jednom kulinarskom putovanju punom otkrića. Pridružite se Lidiji koja će pripremati jednostavna, sezonska i ekonomična jela s puno čara, pouzdanja i ljubavi. Pokazat će gledateljima da nadahnuće mogu pronaći u svojim korijenima, da trebaju biti spontani i da u kuhinji trebaju njegovati osjećaj doma. Uz bogatstvo savjeta i metoda koji su rezultat dugogodišnjeg iskustva u kuhinji i za obiteljskim stolom, Lidia će svoju strast prema poučavanju pretočiti u zabavan i vjerodostojan nastavni plan i program koji obuhvaća kuhinjsku mudrost. Kao što Lidia kaže, "hraniti sebe, svoju obitelj i prijatelje jedna je od najvažnijih stvari u životu". Poznata američka kuharica, vlasnica restorana, autorica nekoliko knjiga o kuhanju, autorica kulinarskih serija Lidia Bastianich rodom je iz Hrvatske, točnije iz Pule. ...
