programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E23, drama series, Portugal, 2024) The telenovela tells the life of a beautiful, brave and unrestrained 22-year-old girl, Cacao, who lives on the estate of her Portuguese parents, Joaquim and Filomena. They are the hosts and trusted people of the rich boss Justin Vaz Pereira, also Portuguese, who is old and sick, so he follows the business from Portugal. Cacau's best friends are Pitty and Guto who help her realize the idea that Brazil tastes the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works in a chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia, where he likes to surf. She is a gifted chocolate maker, and her biggest dream is to get an international diploma in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that it is unattainable for her because her family does not have the necessary money for this very expensive course. Director: Ricardo Carreira Street: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)... / Cacao - (S02, E23, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La promesa - (S04, E55, Drama Series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is in turmoil, life at the noble estate of La Promesa owned by the Luján family could not be more peaceful - or so it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish high society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján, and the daughter of one of the wealthiest families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is an arranged marriage that should save the family from financial ruin. Meanwhile, the enigmatic young Jana (20) starts working on La Promesa and helps as a maid during the wedding preparations. While wandering around the building, he meets Manuel (23), the count's youngest son and Tomás' half-brother. It is a meeting that she will not be able to forget... On the day of the wedding, the countess cannot hide her displeasure since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction grows more and more, and after her outburst of anger, Jana is fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel puts on a show with his biplane and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is cut short when he loses control and crashes not far from the estate. Jana saw what happened and rushed to the scene of the accident to save Manuel. The count offers Jana a generous reward as a sign of gratitude, but she only asks to be put back to work. The family doesn't know it, but Jana has always had a plan to avenge the murder of her mother, which happened 15 years ago, and she wants to find her younger brother, who was kidnapped the same night. The only clue that Jana has leads to the magnificent building of La Promesa, where she wants to infiltrate and find the killer... But also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day, another unfortunate event brings turmoil to the estate. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined to find the killer. All evidence points to Jana because she is the last person Tomás spoke to before his death. R.: Miguel Cond... / La promesa - (S04, E55, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Dulum of the earth / Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: Dulum zemlje - (S04, E05, educational program, Croatia, 2025) Not far from Sisak, the Veselić family developed one of the most successful ecological farms in Croatia. They are especially proud of the fact that they created a business that also employs foreign workers, for whom they bought the house in which they live. Their fruits and vegetables end up on school tables through special food programs, and they organize delivery to customers themselves. The episode reveals how the combination of superior ecological production, social responsibility and entrepreneurial spirit can become an example of sustainable agriculture. Director: Filip Filković... / Dulum zemlje - (S04, E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Nedaleko od Siska, obitelj Veselić razvila je jedno od najuspješnijih ekoloških gospodarstava u Hrvatskoj. Posebno se ponose time što su stvorili posao koji zapošljava i strane radnike, za koje su kupili kuću u kojoj žive. Njihovo voće i povrće završava na stolovima škola kroz posebne prehrambene programe, a sami organiziraju i dostavu kupcima. Epizoda otkriva kako spoj vrhunske ekološke proizvodnje, društvene odgovornosti i poduzetničkog duha može postati primjer održive poljoprivrede. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: Around the world by train / Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Around the World by Train with Tony Robinson - (S02, E03, nature film, England, 2019) Sir Tony Robinson has a mission to get to know and understand the shared history and culture of Mexico and the USA. He leaves the usual tourist paths and meets locals who reveal unexpected stories to him. From the Mexican desert to starry Los Angeles, he explores these fascinating parts of America by train. The journey begins with the El Chepe train on the west coast of Mexico through the spectacular Copper Canyon - larger and deeper than the Grand Canyon in the USA. There they will meet people who have lived in the canyon for generations. Then he takes the only passenger train in Mexico to the USA and on the way he will stop in the city of Chihuahua, where he will learn how he became prosperous and learn about the traditional drink "sotol", a northern Mexican type of tequila. They will have fun at the distillery tasting exotic varieties, including one with marijuana. Then he comes to the city that, thanks to the cartel wars, was once known as the most murderous city in the world, Juarez. Director: Michael Massey... / Around the World by Train with Tony Robinson - (S02, E03, prirod. film, Engleska, 2019) Sir Tony Robinson ima misiju upoznati i razumjeti zajedničku povijest i kulturu Meksika i SAD-a. Napušta uobičajene turističke staze i upoznaje domaće koji mu otkrivaju neočekivane priče. Od meksičke pustinje do zvjezdanog Los Angelesa, vlakom istražuje ove fascinantne dijelove Amerike. Putovanje počinje vlakom El Chepe na zapadnoj obali Meksika kroz spektakularni Bakreni kanjon - veći i dublji od Grand Canyona u SAD-u. Ondje će upoznati ljude koji u kanjonu žive naraštajima. Zatim jedinim putničkim vlakom u Meksiku kreće prema SAD-u i putem će stati u gradu Chihuahui gdje će doznati kako je postao prosperitetan i upoznati tradicionalno piće "sotol", sjevernomeksičku vrstu tekile. Zabavit će se u destileriji kušajući egzotične varijante, uključujući jednu s marihuanom. Zatim dolazi u grad koji je zahvaljujući ratovima kartela nekoć bio poznat kao grad s najviše ubojstava na svijetu, Juarez. R.: Michael Massey...

programme.desc: Potjera - (quiz show, Croatia) In Potjera, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. The chase is not just a quiz - it's also a race where the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is?... / Potjera - (kviz show, Hrvatska) U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?...

programme.title: Don't forget to leave a review / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Don't forget to leave a review - (E05, tourist program, Croatia, 2025) Tourists believe that a rented apartment is not just a place to sleep, but a small piece of the city and country they have arrived in. However, private accommodation is actually a mirror of our society. Cities on the coast live on positional rent: the sea is a currency, and a square meter is worth gold. In places where everyone wants to vacation, it is becoming more and more difficult to live. The old cores are transformed into backdrops for seasonal earnings, and the hosts will huddle at mom's in the summer to let tourists into their beds. One star with the comment "the room was desperate". Apart from the price, nothing was good - and the whole season can go down the drain. When a home becomes a business plan - a review can change everything. R.: Ivan Grgur... / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju - (E05, turistički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Turisti vjeruju da unajmljeni apartman nije samo mjesto za spavanje, već mali komadić grada i zemlje u koju su stigli. No, privatni smještaj je zapravo ogledalo našeg društva. Gradovi na obali žive od položajne rente: more je valuta, a kvadrat vrijedi kao zlato. U mjestima gdje svi žele ljetovati, postaje sve teže živjeti. Stare jezgre pretvaraju se u kulise sezonske zarade, a domaćini će se ljeti stisnuti kod mame kako bi u svoje krevete pustili turiste. Jedna zvjezdica s komentarom "soba je bila očajna". Osim cijene, ništa nije bilo dobro - i cijela sezona može pasti u vodu. Kada dom postane poslovni plan - recenzija može promijeniti sve. programme.title: A conversation with a reason / Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Conversation with a reason - (art program, Croatia) The guest of the show Conversation with a reason is sociologist and political scientist Dražen Lalić. He will discover why his family history became an obsession that he could not let go of, but had to dive into it and write the book Two Houses Above the Sea. We will discuss the differences between the different levels of memory culture - private, family and collective - and why Lalić believes that the traumas of the Second World War are still unhealed. How should we as a society deal with divisions and why is empathy even for victims "on the other side" important? The book, which tells about all of us through the story of two Dalmatian families, is the reason for this conversation with Dražen Lalić. R.: Siniša Hajduk... / Razgovor s razlogom - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je sociolog i politolog Dražen Lalić. Otkrivat će zašto mu je obiteljska povijest postala opsesija koju nije mogao pustiti, već je morao zaroniti u nju i napisati knjigu Dvije kuće iznad mora. Razgovarat ćemo o razlikama između različitih razina kulture sjećanja - privatne, obiteljske i kolektivne - te o tome zašto Lalić smatra da su traume iz Drugog svjetskog rata i dalje neizliječene. Kako se kao društvo trebamo nositi s podjelama i zašto je važna empatija čak i prema žrtvama "s druge strane"? Knjiga, koja kroz priču o dvjema dalmatinskim obiteljima govori o svima nama, razlog je za ovaj razgovor s Draženom Lalićem. R.: Siniša Hajduk...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La promesa - (S04, E55, Drama Series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is in turmoil, life at the noble estate of La Promesa owned by the Luján family could not be more peaceful - or so it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish high society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján, and the daughter of one of the wealthiest families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is an arranged marriage that should save the family from financial ruin. Meanwhile, the enigmatic young Jana (20) starts working on La Promesa and helps as a maid during the wedding preparations. While wandering around the building, he meets Manuel (23), the count's youngest son and Tomás' half-brother. It is a meeting that she will not be able to forget... On the day of the wedding, the countess cannot hide her displeasure since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction grows more and more, and after her outburst of anger, Jana is fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel puts on a show with his biplane and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is cut short when he loses control and crashes not far from the estate. Jana saw what happened and rushed to the scene of the accident to save Manuel. The count offers Jana a generous reward as a sign of gratitude, but she only asks to be put back to work. The family doesn't know it, but Jana has always had a plan to avenge the murder of her mother, which happened 15 years ago, and she wants to find her younger brother, who was kidnapped the same night. The only clue that Jana has leads to the magnificent building of La Promesa, where she wants to infiltrate and find the killer... But also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day, another unfortunate event brings turmoil to the estate. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined to find the killer. All evidence points to Jana because she is the last person Tomás spoke to before his death. R.: Miguel Cond... / La promesa - (S04, E55, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

Cacau's best friends are Pitty and Guto who help her realize the idea that Brazil tastes the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works in a chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia, where he likes to surf. She is a gifted chocolate maker, and her biggest dream is to get an international diploma in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that it is unattainable for her because her family does not have the necessary money for this very expensive course. programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E26, doc. series, USA, 2023) Through 26 episodes, the series follows Lidia Bastianich on another culinary journey full of discoveries. Join Lidia, who will prepare simple, seasonal and economical dishes with lots of charm, trust and love. It will show viewers that they can find inspiration in their roots, that they should be spontaneous and that they should cultivate a sense of home in the kitchen. With a wealth of tips and methods that are the result of years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate her passion for teaching into a fun and credible curriculum that encompasses kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "feeding yourself, your family and friends is one of the most important things in life". Famous American chef, restaurant owner, author of several cooking books, author of culinary series Lidia Bastianich is a native of Croatia, more precisely from Pula. ... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E26, dok. serija, SAD, 2023) Serija kroz 26 nastavaka prati Lidiju Bastianich na još jednom kulinarskom putovanju punom otkrića. Pokazat će gledateljima da nadahnuće mogu pronaći u svojim korijenima, da trebaju biti spontani i da u kuhinji trebaju njegovati osjećaj doma. Uz bogatstvo savjeta i metoda koji su rezultat dugogodišnjeg iskustva u kuhinji i za obiteljskim stolom, Lidia će svoju strast prema poučavanju pretočiti u zabavan i vjerodostojan nastavni plan i program koji obuhvaća kuhinjsku mudrost. Kao što Lidia kaže, "hraniti sebe, svoju obitelj i prijatelje jedna je od najvažnijih stvari u životu". Poznata američka kuharica, vlasnica restorana, autorica nekoliko knjiga o kuhanju, autorica kulinarskih serija Lidia Bastianich rodom je iz Hrvatske, točnije iz Pule. ...

programme.title: Golden League / Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Zlatna liga - (educational program, Croatia) It is not about football, but about something completely different, although, indirectly, it has something to do with the First League, the Premiership or Serie A. Namely, we will host only players from the first league, i.e. golden league players, people from public, cultural, media, artistic, sports life who have marked our lives and yours, and who have well stepped into their retirement days, and what is most beautiful, they are still interesting, active, engaged and full of life's joy and strength. You will be happy to watch them and enjoy chatting with them, remember the past times, but also learn more about what they are doing today and what they dream about in the future. R.: Mladen Šimunov... / Zlatna liga - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Nije riječ o nogometu, već o nečem sasvim drugome, iako, posredno, ima veze s Prvom ligom, Premiershipom ili Serijom A. Naime, ugostit ćemo samo prvoligaše, tj. zlatnoligaše, osobe iz javnoga, kulturnoga, medijskoga, umjetničkoga, sportskoga života koji su obilježili naše i vaše živote, a koji su dobrano zagazili u umirovljeničke dane, i što je najljepše, i dalje su zanimljivi, aktivni, angažirani i prepuni životne radosti i snage. Rado ćete ih gledati i uživati u čavrljanju s njima, sjetiti se prošlih vremena, ali i saznati više o tome što danas rade i o čemu snuju u budućnosti. R.: Mladen Šimunov...

programme.title: Mary Berry's classic recipes / Klasični recepti Mary Berry
programme.desc: Classic Mary Berry - (E01, Education, England, 2018) This six-part series will show why Mary Berry is a fantastic cook, teacher and inspiration. Each food-filled episode will be dedicated to a specific type of dish, some of which are well-known and some of which are completely new. But Mary will use her unique cooking style to prepare all the dishes, which includes simple skills and processing methods, a small number of ingredients and easy-to-apply tricks for easier preparation. No one else can prepare simpler and more delicious dishes, and all of them will be in the classic Mary Berry style. --- Mary Berry will demonstrate her favorite soul-warming homemade dishes, from the simplest to the decadent. At the same time, they will enjoy preparing food on an open fire with Swedish chef Niklas Ekstedt. Director: David Crerar Street: Mary Berry (Self - Presenter), Niklas Ekstedt (Self)... / Classic Mary Berry - (E01, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2018) Ova šestodjelna serija pokazat će zašto je Mary Berry fantastična kuharica, učiteljica i nadahnuće. Svaki nastavak ispunjen hranom bit će posvećen određenoj vrsti jela, od kojih su neka dobro poznata, a neka posve nova. No Mary će za pripremu svih jela primijeniti svoj jedinstveni stil kuhanja, koji uključuje jednostavne vještine i načine obrade, mali broj sastojaka i trikove za lakšu pripremu koje je lako primijeniti. Nitko drugi ne može pripremiti jednostavnija, a slasnija jela, a sva će biti u klasičnom stilu Mary Berry. --- Mary Berry pokazat će omiljena domaća jela koja griju dušu, od najjednostavnijih do dekadentnih. Ujedno će uživati u pripremi hrane na otvorenoj vatri sa švedskim kuharom Niklasom Ekstedtom. R.: David Crerar Ul.: Mary Berry (Self - Presenter), Niklas Ekstedt (Self)...

programme.desc: dr. Beck - (show magazine, Croatia) As many as 70 to 90 percent of adolescents at puberty have problems with acne, but they are not a problem only in that period of life. What is their cause and how to properly treat and cure them, we find out in the show. dr. Dermatologist Gaby Novak Bilić, beautician Zdenka Mihelj, singer Zsa Zsa and nutritionist Ivona Brodić are visiting Natka Beck... / Dr. Beck - (show magazin, Hrvatska) Čak 70 do 90 posto adolescenata u pubertetu ima problem s aknama, no one nisu problem samo u tom životnom razdoblju. Dr. Natku Becku u goste stižu dermatologinja Gaby Novak Bilić, kozmetičarka Zdenka Mihelj, pjevačica Zsa Zsa i nutricionistic Ivona Brodić...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E24, drama series, Portugal, 2024) The telenovela tells the life of a beautiful, brave and unrestrained 22-year-old girl, Cacao, who lives on the estate of her Portuguese parents, Joaquim and Filomena. They are the hosts and trusted people of the rich boss Justin Vaz Pereira, also Portuguese, who is old and sick, so he follows the business from Portugal. Cacau's best friends are Pitty and Guto who help her realize the idea that Brazil tastes the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works in a chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia, where he likes to surf. She is a gifted chocolate maker, and her biggest dream is to get an international diploma in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that it is unattainable for her because her family does not have the necessary money for this very expensive course. Director: Ricardo Carreira Street: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)... / Cacao - (S02, E24, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La promesa - (S04, E56, Drama Series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is in turmoil, life at the noble estate of La Promesa owned by the Luján family could not be more peaceful - or so it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish high society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján, and the daughter of one of the wealthiest families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is an arranged marriage that should save the family from financial ruin. Meanwhile, the enigmatic young Jana (20) starts working on La Promesa and helps as a maid during the wedding preparations. While wandering around the building, he meets Manuel (23), the count's youngest son and Tomás' half-brother. It is a meeting that she will not be able to forget... On the day of the wedding, the countess cannot hide her displeasure since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction grows more and more, and after her outburst of anger, Jana is fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel puts on a show with his biplane and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is cut short when he loses control and crashes not far from the estate. Jana saw what happened and rushed to the scene of the accident to save Manuel. The count offers Jana a generous reward as a sign of gratitude, but she only asks to be put back to work. The family doesn't know it, but Jana has always had a plan to avenge the murder of her mother, which happened 15 years ago, and she wants to find her younger brother, who was kidnapped the same night. The only clue that Jana has leads to the magnificent building of La Promesa, where she wants to infiltrate and find the killer... But also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day, another unfortunate event brings turmoil to the estate. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined to find the killer. All evidence points to Jana because she is the last person Tomás spoke to before his death. R.: Miguel Cond... / La promesa - (S04, E56, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Don't forget to leave a review / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Don't forget to leave a review - (E05, tourist program, Croatia, 2025) Tourists believe that a rented apartment is not just a place to sleep, but a small piece of the city and country they have arrived in. However, private accommodation is actually a mirror of our society. Cities on the coast live on positional rent: the sea is a currency, and a square meter is worth gold. In places where everyone wants to vacation, it is becoming more and more difficult to live. The old cores are transformed into backdrops for seasonal earnings, and the hosts will huddle at mom's in the summer to let tourists into their beds. One star with the comment "the room was desperate". Apart from the price, nothing was good - and the whole season can go down the drain. When a home becomes a business plan - a review can change everything. R.: Ivan Grgur... / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju - (E05, turistički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Turisti vjeruju da unajmljeni apartman nije samo mjesto za spavanje, već mali komadić grada i zemlje u koju su stigli. No, privatni smještaj je zapravo ogledalo našeg društva. Gradovi na obali žive od položajne rente: more je valuta, a kvadrat vrijedi kao zlato. U mjestima gdje svi žele ljetovati, postaje sve teže živjeti. Stare jezgre pretvaraju se u kulise sezonske zarade, a domaćini će se ljeti stisnuti kod mame kako bi u svoje krevete pustili turiste. Jedna zvjezdica s komentarom "soba je bila očajna". Osim cijene, ništa nije bilo dobro - i cijela sezona može pasti u vodu. Kada dom postane poslovni plan - recenzija može promijeniti sve. R.: Ivan Grgur...

programme.title: Police witnesses / Policijske priče
programme.desc: Police stories - (E05, educational program, Croatia, 2025) Murders in the crime milieu are often full of unanswered questions. In order to get answers to them, Domagoj Zaradić, together with his colleagues, has to contact people from all walks of life and thus portrays the real "Face of the city". R.: Hrvoje Mabić... / Policijske priče - (E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Ubojstva u krim miljeu često su puna neodgovorenih pitanja. Kako bi na njih dobio odgovore, Domagoj Zaradić zajedno sa svojim kolegama mora kontaktirati osobe iz svih sfera života i tako oslikava stvarno "Naličje grada". R.: Hrvoje Mabić...

programme.title: Our little parties / Naše male fešte
programme.desc: Our little festivals - (E08, art program, Croatia) The episode takes us to Cvelferija, a charming plain in Srijem, where the "Singing Cvelferija" takes place every year, an event that celebrates the Shoka tradition through music, dance and togetherness. We follow the preparations for this event, from decorating the village to the arrival of choirs and tambura bands. The event brings a wealth of cultural performances, from children's sections to guests from other parts of Croatia and abroad. The day ends with a large joint circle, where all participants celebrate the Šoká heritage, and the atmosphere is filled with joy, tradition and pride in the cultural identity of this region. Director: Goran Ribarić... / Naše male fešte - (E08, umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Epizoda nas vodi u Cvelferiju, šarmantnu ravnicu u Srijemu, gdje se svake godine održava "Raspjevana Cvelferija", manifestacija koja slavi šokačku tradiciju kroz glazbu, ples i zajedništvo. Pratimo pripreme za ovaj događaj, od ukrašavanja sela do dolaska zborova i tamburaških sastava. Manifestacija donosi bogatstvo kulturnih nastupa, od dječjih sekcija do gostiju iz drugih dijelova Hrvatske i inozemstva. Dan završava velikim zajedničkim kolom, gdje svi sudionici slave šokačku baštinu, a atmosfera je ispunjena veseljem, tradicijom i ponosom na kulturni identitet ovog kraja. R.: Goran Ribarić...

programme.title: Around the world by train / Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Around the World by Train with Tony Robinson - (S02, E04, natural film, England, 2020) Sir Tony Robinson will take a train into the unknown traveling from Canada to Alaska. He looks forward to meeting Canadians and exploring the great wilderness in this part of the world, from the Rocky Mountains to the beautiful glaciers of Alaska. The journey begins in the high-tech city of Seattle, home to Amazon, Microsoft and Starbucks. The Amtrack Cascades train will take him across the border into Canada where he will be immediately surprised by the beauty of Vancouver and the warmth of Canadians. Director: Michael Massey Street: Dave Babych (Self)... / Around the World by Train with Tony Robinson - (S02, E04, prirod. film, Engleska, 2020) Sir Tony Robinson će se vlakom zaputiti u nepoznato putujući iz Kanade u Aljasku. Veseli se upoznavanju Kanađana i istraživanju velike divljine u ovom dijelu svijeta, od planina Stjenjaka do prelijepih glečera Aljaske. Putovanje počinje u gradu visoke tehnologije Seattleu gdje sjedišta imaju Amazon, Microsoft i Starbucks. Vlak Amtrack Cascades prevest će ga preko granice u Kanadu gdje će ga odmah iznenaditi ljepota Vancouvera i toplina Kanađana. R.: Michael Massey Ul.: Dave Babych (Self)...

programme.title: Pursuit / Potjera
programme.desc: Potjera - (quiz show, Croatia) In Potjera, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is?... / Potjera - (kviz show, Hrvatska) U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. Potjera nije samo kviz - ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?...

programme.title: David Skoko: A place for me / David Skoko: Mjesto za mene
programme.desc: David Skoko: A place for me - (E01, educational program, Croatia, 2025) David Skoko travels to the Neretva valley to experience the authentic tourist offer of that traditionally agricultural region, and Pavo Jerković, the hearty ambassador of Neretva, will bring him closer to the potential and specificity of this climate. Photo safaris, rides on traditional Neretva boats, mandarin plantations and kite-surfing have become a kind of brand of this valley and have attracted thousands of visitors. On the gastronomic side, we will find out what kind of capelunga shells they are and how many hot peppers go into Neretva's brudet. Director: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo... / David Skoko: Mjesto za mene - (E01, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) David Skoko putuje u dolinu Neretve iskušati autentičnu turističku ponudu tog tradicionalno poljoprivrednog kraja, a Pavo Jerković, srčani ambasador Neretve, približit će mu potencijal i specifičnost ovoga podneblja. Fotosafari, vožnja tradicionalnim neretvanskim lađama, nasadi mandarina ali i kite-surfing postali su svojevrsni brend ove doline i privukli tisuće posjetitelja. S gastronomske strane, doznat ćemo kakve su to školjke kapelunge i koliko ljutih papričica ide u neretvanski brudet. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo...

programme.title: Arm / Krah
programme.desc: Little Disasters - (E05, drama series, England, 2025) And as all their lies and secrets come to the surface, Ed, Jess and the other friends have to deal with the consequences of Jess's actions. Charlotte reveals how she really feels about Ed, and Liz defuses a potentially fatal situation for Betsey. The friends are shaken after Jess ends up in police custody. Jess's mental state begins to deteriorate after relentless questioning by Detectives Rustin and Farron, though Andrew intervenes, this time as her lawyer. Desperate to get some answers on some issues, Ed and Liz try to find out on their own why Jess is behaving the way she does. Charlotte gets involved after Rob and Mel's relationship publicly falls apart. Mel finally has to admit the truth to herself. Ed and friends are running out of time, and Jess's future hangs in the balance. Everyone has to ask themselves hard questions because of the speculation. As it slowly becomes clear what really happened on Friday night, the police uncover a crucial piece of evidence, and Jess faces life-changing consequences. Director: Eva Sigurdardottir Ul.: Diane Kruger (Jess), Jo Joyner (Liz), Shelley Conn (Charlotte), Emily Taaffe (Mel), Adil Akram (Nihal)... / Little Disasters - (E05, igrana serija, Engleska, 2025) I dok sve njihove laži i tajne izlaze na površinu, Ed, Jess i ostali prijatelji moraju se nositi s posljedicama Jessinih postupaka. Charlotte otkriva što zapravo osjeća prema Edu, a Liz smiri situaciju u kojoj je Betsey mogla smrtno stradati. Prijatelji su potreseni nakon što Jess završi u policijskom pritvoru. Jessino mentalno stanje počinje se pogoršavati nakon neumornog ispitivanja detektiva Rustin i Farron, iako se Andrew umiješao, ovaj put kao njezin odvjetnik. Budući da očajnički žele dobiti dogovore na neka pitanja, Ed i Liz pokušavaju sami istražiti zašto se Jess tako ponaša. Charlotte se umiješa nakon što se Robova i Melina veza javno raspadne. Mel si napokon mora priznati istinu. Ed i prijatelji imaju sve manje vremena, a Jessina budućnost visi o niti. Svi si zbog nagađanja moraju postaviti teška pitanja. Polako postaje jasno što se zaista dogodilo u petak navečer, policija otkrije ključan dokaz, a Jess se suoči s posljedicama koje će joj promijeniti život. R.: Eva Sigurdardottir Ul.: Diane Kruger (Jess), Jo Joyner (Liz), Shelley Conn (Charlotte), Emily Taaffe (Mel), Adil Akram (Nihal)...

programme.title: Mayaki, the duration of parride / Miyazaki, duh prirode
programme.desc: Miyazaki: LEsprit de la Nature - (doc. film, France, 2024) The first documentary that talks about the work of Oscar winner Hayao Miyazaki, emphasizing his deep connection with nature and the ecological themes he deals with in his films. Through protagonists such as Totoro and Princess Mononoke, Miyazaki expresses his preoccupations with the world. His films are often autobiographical and echo the turmoil of the 20th century. This clip-enhanced documentary, featuring his son and director Goro Miyazaki, producer Toshio Suzuki and philosopher Timothy Morton, reveals the profound ecological dimension of Miyazaki's works, which question our relationship to the natural world and living beings... / Miyazaki: LEsprit de la Nature - (dok. film, Francuska, 2024) Prvi dokumentarni film koji o djelu oskarovca Hayaoa Miyazakija govori naglašavajući njegovu duboku povezanost s prirodom i ekološke teme kojima se bavi u svojim filmovima. Kroz protagoniste kao što su Totoro i princeza Mononoke, Miyazaki izražava svoje preokupacije o svijetu. Njegovi su filmovi često autobiografski i u njima se osjeća odjek previranja 20. stoljeća. Ovaj dokumentarni film obogaćen filmskim isječcima, u kojem sudjeluju njegov sin i redatelj Goro Miyazaki, producent Toshio Suzuki i filozof Timothy Morton, otkriva duboku ekološku dimenziju Miyazakijevih djela, koja propituju naš odnos prema prirodnom svijetu i živim bićima...

programme.title: The trap of social networks - five women against five major platforms / Zamka društvenih mreža - pet žena protiv pet velikih platformi
programme.desc: Emprise numerique, 5 femmes contre les Big 5 - (documentary film, France, 2025) Adolescents who spend more than five hours a day on their smartphones are 66% more likely to develop suicidal tendencies than those who use them for up to one hour a day. 44 US states are currently suing Meta, blaming the company for making an entire generation sick. Faced with powerful tech giants like Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X and Discord, how can we possibly protect children and their childhoods? For the first time in history, state legislators and parents in the US and Europe are joining forces to fight the digital giants. Among them are five women who decided to turn their everyday lives upside down to fight against five major platforms. Alexis, Elisabet, Sofia, Laure and Socheata. They are victims, mothers, doctors and lawyers. They are all behind a movement whose goal is to change the fate of future generations. Alexis, a victim of screen addiction, was among the first to sue Meta, accusing her of "inciting suicide." Elisabet is a mother of three children, and in just a few days more than 10,000 parents joined her WhatsApp group in the fight for "youth without mobile phones". As a result, the state banned smartphones in schools. Sofia is a psychiatrist and a pioneer in the treatment of screen addiction in children, some of whom are as young as seven years old. Socheata joined the fight when her son found himself under the manipulation of an internet predator. She joined the association and, together with police officers specializing in cybercrime, catches pedophiles. Laure is a lawyer determined to change the laws that protect the Big Five. Through the difficulties these women face, we will discover how digital control is a major public health and safety problem that exceeds the limits of our expectations. Director: Elisa Jadot... / Emprise numerique, 5 femmes contre les Big 5 - (dok. film, Francuska, 2025) Adolescenti koji za svojim pametnim telefonima provode više od pet sati na dan imaju 66 % više izgleda da će razviti suicidalne sklonosti negoli oni koji se njima koriste do jednog sata na dan. 44 američke savezne države trenutačne tuže Metu, okrivljujući kompaniju za pobolijevanje cijele generacije. Suočeni s moćnim tehnološkim divovima poput Mete, TikToka, Snapchata, X-a i Discorda, kako uopće možemo zaštititi djecu i njihovo djetinjstvo? Prvi put u povijesti državni zakonodavci i roditelji u SAD-u i Europi udružuju snage u borbi protiv digitalnih divova. Među njima je pet žena koje su odlučile preokrenuti svoj svakodnevni život naglavačke kako bi krenule u borbu protiv pet velikih platformi. Alexis, Elisabet, Sofia, Laure i Socheata. One su žrtve, majke, liječnice i odvjetnice. Sve stoje iza pokreta kojem je cilj promijeniti sudbinu budućih naraštaja. Alexis, žrtva ovisnosti o ekranu, bila je među prvima koji su tužili Metu, optužujući je za "poticanje na samoubojstvo". Elisabet je majka troje djece, a u samo nekoliko dana više od 10.000 roditelja pridružilo se njezinoj WhatsApp grupi u borbi za "mladost bez mobitela". Kao rezultat toga, država je zabranila pametne telefone u školama. Sofia je psihijatrica i pionirka u liječenju ovisnosti o ekranu kod djece, od kojih neki imaju samo sedam godina. Socheata se pridružila borbi kad se njezin sin našao pod manipulacijom internetskog predatora. Priključila se udruženju i zajedno s policajcima specijaliziranim za kibernetički kriminal hvata pedofile. Laure je odvjetnica odlučna u tome da promijeni zakone koji štite velikih pet. Kroz poteškoće s kojima se susreću ove žena otkrit ćemo kako je digitalna kontrola veliki problem javnog zdravstva i sigurnosti koji prelazi granice naših očekivanja. R.: Elisa Jadot...

programme.title: Lewis / Lewis
programme.desc: Lewis - (S02, E04, crime series, England, 2008) Teenager Beatrice is found wandering naked in the meadows of Oxford. She doesn't remember anything, but forensics reveal that she was raped after the criminal drugged her with insomnia. Lewis and Hathaway narrow down the list of suspects and eventually land on a computer science teacher at Beatrice's school. But the suspect Oswald Cooper has a solid alibi, moreover, he is vouched for by three men, well-known pillars of society. When Cooper is found murdered and castrated, revenge is the obvious motive for the attack on Beatrice, but the police can't prove that Cooper was the attacker, and Lewis tries hard to find a hole in Cooper's alibi. R.: Stuart Orme St.: Kevin Whately (DI Robert Lewis), Laurence Fox (DS James Hathaway), Clare Holman (Dr. Laura Hobson), Rebecca Front (Chief Superintendent Jean Innocent), Laura Rees (Beatrice Donnelly)... / Lewis - (S02, E04, krim. serija, Engleska, 2008) Tinejdžerica Beatrice pronađena je kako gola luta livadama Oxforda. Ne sjeća se ničega, ali forenzičari otkrivaju da je silovana nakon što ju je zločinac drogirao lijekom protiv nesanice. Lewis i Hathaway sužavaju popis osumnjičenih i naposljetku dolaze do profesora informatike u Beatriceinoj školi. Ali osumnjičeni Oswald Cooper ima čvrst alibi, štoviše, za njega jamče tri čovjeka, poznati stupovi društva. Kada Coopera pronađu ubijenog i kastriranog, očit je motiv osveta za napad na Beatrice, ali policija ne može dokazati da je Cooper bio napadač, a Lewis uza sav trud ne uspijeva pronaći rupu u Cooperovu alibiju. R.: Stuart Orme Ul.: Kevin Whately (DI Robert Lewis), Laurence Fox (DS James Hathaway), Clare Holman (Dr. Laura Hobson), Rebecca Front (Chief Superintendent Jean Innocent), Laura Rees (Beatrice Donnelly)...

programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S10, E19, Comedy, USA, 2023) Once upon a time, not so long ago, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) used his parents' camcorder to document life on the outskirts of the 1980s. He has his hands full, starting with well-meaning but stifling mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), to temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orrantia) and hypersensitive brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And then there is the unbelted grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when there are better things in life. Driving lessons, first jobs, college applications, and making new friends without losing old ones are all part of the Goldberg family saga. Some leave their childhood behind in search of their first kiss, others struggle with raising teenagers or, faced with aging, recall youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience it all. For better or for worse, they are always there for each other. Director: Melissa Kosar Street: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)... / The Goldbergs - (S10, E19, komedija, SAD, 2023) Jednom ne tako davno i ne tako daleko 11-godišnji Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) video-kamerom svojih roditelja dokumentira život na periferiji 1980-ih godina. Ima pune ruke posla, počevši od mame Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), koja je dobronamjerna, ali ga guši, preko temperamentnog tate Murrayja (Jeff Garlin), do buntovne starije sestre Erice (Hayley Orrantia) i hipersenzibilnog brata Barryja (Troy Gentile). A tu je i raspojasani djed (George Segal), zavodnik, koji je Adamu mentor kad su posrijedi ljepše stvari u životu. Satovi vožnje, prvi poslovi, prijave za fakultet i stjecanje novih prijatelja, a da se pritom ne izgube stari, sve je to dio sage o obitelji Goldberg. Neki ostavljaju djetinjstvo iza sebe u potrazi za prvim poljupcem, drugi pak muku muče s odgojem tinejdžera ili se, suočeni sa starenjem, prisjećaju mladenačkih strasti - obitelj Goldberg iskusit će sve to. I u dobru i u zlu, oni su uvijek tu jedni za druge. R.: Melissa Kosar Ul.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)...

programme.title: Escape to the countryside / Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Escape to the Country - (S32, E17, Entertainment, England, 2024) Emotions run high in West Yorkshire as Nicki Chapman helps a Hertfordshire lady find a new home in the beautiful county where she grew up. There, Nicki meets a couple who three years ago moved from London to a beautiful old farm with as much as two and a half hectares of land. Chosen by: Andrijana Škorput... / Escape to the Country - (S32, E17, zabavni program, Engleska, 2024) Emocije su na vrhuncu u Zapadnom Yorkshireu dok Nicki Chapman pomaže gospođi iz Hertfordshirea pronaći novi dom u prekrasnoj grofoviji u kojoj je odrasla. Ondje Nicki upoznaje i par koji se prije tri godine preselio iz Londona na prekrasnu staru farmu s čak dva i pol hektara zemlje. Odabrala: Andrijana Škorput...

programme.title: The most wonderful homes in the world / Najčudesniji domovi na svijetu
programme.desc: The Worlds Most Extraordinary Homes - (S02, E01, Education, England, 2018) Hosts Piers Taylor and Caroline Quentin will travel to Portugal in search of four extraordinary homes. This country is known for its great design and quality of workmanship, as well as for its modesty. The first house was located on the Portuguese Riviera, an exclusive area west of Lisbon. The second house is in Gateira, and the owners are Britons Neil and Shirley. The house was built in Penela, an agricultural area in the center of Portugal. From the outside it looks like an outbuilding, but behind the front door hides a modern home. The third house is among the dunes, and it was built in a pine forest near the Atlantic coast. "Casa Geres" is hidden in a national park in a mountainous forest area. R.: Will Hustler Ul.: Caroline Quentin (Self - Presenter), Piers Taylor (Self - Presenter), Marco Martínez Marinho (Self - Architect), Jose Guedes Cruz (Self - Architect), Vasco Matias Correia (Self - Architect)... / The Worlds Most Extraordinary Homes - (S02, E01, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2018) Voditelji Piers Taylor i Caroline Quentin otputovat će u Portugal u potrazi za četiri izvanredna doma. Ta je zemlja poznata kako po sjajnom dizajnu i kvaliteti izrade, tako i po skromnosti. Prva se kuća smjestila na portugalskoj rivijeri, ekskluzivnom području zapadno od Lisabona. Druga je kuća u Gateiri, a vlasnici su Britanci Neil i Shirley. Kuća je izgrađena u Peneli, poljoprivrednom području u središtu Portugala. Izvana izgleda kao gospodarska zgrada, a iza ulaznih se vrata skriva suvremeni dom. Treća je kuća među dinama, a izgrađena je u borovoj šumi u blizini atlantske obale. "Casa Geres" skrivena je u nacionalnom parku na planinskom šumskom području. R.: Will Hustler Ul.: Caroline Quentin (Self - Presenter), Piers Taylor (Self - Presenter), Marco Martínez Marinho (Self - Architect), Jose Guedes Cruz (Self - Architect), Vasco Matias Correia (Self - Architect)...

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsays Home Cooking - (E07, educational program, England, 2013) Gordon Ramsay is one of the world's most famous chefs, and his cooking style is twofold. He serves very complex dishes in restaurants, and at home he serves equally delicious, but simpler, faster and easier dishes. programme.title: Around the world by train / Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Around the World by Train with Tony Robinson - (S02, E03, nature film, England, 2019) Sir Tony Robinson has a mission to get to know and understand the shared history and culture of Mexico and the USA. He leaves the usual tourist paths and meets locals who reveal unexpected stories to him. From the Mexican desert to starry Los Angeles, he explores these fascinating parts of America by train. The journey begins with the El Chepe train on the west coast of Mexico through the spectacular Copper Canyon - larger and deeper than the Grand Canyon in the USA. There they will meet people who have lived in the canyon for generations. Then he takes the only passenger train in Mexico to the USA and on the way he will stop in the city of Chihuahua, where he will learn how he became prosperous and learn about the traditional drink "sotol", a northern Mexican type of tequila. They will have fun at the distillery tasting exotic varieties, including one with marijuana. Then he comes to the city that, thanks to the cartel wars, was once known as the most murderous city in the world, Juarez. Director: Michael Massey... / Around the World by Train with Tony Robinson - (S02, E03, prirod. film, Engleska, 2019) Sir Tony Robinson ima misiju upoznati i razumjeti zajedničku povijest i kulturu Meksika i SAD-a. Napušta uobičajene turističke staze i upoznaje domaće koji mu otkrivaju neočekivane priče. Od meksičke pustinje do zvjezdanog Los Angelesa, vlakom istražuje ove fascinantne dijelove Amerike. Putovanje počinje vlakom El Chepe na zapadnoj obali Meksika kroz spektakularni Bakreni kanjon - veći i dublji od Grand Canyona u SAD-u. Ondje će upoznati ljude koji u kanjonu žive naraštajima. Zatim jedinim putničkim vlakom u Meksiku kreće prema SAD-u i putem će stati u gradu Chihuahui gdje će doznati kako je postao prosperitetan i upoznati tradicionalno piće "sotol", sjevernomeksičku vrstu tekile. Zabavit će se u destileriji kušajući egzotične varijante, uključujući jednu s marihuanom. Zatim dolazi u grad koji je zahvaljujući ratovima kartela nekoć bio poznat kao grad s najviše ubojstava na svijetu, Juarez. R.: Michael Massey...

Edgerton), who has since started dropping by unannounced and bringing gifts. Simon began to be disturbed by this, but Robyn did not see any problem in it until she began to discover the truth about the relationship between the two men during school and to wonder how much we know the people we are close to... R.: Joel Edgerton St.: Jason Bateman (Simon), Rebecca Hall (Robyn), Joel Edgerton (Gordo), Allison Tolman (Lucy), Tim Griffin (Kevin KK Keelor)... / The Gift - (triler, SAD, 2015) Psihološki triler o neočekivanim darovima i mračnoj tajni koja je nakon dva desetljeća izašla na vidjelo. Kad je Simon (J. Bateman) promijenio posao, on i njegova žena Robyn (R. Hall) preselili su se iz Chicaga u predgrađe Los Angelesa. Dok su bili u kupovini, sreli su Simonovog školskog kolegu Gordona Moseleya, zvanog Gordo (J. Edgerton), koji je od tada počeo nenajavljeno svraćati k njima i donositi darove. Simona je to počelo uznemiravati, no Robyn u tome nije vidjela neki problem sve dok nije počela otkrivati istinu o odnosu dvojice muškaraca tijekom školovanja i pitati se koliko poznajemo ljude s kojima smo bliski... R.: Joel Edgerton Ul.: Jason Bateman (Simon), Rebecca Hall (Robyn), Joel Edgerton (Gordo), Allison Tolman (Lucy), Tim Griffin (Kevin KK Keelor)...

S obzirom na to da birokracija koči istragu, Manningova frustracija i nedostatak rezultata dosežu vrhunac pa on odlučuje hvatati krivine kako bi učinio kakav-takav pomak. Jenn ugrozi svoj odnos s obitelji Dawson nakon što se previše zbliži sa Steveom. Istodobno, Chris se mora suočiti i s prosvjetnom inspekcijom i s obiteljskim problemima. Nakon što se ispostavi da Cal ekipu neće odvesti do Hannina ubojice, Manning se nađe na udaru nadređenih, a istraga ponovno tapka na mjestu. R.: Waris Islam Ul.: Marsha Thomason (D.S. Jenn Townsend), Daniel Ryan (D.I. Tony Manning), Erin Shanagher (D.S. Karen Hobson), Andrew Dowbiggin (D.S. James Clarke), Barry Sloane (Chris Fischer)...

programme.title: Lewis / Lewis
programme.desc: Lewis - (S03, E01, crime series, England, 2009) Lewis investigates the gruesome murder of a young waitress after she leaves her professor's book launch. As Lewis and Hathaway delve deeper into the mystery of the crime, the line between fantasy and reality becomes ever thinner as the murder begins to mirror the content of the professor's books. R.: Bill Anderson St.: Kevin Whately (DI Robert Lewis), Laurence Fox (DS James Hathaway), Clare Holman (Dr. Laura Hobson), Rebecca Front (Ch. Supt. Innocent), Art Malik (Professor Hamid Jassim)... / Lewis - (S03, E01, krim. serija, Engleska, 2009) Lewis istražuje stravično ubojstvo mlade konobarice nakon što je napustila predstavljanje knjige svoga profesora. Kako Lewis i Hathaway poniru dublje u zagonetku zločina, granica između fantazije i stvarnosti postaje sve tanja jer ubojstvo počinje zrcaliti sadržaj profesorovih knjiga. programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S10, E21, comedy, USA, 2023) Once upon a time, not so long ago, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) used his parents' video camera to document life on the outskirts of the 1980s. He has his hands full, starting with well-meaning but stifling mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), to temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orrantia) and hypersensitive brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And then there is the unbelted grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when there are better things in life. Driving lessons, first jobs, college applications, and making new friends without losing old ones are all part of the Goldberg family saga. Some leave their childhood behind in search of their first kiss, others struggle with raising teenagers or, faced with aging, recall youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience it all. For better or for worse, they are always there for each other. R.: Lew Schneider St.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)... / The Goldbergs - (S10, E21, komedija, SAD, 2023) Jednom ne tako davno i ne tako daleko 11-godišnji Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) video-kamerom svojih roditelja dokumentira život na periferiji 1980-ih godina. Ima pune ruke posla, počevši od mame Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), koja je dobronamjerna, ali ga guši, preko temperamentnog tate Murrayja (Jeff Garlin), do buntovne starije sestre Erice (Hayley Orrantia) i hipersenzibilnog brata Barryja (Troy Gentile). A tu je i raspojasani djed (George Segal), zavodnik, koji je Adamu mentor kad su posrijedi ljepše stvari u životu. Satovi vožnje, prvi poslovi, prijave za fakultet i stjecanje novih prijatelja, a da se pritom ne izgube stari, sve je to dio sage o obitelji Goldberg. Neki ostavljaju djetinjstvo iza sebe u potrazi za prvim poljupcem, drugi pak muku muče s odgojem tinejdžera ili se, suočeni sa starenjem, prisjećaju mladenačkih strasti - obitelj Goldberg iskusit će sve to. I u dobru i u zlu, oni su uvijek tu jedni za druge. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La promesa - (S01, E01, TV series, Spain, 2023) Jana arrives at the magnificent palace of La Promesa on the day of the arranged marriage of Don Tomás, heir to the Luján family, and Jimena de los Infantes. Jana manages to get a job as a replacement for the fired maid who was helping with the wedding preparations. The first person she meets is the groom's younger brother, Don Manuel. Actually, Jana didn't come here by chance. She is looking for her mother's killer and her brother's kidnapper. Finding herself in a bind, Jana is forced to confide her plan to Tomás, and he thinks he knows who committed the crime... Director: Miguel Conde Street: Ana Garces (Jana Exposito), Eva Martín (Cruz Ezquerdo), Manuel Regueiro (Alonso Luján), Carmen Asecas (Catalina Luján), Jordi Coll (Tomás Luján)... / La promesa - (S01, E01, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2023) Jana dolazi u veličanstvenu palaču La Promesa na dan sklapanja ugovorenog braka Don Tomása, nasljednika obitelji Luján, i Jimene de los Infantes. Jana uspijeva dobiti posao kao zamjena za otpuštenu sluškinju koja je pomagala oko priprema za vjenčanje. Prva osoba koju susreće je mladoženjin mlađi brat, Don Manuel. Ustvari, Jana nije slučajno došla ovamo. Ona traga za ubojicom svoje majke i otmičarem svojega brata. Našavši se u škripcu, Jana je prisiljena povjeriti Tomásu svoj plan, a on misli da zna tko je taj zločin počinio... R.: Miguel Conde Ul.: Ana Garces (Jana Exposito), Eva Martín (Cruz Ezquerdo), Manuel Regueiro (Alonso Luján), Carmen Asecas (Catalina Luján), Jordi Coll (Tomás Luján)...

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Escape to the Country - (S32, E18, Entertainment, England, 2024) Three dogs and their two owners want to realize their dream of escaping to the country - from the bustling port city of Southampton to beautiful, rural Herefordshire. Denise Nurse is already ready and waiting for them with the keys to a selection of outstanding potential new homes... / Escape to the Country - (S32, E18, zabavni program, Engleska, 2024) Tri psa i njihova dva vlasnika žele ostvariti svoj san o bijegu na selo - iz užurbanog lučkog grada Southamptona u prekrasni, ruralni Herefordshire. Denise Nurse već je spremna i čeka ih s ključevima od odabranih izvanrednih potencijalnih novih domova...

programme.title: The most wonderful homes in the world / Najčudesniji domovi na svijetu
programme.desc: The Worlds Most Extraordinary Homes - (S02, E02, Education, England, 2017) Piers Taylor and Caroline Quentin will travel to Switzerland, where architecture is influenced by neighboring countries and dramatic nature. The house in Les Jeurs is built in the shadow of Mont Blanc at 1300 m above sea level in the Alps. It is a modern version of a traditional Swiss wooden house. The second house lies on the western shore of Lake Maggiore, in an area known for its warm climate and Italian influence. The third house is located near Zurich. The last house is a villa on the lake with a view of Firvaldštet Lake. Director: Emma Webster Ul.: Caroline Quentin (Self - Presenter), Piers Taylor (Self - Presenter), Simon Chessex (Self - Designer), Jerôme de Meuron (Self - Architect), Stefan Camenzind (Self - Architect)... / The Worlds Most Extraordinary Homes - (S02, E02, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2017) Piers Taylor i Caroline Quentin otputovat će u Švicarsku, u kojoj je arhitektura pod utjecajem susjednih zemalja i dramatične prirode. Kuća u Les Jeursu izgrađena je u sjeni Mont Blanca na 1300 m nadmorske visine u Alpama. Riječ je o modernoj inačici tradicionalne švicarske drvene kuće. Druga kuća leži na zapadnoj obali jezera Maggiore, na području poznatom po toploj klimi i talijanskom utjecaju. Treća se kuća smjestila nadomak Zuricha. Posljednja je kuća vila na jezeru s pogledom na Firvaldštetsko jezero. R.: Emma Webster Ul.: Caroline Quentin (Self - Presenter), Piers Taylor (Self - Presenter), Simon Chessex (Self - Designer), Jerôme de Meuron (Self - Architect), Stefan Camenzind (Self - Architect)...

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsays Home Cooking - (E08, educational program, England, 2013) Gordon Ramsay is one of the world's most famous chefs, and his cooking style is twofold. He serves very complex dishes in restaurants, and at home he serves equally delicious, but simpler, faster and easier dishes. In this culinary series dedicated to practical cooking at home, Gordon will teach us how to prepare fantastic meals for every day - for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Director: Paul Ratcliffe... / Gordon Ramsays Home Cooking - (E08, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2013) Gordon Ramsay jedan je od najslavnijih svjetskih kuhara, a njegov je način kuhanja dvojak. On u restoranima poslužuje vrlo složena jela, a kod kuće jednako slasna, ali jednostavnija, brža i lakša. U ovoj kulinarskoj seriji posvećenoj praktičnom kuhanju kod kuće, Gordon će nas poučiti pripremi fantastičnih jela za svaki dan - za doručak, ručak i večeru. R.: Paul Ratcliffe...

programme.title: Garden saviors / Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Garden Rescue - (S09, E05, entertainment magazine, England, 2024) Danni and Dawn decide to create a naughty wonderland for their five-year-old twins Ellie and Sofia. With a budget of £5,000 Charlie and Flo let their creative, playful imaginations run wild. Danni and Dawn moved into their newly built home four years ago. With two small children, the garden was not a priority for them. Now they have decided to transform that space and introduce twists instead of symmetry. Their goal is to create a magical place for Ellie and Sofia where the girls can explore, play hide and seek and build secret hiding places. In addition, they also want a place where the two of them can rest and relax in the shade. R.: Steve Peet Ul.: Charlie Dimmock (Self - Presenter), Flo Headlam (Self - Presenter), Lucinda Lawrence (Self - Narrator), Colin Anderson (Self - Landscape Contractors), Russell Harris (Self - Landscape Contractors)... / Garden Rescue - (S09, E05, zabavni magazin, Engleska, 2024) Danni i Dawn odlučile su stvoriti nestašnu zemlju čudesa za svoje petogodišnje blizanke Ellie i Sofiju. Uz budžet od 5000 funta Charlie i Flo puštaju na volju svojoj kreativnoj razigranoj mašti. Danni i Dawn uselile su se u svoj novoizgrađeni dom prije četiri godine. Uz dvoje male djece vrt im nije bio prioritetan. Sad su odlučile preobraziti taj prostor i u njega unijeti vijuge umjesto simetrije. Cilj im je stvoriti čarobno mjesto za Ellie i Sofiju gdje će curice moći istraživati, igrati se skrivača i graditi tajna skrovišta. Usto, također žele mjesto gdje će se njih dvije moći odmarati i opuštati u hladu. R.: Steve Peet Ul.: Charlie Dimmock (Self - Presenter), Flo Headlam (Self - Presenter), Lucinda Lawrence (Self - Narrator), Colin Anderson (Self - Landscape Contractors), Russell Harris (Self - Landscape Contractors)...

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue Leiths Cotswold Kitchen - (S02, E06, Education, England, 2025) Prue Leith, one of today's most famous chefs and pastry chefs, takes viewers into her kitchen! We have been watching this famous cook for years on the famous show "Good, Better, Best... British Pastry Chef", and now she will present recipes for all occasions in her Cotswold kitchen. The show will feature various celebrity guests as well as her husband John Playfair. Director: Sara Allen Street: Mark Lane (Self)... / Prue Leiths Cotswold Kitchen - (S02, E06, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2025) Prue Leith, jedna od najpoznatijih kuharica i slastičarki današnjice, vodi gledatelje u svoju kuhinju! Ovu slavnu kuharicu već godinama gledamo u slavnoj emisiji "Dobar, bolji, najbolji... britanski slastičar", a sada će nam u svojoj kuhinji u Cotswoldu predstaviti recepte za sve prilike. U emisiji će sudjelovati i razni slavni gosti kao i njezin muž John Playfair. R.: Sara Allen Ul.: Mark Lane (Self)...

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E11, doc series, Germany, 2023) The wild west of France is surrounded by the sea. Brittany, with its often stormy weather and harsh climate, has a peculiar charm. Inland are deep forests and hilly wasteland, on the coast rugged steep slopes with extremely unusual rock formations, and in between beaches with white sand similar to the Caribbean. No place is more than 80 km from the coast. Most Bretons live from the sea and with the sea... / Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E11, dok. serija, Njemačka, 2023) Surovi zapad Francuske okružen je morem. Bretanja s često olujnim vremenom i oštrom klimom ima osebujan šarm. U unutrašnjosti se prostiru duboke šume i brežuljkasta pustopoljina, na obali krševite strme padine s krajnje neobičnim formacijama stijena, a između toga plaže s bijelim pijeskom nalik na karipske. Nijedno mjesto nije udaljeno od obale više od 80 km. Većina Bretonaca živi od mora i s morem...
