programme.title: The world of science / Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: The world of science - (educational program, Croatia) The show brings current events, new scientific discoveries, interesting facts from the animal and plant world, and social phenomena. We will look into all the corners of the Earth, and we will not forget the rest of the universe either. We bring the serious, but also the more casual, fun side of science... / Svijet znanosti - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Emisija donosi aktualnosti, nova znanstvena otkrića, zanimljivosti iz životinjskog i biljnog svijeta te društvene fenomene. Zavirit ćemo u sve kutke Zemlje, a nećemo zaboraviti ni ostatak svemira. Donosimo ozbiljnu, ali i onu ležerniju, zabavnu stranu znanosti...

programme.title: Prometheus / Prometej
programme.desc: Prometej - (scientific popular series, Croatia) A weekly show about science, new knowledge and innovations that practically change our world, improving our everyday life, presents the professional and scientific achievements of our scientists in all scientific fields... / Prometej - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska) Tjedna emisija o znanosti, novim spoznajama i inovacijama koje praktično mijenjaju naš svijet poboljšavajući nam svakodnevicu, predstavlja stručna i znanstvena postignuća naših znanstvenika u svim znanstvenim područjima...

programme.title: Business plan / Poslovni plan
programme.desc: Business plan - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP trends, problems and growth generators... / Poslovni plan - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta...

programme.title: Coordination / Koordinacija
programme.desc: Coordination - (educational program, Croatia) Coordination is a specialized weekly show about construction that brings current topics and conversations with leading Croatian experts, scientists and engineers in an entertaining way. The name of the project derives from a customary term on the construction site when all participants in the construction of a building meet to coordinate current and future activities. Anta's garage, Notes, contributions, interviews, Tips and Tricks, Miljokaz, news - these are just some of the components of this show... / Koordinacija - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Koordinacija je specijalizirana tjedna emisija o građevinarstvu koja na zabavan način donosi aktualne teme i razgovore s vodećim hrvatskim stručnjacima, znanstvenicima i inženjerima. Ime projekta proizlazi iz uvriježenog termina na gradilištu kada se sastaju svi sudionici u izgradnji neke građevine da bi koordinirali trenutačne i buduće aktivnosti. Antina garaža, Notes, prilozi, intervjui, Tips and Tricksi, Miljokaz, vijesti - samo su neke od sastavnica ove emisije...

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina - (educational program, Croatia) Weekly show, brings short reports about the everyday life of Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina, follows the political scene there, events in the Croatian community, reminds us of the greats of Croatian culture, science and history... / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Tjedna emisija, donosi kratke reportaže o svakodnevici Hrvata u BiH, prati tamošnju političku scenu, događaje u hrvatskoj zajednici, podsjeća na velikane hrvatske kulture, znanosti i povijesti...

programme.title: Herb hunter / Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herb hunter - (S03, E05, doc. series, Croatia, 2021) The herb hunter visits the southernmost branch of Lička Plješivice - Poštak. The highest rounded peak on the northern ridge is Bijeli vrh, 1446 meters high. From a distance, it stands out because of the steep, almost cut-off slope below the peak. In addition to the wide vistas, it is interesting as a hiker because of the natural park of unusual stone sculptures on the grassy slope next to the marked trail, at an altitude of 1,200 meters. Some of the plants in this episode are small cacti, narrow-leaved lungwort, stout gorse, bearberry, large sasa, and medicinal primrose. The guests of the episode are Gradimira Bumbak, vice president of HPD Kamenar from Šibenik, and Vesna Bogunović, a lover of plants. Director: Filip Filković... / Lovac na bilje - (S03, E05, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2021) Lovac na bilje posjećuje najjužniji ogranak Ličke Plješivice - Poštak. Najviši zaobljeni vrh na sjevernom grebenu je Bijeli vrh, visok 1446 metara. Iz daljine se posebno ističe po strmoj, gotovo odsječenoj padini ispod vrha. Osim zbog širokih vidika planinarski je zanimljiv zbog prirodnog parka neobičnih kamenih skulptura na travnatoj padini pokraj markirane staze, na visini od 1200 metara. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su mali kaćun, uskolisni plućnjak, čvrsta šupaljka, medvjedka, velika sasa i ljekoviti jaglac. Gosti epizode su Gradimira Bumbak, potpredsjednica HPD Kamenar iz Šibenika te Vesna Bogunović, zaljubljenica u bilje. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: Hit of the day / Hit dana
programme.desc: Hit of the day - (musical video clip, Croatia, 2025) In Hit of the Day every weekday the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers... / Hit dana - (glazb. videoisječak, Hrvatska, 2025) U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača...

programme.title: Around the world by train / Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Around the World by Train with Tony Robinson - (S02, E04, natural film, England, 2020) Sir Tony Robinson will take a train into the unknown traveling from Canada to Alaska. He looks forward to meeting Canadians and exploring the great wilderness in this part of the world, from the Rocky Mountains to the beautiful glaciers of Alaska. The journey begins in the high-tech city of Seattle, home to Amazon, Microsoft and Starbucks. The Amtrack Cascades train will take him across the border into Canada where he will be immediately surprised by the beauty of Vancouver and the warmth of Canadians. Director: Michael Massey Street: Dave Babych (Self)... / Around the World by Train with Tony Robinson - (S02, E04, prirod. film, Engleska, 2020) Sir Tony Robinson će se vlakom zaputiti u nepoznato putujući iz Kanade u Aljasku. Veseli se upoznavanju Kanađana i istraživanju velike divljine u ovom dijelu svijeta, od planina Stjenjaka do prelijepih glečera Aljaske. Putovanje počinje u gradu visoke tehnologije Seattleu gdje sjedišta imaju Amazon, Microsoft i Starbucks. Vlak Amtrack Cascades prevest će ga preko granice u Kanadu gdje će ga odmah iznenaditi ljepota Vancouvera i toplina Kanađana. R.: Michael Massey Ul.: Dave Babych (Self)...

programme.title: The trap of social networks - five women against five major platforms / Zamka društvenih mreža - pet žena protiv pet velikih platformi
programme.desc: Emprise numerique, 5 femmes contre les Big 5 - (documentary film, France, 2025) Adolescents who spend more than five hours a day on their smartphones are 66% more likely to develop suicidal tendencies than those who use them for up to one hour a day. 44 US states are currently suing Meta, blaming the company for making an entire generation sick. Faced with powerful tech giants like Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X and Discord, how can we possibly protect children and their childhoods? For the first time in history, state legislators and parents in the US and Europe are joining forces to fight the digital giants. Among them are five women who decided to turn their everyday lives upside down to fight against five major platforms. Alexis, Elisabet, Sofia, Laure and Socheata. They are victims, mothers, doctors and lawyers. They are all behind a movement whose goal is to change the fate of future generations. Alexis, a victim of screen addiction, was among the first to sue Meta, accusing her of "inciting suicide." Elisabet is a mother of three children, and in just a few days more than 10,000 parents joined her WhatsApp group in the fight for "youth without mobile phones". As a result, the state banned smartphones in schools. Sofia is a psychiatrist and a pioneer in the treatment of screen addiction in children, some of whom are as young as seven years old. Socheata joined the fight when her son found himself under the manipulation of an internet predator. She joined the association and, together with police officers specializing in cybercrime, catches pedophiles. Laure is a lawyer determined to change the laws that protect the Big Five. Through the difficulties these women face, we will discover how digital control is a major public health and safety problem that exceeds the limits of our expectations. Director: Elisa Jadot... / Emprise numerique, 5 femmes contre les Big 5 - (dok. film, Francuska, 2025) Adolescenti koji za svojim pametnim telefonima provode više od pet sati na dan imaju 66 % više izgleda da će razviti suicidalne sklonosti negoli oni koji se njima koriste do jednog sata na dan. 44 američke savezne države trenutačne tuže Metu, okrivljujući kompaniju za pobolijevanje cijele generacije. Suočeni s moćnim tehnološkim divovima poput Mete, TikToka, Snapchata, X-a i Discorda, kako uopće možemo zaštititi djecu i njihovo djetinjstvo? Prvi put u povijesti državni zakonodavci i roditelji u SAD-u i Europi udružuju snage u borbi protiv digitalnih divova. Među njima je pet žena koje su odlučile preokrenuti svoj svakodnevni život naglavačke kako bi krenule u borbu protiv pet velikih platformi. Alexis, Elisabet, Sofia, Laure i Socheata. One su žrtve, majke, liječnice i odvjetnice. Sve stoje iza pokreta kojem je cilj promijeniti sudbinu budućih naraštaja. Alexis, žrtva ovisnosti o ekranu, bila je među prvima koji su tužili Metu, optužujući je za "poticanje na samoubojstvo". Elisabet je majka troje djece, a u samo nekoliko dana više od 10.000 roditelja pridružilo se njezinoj WhatsApp grupi u borbi za "mladost bez mobitela". Kao rezultat toga, država je zabranila pametne telefone u školama. Sofia je psihijatrica i pionirka u liječenju ovisnosti o ekranu kod djece, od kojih neki imaju samo sedam godina. Socheata se pridružila borbi kad se njezin sin našao pod manipulacijom internetskog predatora. Priključila se udruženju i zajedno s policajcima specijaliziranim za kibernetički kriminal hvata pedofile. Laure je odvjetnica odlučna u tome da promijeni zakone koji štite velikih pet. Kroz poteškoće s kojima se susreću ove žena otkrit ćemo kako je digitalna kontrola veliki problem javnog zdravstva i sigurnosti koji prelazi granice naših očekivanja. R.: Elisa Jadot...

programme.title: In the mafia den / U mafijaškoj jazbini
programme.desc: Inside Man - (film, USA, 2023) After a personal and professional downfall, police officer Bobby Bellucci infiltrates a mafia network connected to the notorious club Gemini Lounge. As he tries to expose the gang from the inside, he sinks deeper and deeper into a world of violence and betrayal. Although the policeman's character is fictional, the plot is based on the real-life Roy DeMeo mafia group that operated in Brooklyn in the 1970s and 1980s, and the club is, according to the FBI, the site of numerous murders linked to the Gambino family. R.: Danny A. Abeckaser St.: Emile Hirsch (Bobby Belucci), Lucy Hale (Gina Tucci), Jake Cannavale (Chris Rosenberg), Ashley Greene (Mary Belucci), Robert Davi (Anthony Nino Gaggi)... / Inside Man - (film, SAD, 2023) Nakon osobnog i profesionalnog pada, policajac Bobbyj Belucci infiltrira se u mafijašku mrežu povezanu s ozloglašenim klubom Gemini Lounge. Dok pokušava razotkriti bandu iznutra, sve dublje tone u svijet nasilja i izdaje. Iako je lik policajca fiktivan, radnja se temelji na stvarnoj mafijaškoj grupi Roya DeMea koja je djelovala u Brooklynu 1970-tih i 1980-tih, a klub je, prema FBI-ju, mjesto brojnih ubojstava povezanih s obitelji Gambino. R.: Danny A. Abeckaser Ul.: Emile Hirsch (Bobby Belucci), Lucy Hale (Gina Tucci), Jake Cannavale (Chris Rosenberg), Ashley Greene (Mary Belucci), Robert Davi (Anthony Nino Gaggi)...

programme.title: Bay / Zaljev
programme.desc: The Bay - (S05, E05, drama series, England, 2024) In the Serious Crimes Department, everything changes when a new commander takes over. She is more direct than Manning, so the team has a hard time adapting to the new way of working, but is forced to accept the new situation in order to find new clues in Hanna's case. Erin gets stuck at work due to a misjudgment, and Jenn has to choose between family and the police, which ultimately leaves Chris very disappointed. Jenn loses Julie's trust after she arrests Craig. With the pressure mounting, Jenna's grief over her father's death suddenly comes to light, affecting her entire family. R.: Waris Islam Ul.: Marsha Thomason (D.S. Jenn Townsend), Daniel Ryan (D.I. Tony Manning), Erin Shanagher (D.S. Karen Hobson), Andrew Dowbiggin (D.S. James Clarke), Barry Sloane (Chris Fischer)... / The Bay - (S05, E05, igrana serija, Engleska, 2024) U Odjelu teških zločina sve se mijenja kad na čelo dođe nova zapovjednica. Izravnija je od Manninga pa se ekipa teško prilagođava novom načinu rada, no primorana je prihvatiti novonastalu situaciju kako bi došla do novih tragova u Hanninu slučaju. Erin zbog pogrešne procjene zaglibi na poslu pa Jenn mora birati između obitelji i policije, zbog čega se Chris naposljetku itekako razočara. Jenn gubi Julieno povjerenje nakon što uhiti Craiga. S obzirom na to da pritisak sve više raste, Jennina tuga zbog očeve smrti iznenada izađe na vidjelo, što utječe na cijelu njezinu obitelj. R.: Waris Islam Ul.: Marsha Thomason (D.S. Jenn Townsend), Daniel Ryan (D.I. Tony Manning), Erin Shanagher (D.S. Karen Hobson), Andrew Dowbiggin (D.S. James Clarke), Barry Sloane (Chris Fischer)...

programme.title: Yinniang killer / Ubojica Yinniang
programme.desc: Ci ke Nie Yin Niang - (drama, Hong Kong, 2015) The film is partially based on Pei Xing's short story "Nie Yinniang" about the adventures of a Chinese martial arts master and excellent swordsman from the end of the seventh century. The film is set in China during the Zhenyuan period (785-805) during the reign of the Tang Dynasty, a few years after the uprising led by An Lushan (755-763). Weibo Province, although formally part of the Empire, is ruled by General Tian Jian. It centers on Nie Yinniang, an assassin who is ordered to kill corrupt government officials by her mistress, the nun Jiaxin, who has raised her since she was ten years old. When Yinniang spares their lives, Jiaxin decides to punish her cruelly and test her loyalty at the same time. He sends her to kill the ruler of the distant province of Weibo in northern China, her cousin Tian Jian, to whom she was promised as a child. R.: Hsiao-hsien Hou Ul.: Chen Chang (Tian Jian, governor of Weibo), Qi Shu (Nie Yinniang), Yun Zhou (Lady Tian), Satoshi Tsumabuki (The Mirror Polisher), Nikki Hsieh (Huji,Tian Jians concubine)... / Ci ke Nie Yin Niang - (drama, Hong Kong, 2015) Film se djelomično temelji na kratkoj priči Pei Xinga "Nie Yinniang" o pustolovinama kineske majstorice borilačkih vještina i vrsne mačevaokinje s kraja sedmog stoljeća. Radnja filma smještena je u Kinu tijekom razdoblja Zhenyuan (785.-805.) za vrijeme vladavine dinastije Tang, nekoliko godina nakon ustanka pod vodstvom An Lushana (755.-763.). Provincijom Weibo, iako je formalno dio Carstva, upravlja general Tian Jian. U središtu je radnje Nie Yinniang, ubojica kojoj njezina gospodarica, redovnica Jiaxin, koja ju je odgajala od njezine desete godine, naređuje da ubije korumpirane vladine dužnosnike. Kad im Yinniang poštedi život, Jiaxin je odluči okrutno kazniti i ujedno testirati njezinu lojalnost. Pošalje je da ubije upravitelja daleke provincije Weibo na sjeveru Kine, njezinog rođaka Tian Jiana, kojem je bila obećana kao dijete. R.: Hsiao-hsien Hou Ul.: Chen Chang (Tian Jian, governor of Weibo), Qi Shu (Nie Yinniang), Yun Zhou (Lady Tian), Satoshi Tsumabuki (The Mirror Polisher), Nikki Hsieh (Huji,Tian Jians concubine)...

programme.title: Acoustic Project: Furious Dance, Lauba / Acoustic Project: Furious Dance, Lauba
programme.desc: Acoustic Project: Furious Dance, Lauba - (show magazine, Croatia, 2022) In 2012, the Acoustic Project ensemble released its first CD entitled Acoustic Project, which was nominated for the Croatian discography award "Porin" in the same year. In the continuity of activity, this group of great musicians boldly faces various challenges without refraining from musical experiments, always striving to reach new and as yet unexplored "landscapes of music". According to the opinion of the audience and professional critics, the ensemble made a leap into new musical expanses by introducing into classical music some contemporary, innovative formal structures and instrumentation procedures different from the established ones, and thereby not only brought it closer to other musical styles, but also made it more accessible to an audience that is open to new challenges and eager for new perspectives and exciting and still unexplored musical expanses... / Acoustic Project: Furious Dance, Lauba - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2022) Godine 2012. ansambl Acoustic Project objavljuje svoj prvi CD pod nazivom Acoustic Project, koji je iste godine nominiran i za hrvatsku diskografsku nagradu "Porin". U kontinuitetu djelovanja ovaj sastav sjajnih glazbenika smjelo se suočava s raznim izazovima ne prežući niti od glazbenih eksperimenata, uvijek nastojeći doprijeti do novih i još neistraženih "predjela glazbe". Ansambl je po mišljenju publike i stručne kritike napravio iskorak u nova glazbena prostranstva uvođenjem u klasičnu glazbu nekih suvremenih, inovativnih formalnih struktura i instrumentacijskih postupaka drugačijih od onih uvriježenih te ju je time ne samo približio drugim glazbenim stilovima, nego učinio i pristupačnijom publici koja je otvorena za nove izazove te željna novih vidika i uzbudljivih i još neistraženih glazbenih prostranstava...

programme.title: Great shipwrecks of the Adriatic / Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: Great shipwrecks of the Adriatic - (E06, doc. series, Croatia, 2007) At the beginning of June 1866, Italy declared war on Austria, deciding to take control of the island of Vis, a key point for the control of the entire Adriatic. After several days of cruising around Vis and bombarding Austrian positions, the Italian fleet decides to conquer the island by landing. However, at dawn on June 20, an Austrian squadron arrived at Vis and a great naval battle began. With a deft maneuver, the Austrian ship sank the Italian admiral ship, the battleship Re d'Italia, and the battle ended very quickly. Legend has it that Re d'Italia was transporting gold coins worth several million euros intended for the establishment of Italian rule on Vis and in Dalmatia. Therefore, the search for the location of the sinking of the Re d'Italie continued for more than a hundred years, until a special Croatian-French expedition found it in May 2005. The last episode of Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic brings a successful search for the location of the Battle of Vis, as well as the reconstruction of that battle, one of the most famous naval battles on the Adriatic. Director: Davor Šarić... / Veliki brodolomi Jadrana - (E06, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2007) Početkom lipnja 1866. Italija je objavila rat Austriji, odlučivši od nje preuzeti nadzor nad otokom Visom, ključnom točkom za nadzor cijelog Jadrana. Nakon nekoliko dana krstarenja oko Visa i bombardiranja austrijskih položaja talijanska flota odlučuje osvojiti otok iskrcavanjem. No, u zoru 20. lipnja do Visa stiže austrijska eskadra i započinje velika pomorska bitka. Spretnim manevrom austrijski brod potopio je talijanski admiralski brod, oklopnjaču Re dItalia, te je bitka okončana vrlo brzo. Legenda govori da je Re dItalia prevozila zlatnike vrijedne nekoliko milijuna eura namijenjene uspostavi talijanske vlasti na Visu i u Dalmaciji. Stoga se više od stotinu godina odvijala potraga za lokacijom potonuća Re dItalie, sve dok je u svibnju 2005. ne pronalazi posebna hrvatsko-francuska ekspedicija. Posljednja epizoda Velikih brodoloma Jadrana donosi uspješnu potragu za lokacijom Viške bitke, ali i rekonstrukciju te bitke, jedne od najpoznatijih pomorskih bitaka na Jadranu. R.: Davor Šarić...

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: Notes on language - (educational program, Croatia) Etymology is a branch of linguistics that studies the origin of words. In our country it is also called prehistory. Academician Ranko Matasović tells us about the beginnings of research into the origin of words, about our commonality with other languages ​​of the Indo-European group, about why the words brother, frater, brother have the same origin. We also learn how the origin of words that are difficult to determine where they come from, for example the word sedge, raga, etc., is shed light on. R.: Goran Ribarić... / Bilješke o jeziku - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Etimologija je grana lingvistike koja proučava podrijetlo riječi. U nas se zove i iskonoslovlje. Akademik Ranko Matasović govori nam o počecima istraživanja podrijetla riječi, o našem zajedništvu s ostalim jezicima indoeuropske skupine, o tome zašto su riječi brat, frater, bhrata istog podrijetla. Saznajemo i kako se rasvjetljava podrijetlo riječi kojima je teško utvrditi od kuda dolaze, primjerice riječ šaš, raga, i sl. R.: Goran Ribarić...

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: Juhuhu - (children's program, Croatia) JUHUHU is a children's morning program that includes cartoons, domestic and foreign shows for children of early school and kindergarten age. Through the morning and cheerful content, the Juhuhu people are led by actor-hosts who are there to tell a story, be a company for morning exercise, brush their teeth with a magical Juhuhu toothbrush or to teach their viewers some new, so far unknown things about the universe, chickens, sheep, refrigerators, trumpets, cabbage, broccoli and the secrets of Juhuhu plushies. Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: Sound collector / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: The Collector of Sounds - (E54, feature series, Croatia) Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called "The Collector of Sounds", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he has very poor hearing. This little being spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are most often the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle... / Skupljač zvukova - (E54, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte...

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: PAW Patrol - (S09, E09, animated series, USA, 2021) The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. Each dog has special skills associated with emergency service professions, so members of the family include a firefighter, a policeman and an airman. They all live in doghouses that transform into vehicles adapted to their tasks. They are also equipped with special "dog backpacks" in which they carry all the tools needed for "dog jobs". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Nylan Parthipan (Al), Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Christian Corrao (Marshall), Lucien Duncan Reid (Rubble), Kai Harris (Ryder)... / PAW Patrol - (S09, E09, anim. serija, SAD, 2021) Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay. Svaki pas ima posebne vještine povezane s profesijama hitne službe, pa su članovi družine vatrogasac, policajac i zrakoplovac. Svi žive u psećim kućicama koje se preoblikuju u vozila prilagođena njihovim zadacima. Također su opremljeni posebnim "psećim ruksacima" u kojima nose sve alate potrebne za "pseće poslove". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Nylan Parthipan (Al), Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Christian Corrao (Marshall), Lucien Duncan Reid (Rubble), Kai Harris (Ryder)...

programme.title: It's time for Timi / Vrijeme je za Timija
programme.desc: Timmy Time - (S02, E06, animated series, England, 2009) The animated British children's series follows the adventures of a little troubled lamb and his friends. Timmy goes to kindergarten in the hills where teacher Harriet and teacher Osbourne teach him how to be a good friend and how to share with friends. In addition, it is important that students accept their mistakes and learn something from them. Join Timmy and his friends - Yabba the duck, Paxton the pig and Mittens the kitten as they sing, play and laugh. Director: Liz Whitaker... / Timmy Time - (S02, E06, anim. serija, Engleska, 2009) Animirana britanska dječja serija prati avanture malog problematičnog janjeta i njegovih prijatelja. Timmy ide u vrtić u brdima gdje ga učiteljica Harriet i učitelj Osbourne uče kako da bude dobar prijatelj te kako s prijateljima treba dijeliti. Osim toga važno je da učenici prihvaćaju svoje pogreške i na njima nešto nauče. Pridružite se Timmyju i njegovim prijateljima - patki Yabbi, praščiću Paxtonu i mačiću Mittensu u njihovoj pjesmi, igri i smijehu. R.: Liz Whitaker...

programme.title: Kreki / Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki - (children's program, Croatia) Krceki are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game are also waiting for you!... / Krceki - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!...

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Krceki - song - (E26, children's program, Croatia, 2023) In addition to the animated series Krceki, we also get seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramezljlko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the series Krceki... / Krceki - pjesmica - (E26, dječji program, Hrvatska, 2023) Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki...

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu and The Bally Bunch - (E15, cartoon series, Ireland, 2023) Lu is a little ladybug who has just started preschool with her new friends, and is entering a completely new social life. This animated dramedy for preschoolers takes place in Bubingrad, a small village that is home to a community of bugs. Lu's teacher Mila is a snail, and Lu goes to school in a house on her back. Lu and her new friends, Branimir, Biba, Damir, Elica and Maks, build their first friendships and at the same time learn social skills in order to navigate them! The series explores the fun, drama and mishaps that come from the lives of preschoolers. Filled with music, humor and heart, Lu and the merry band celebrate their friendships. Director: Nicky Phelan Street: Freya Mclaughlin (Lu), Aileen Mythen (Shella), Alice Helenport (Elodie), Kolby McDonald (Gus), Joy Tú Clarke (Biba)... / Lu and The Bally Bunch - (E15, crt. serija, Irska, 2023) Lu je mala bubamara koja je upravo krenula u predškolu sa svojim novim prijateljima, te ulazi u sasvim novi društveni život. Ova animirana dramedija za predškolarce događa se u Bubingradu, malom selu koje je dom zajednici buba. Luina učiteljica Mila je puž, te Lu odlazi u školu u kućici na njezinim leđima. Lu i njezini novi prijatelji, Branimir, Biba, Damir, Elica i Maks, grade svoja prva prijateljstva te usto uče društvene vještine kako bi se u njima snašli! Serija istražuje zabavu, dramu i nezgode koje proizlaze iz života predškolaraca. Ispunjeni glazbom, humorom i srcem, Lu i vesela družina slave svoja prijateljstva. R.: Nicky Phelan Ul.: Freya Mclaughlin (Lu), Aileen Mythen (Shella), Alice Helenport (Elodie), Kolby McDonald (Gus), Joy Tú Clarke (Biba)...

programme.title: Hi Day / Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Hey Duggee - (S03, E11, cartoon series, England) Get ready for laughter, learning and exciting activities in an adventure-filled club that every child will want to join! Meet Duggee, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages kids to have fun, be full of energy and most of all, do anything! Each episode of this colorful, fun and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Duggee welcoming the Chipmunks, a group of little curios left at the club by their parents. Then there's laughter and learning as the Chipmunks discover something new about the world around them, and Duggee watches over them patiently. Their adventures are often funny and comical, which will certainly attract young viewers (as well as adults) and encourage them to solve problems actively and on the move, running and jumping. Duggee rewards club members with an activity badge each time, which they proudly show off to the parents who pick them up at the end of each episode. Introducing... Squirrels! Piko, a small and good-natured rhinoceros, a gentle soul who often gets lost in the things around him! Betty, a cheerful octopus who loves to read and is very intelligent, wants to be the first to answer every question. Vrcko, a hyperactive hippopotamus who approaches everything with enthusiasm, is loud and doesn't like listening. Lucky, a small, happy and undemanding crocodile, will use every opportunity to get wet. Nora, thoughtful and smart muscle, is sensitive, curious and gentle. R.: Grant Orchard St.: Alexander Armstrong (Narrator), Jasmine Bartholomew (Betty), Alfie Sanderson (Tag), Poppy Boyes (Norrie), Duke Davis (Happy)... / Hey Duggee - (S03, E11, crt. serija, Engleska) Pripremite se na smijeh, učenje i uzbudljive aktivnosti u klubu punom pustolovina kojem će se svako dijete htjeti pridružiti! Upoznajte Duggeeja, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i više od svega, da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene, zabavne i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Duggee dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Duggee strpljivo pazi na njih. Njihove pustolovine često su šaljive i komične, što će zasigurno privući mlade gledatelje (ali i odrasle) i potaknuti ih da probleme rješavaju aktivno i u pokretu, trčeći i poskakujući. Duggee svaki put članove kluba nagradi značkom za aktivnost, što oni ponosno pokazuju roditeljima koji dođu po njih na kraju svake epizode. Predstavljamo... Vjeverice! Piko, malen i dobrodušan nosorog, nježna duša koja se često zalijeće u stvari oko sebe! Beti, vesela hobotnica koja voli čitati i vrlo je inteligentna, želi odgovoriti prva na svako pitanje. Vrcko, hiperaktivan vodenkonj koji svemu pristupa s oduševljenjem, glasan je i ne ide mu slušanje. Srećko, malen, sretan i nezahtjevan krokodil, iskoristit će svaku priliku da se smoči. Nora, zamišljena i pametna mišica, osjećajna je, radoznala i nježna. R.: Grant Orchard Ul.: Alexander Armstrong (Narator), Jasmine Bartholomew (Betty), Alfie Sanderson (Tag), Poppy Boyes (Norrie), Duke Davis (Happy)...

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E03, TV series, Australia) Bluey is an adorable and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E03, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E14, feature series, England, 2024) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E14, igrana serija, Engleska, 2024) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu - (S01, E22, cartoon series, Croatia, 2022) Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. They live in a village that has a train station. In it, in each sequel, they welcome travelers from different countries: Japan, France, Australia... From each of them they learn something about the world they don't know and because of that they become smarter and better. Director: Vjekoslav Živković... / Hu Hu - (S01, E22, crt. serija, Hrvatska, 2022) Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško. Oni žive u selu koje ima željezničku stanicu. U njoj u svakom nastavku dočekuju putnike iz različitih zemalja: Japana, Francuske, Australije... Od svakog od njih oni nešto nauče o svijetu koji ne poznaju i zbog čega postaju pametniji i bolji. R.: Vjekoslav Živković...

programme.title: Hu Hu song / Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu song - (children's program, Croatia) Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško...

programme.title: Oggy Oggy / Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy - (S01, E23, feature series, France, 2021) Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated preschool series by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri, The series follows Oggy the kitten who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys... / Oggy Oggy - (S01, E23, igrana serija, Francuska, 2021) Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka...

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Numberblocks - (S01, E29, drama series, England) The series "Number Blocks" follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily... / Numberblocks - (S01, E29, igrana serija, Engleska) Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke...

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Pig - (S02, E49, feature series, England) "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human traits, and there are also her family and friends. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother George, their parents and the other animal families that live in their town. Each family represents a different animal species, so Peppa's friends are the rabbit Rebecca, the sheep Suzy and the cat Candy. In each episode, the cheerful group experiences new adventures, and the plot often helps children cope with new feelings and experiences that come with growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human characteristics. Along with her, there are her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her own age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plots of the episodes are related to the children's daily activities - going to kindergarten, swimming, visiting grandparents or other relatives, playing on the playground or riding bicycles. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in houses and drive cars, but they also show some characteristics of the animals on which they are based. R.: Mark Baker St.: John Sparkes (Narrator)... / Peppa Pig - (S02, E49, igrana serija, Engleska) "Praščić Peppa" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s mnogo ljudskih osobina, a tu su još i njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georgea, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu. Svaka obitelj predstavlja drugu životinjsku vrstu pa su tako Peppini prijatelji zečica Rebecca, ovca Suzy i mačka Candy. U svakoj epizodi vesela družina doživljava nove avanture, a radnja često pomaže djeci da se nose s novim osjećajima i iskustvima koje sa sobom donosi odrastanje. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s puno ljudskih osobina. Uz nju, tu su još njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Peppini prijatelji su njezinih godina, dok su prijatelji njezinog mlađeg brata njegovi vršnjaci. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. Likovi u seriji nose odjeću, žive u kućama i voze automobile, no pokazuju i neke osobine onih životinja na kojima su temeljeni. R.: Mark Baker Ul.: John Sparkes (Narator)...

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E21, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with the vitality of childhood. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. Director: Julien Cayot Street: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)... / Simon - (S02, E21, igrana serija, Francuska) Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. R.: Julien Cayot Ul.: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)...

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: 123 Number Squad - (E36, drama series, Singapore, 2021) Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. R.: Yvonne Ng Yuwen Ul.: Amir El Ghouch (Numero / Tim), Archie Fletcher (Billy), Lois Sefton (Paula)... / 123 Number Squad - (E36, igrana serija, Singapur, 2021) Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: Love Monster - (E02, cartoon series, England, 2020) Follow the unforgettable adventures of this little monster who lives in a town full of cute little animals. The love monster may not look like the others, but despite that, his friends love him and go on crazy adventures with him. Dir.: Rufus Blacklock Ul.: Tamsin Greig (Narrator), Lewis Macleod ((Voice)), George Takei (Elder Panda), Sarah Hadland, Emma Maclennan... / Love Monster - (E02, crt. serija, Engleska, 2020) Pratite nezaboravne avanture ovog malenog čudovišta koje živi u gradu prepunom mali slatkih životinjica. Ljubavno čudovište možda ne izgleda kao ostali, ali usprkos tome njegovi ga prijatelji vole i odlaze s njim na lude pustolovine. programme.title: Bitz i Bob / Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bob - (E41, feature series, England, 2018) In the children's series Bitz and Bob, we follow the adventures of the girl inventor Bitz and her younger brother Bob. She embodies the new strong girl and is fascinated by all innovative things and activities related to science, technology, art and mathematics. The goal of this series is to encourage girls and boys to do their own research, to be ambitious and to come up with different ways to solve any problem. R.: Angela Russel Ul.: Hans-Heinrich Hunnebeck (Bob), Sven Fechner (Bevel), Sarah Alles (Fleur), IT (Zip and Pop)... / Bitz and Bob - (E41, igrana serija, Engleska, 2018) U dječjoj seriji Bitz i Bob pratimo dogodovštine djevojčice izumiteljice Bitz i njezinog mlađeg brata Boba. Ona utjelovljuje novu snažnu djevojku i fasciniraju je sve inovativne stvari i aktivnosti vezane za znanost, tehnologiju, umjetnost i matematiku. Cilj ove serije je poticanje djevojčica i dječaka da sami istražuju, da budu ambiciozni i osmišljavaju razne načine s ciljem da riješe bilo koji problem. R.: Angela Russel Ul.: Hans-Heinrich Hunnebeck (Bob), Sven Fechner (Bevel), Sarah Alles (Fleur), IT (Zip and Pop)...

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: Dino Ranch - (S02, E34, Drama, Canada, 2022) Tango and Miguel need to bale hay and load it into the stegosaur barn, but just then Tango's best friend Aroo arrives for a visit with her wild herd of triceratops. Miguel lets Tango take a short break and play with Aroo, but when he needs help, Tango gets so carried away that he forgets to come back. Miguel tries to load hay into the barn by himself, but soon finds himself stuck at the end of the dino crane! When Tango realizes she's been neglecting Miguel, she and Aroo rush to his aid, and before all three can have fun, they help him finish the hay job. R.: Bill Speers Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)... / Dino Ranch - (S02, E34, igrana serija, Kanada, 2022) Tango i Miguel trebaju balirati sijeno i utovariti ga u staju stegosaura, ali baš tada u posjet stiže Tangina najbolja prijateljica Aroo sa svojim divljim stadom triceratopsa. Miguel dopušta Tango da napravi kratki predah i poigra se s Aroo, ali kad mu zatreba pomoć, Tango se toliko zaigra da se zaboravi vratiti. Miguel pokušava sam utovariti sijeno u staju, no ubrzo se nađe zaglavljen na kraju dinodizalice! Kad Tango shvati da je zanemarila Miguela, ona i Aroo pohitaju mu u pomoć, a prije nego što se svo troje može zabavljati, pomognu mu dovršiti posao sa sijenom. R.: Bill Speers Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)...

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: The Furchester Hotel - (S03, E11, Drama, England) Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (a BBC pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel... / The Furchester Hotel - (S03, E11, igrana serija, Engleska) Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela...

programme.title: The song GREEN / Pjesmica ZELENA
programme.desc: Pjesmica ZELENA - (children's program, Croatia) We bring fun and educational musical moments that your little ones will endlessly enjoy!... / Pjesmica ZELENA - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Donosimo zabavne i edukativne glazbene trenutke u kojima će vaši najmlađi beskrajno uživati!...

programme.title: Daniel the tiger's neighborhood / Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: Daniel Tigers Neighborhood - (S02, E21, Drama, USA) "Daniel Tigers Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." The series tells inspiring stories about the lives of preschoolers, using musical strategies rooted in Fred Rogers' famous social-emotional learning. Through imagination, creativity and music, Daniel and his friends learn important social skills, necessary for school and life. The main character of the series is Tigrić Daniel (son of Mama Tigrica and Papa Tigra). Along with him, the series also features other children, characters from the Neighborhood of Imagination, such as Maca Katarina (daughter of Maca Henrietta), Miss Elena (daughter of Lady Elena Fairchilda and Niko Musician), Owl O (nephew of Owl X) and Prince Wednesday (youngest son of King Friday and Queen Saturday, younger brother of Prince Tuesday). Each episode consists of two parts connected by a common social-emotional theme, such as disappointment and sadness or anger and gratitude. Each of the stories is accompanied by appropriate musical numbers, in order to bring the theme and different life situations as close as possible to the youngest viewers. Street: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)... / Daniel Tigers Neighborhood - (S02, E21, igrana serija, SAD) "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa". Serija pripovijeda poticajne priče o životu predškolske djece, služeći se glazbenim strategijama ukorijenjenim u poznatom socijalno-emotivnom učenju Freda Rogersa. Kroz maštu, kreativnost i glazbu, Daniel i njegovi prijatelji uče važne društvene vještine, neophodne za školu i život. Glavni lik serije je Tigrić Daniel (sin Mame Tigrice i Tate Tigra). Uz njega, u seriji se također pojavljuju druga djeca, likovi iz Susjedstva Mašte, kao što su Maca Katarina (kći Mace Henrijete), gospođica Elena (kći ledi Elene Fairchilde i Nika Glazbenika), Sova O (nećak Sove X) i Princ Srijeda (najmlađi sin Kralja Petka i Kraljice Subote, mlađi brat Princa Utorka). Svaka epizoda sastoji se iz dva dijela povezana zajedničkom socijalno-emotivnom temom, kao što su razočarenje i tuga ili bijes i zahvalnost. Svaku od priča prate i prigodni glazbeni brojevi, kako bi se najmlađim gledateljima što bolje približila tema i različite životne situacije. Ul.: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)...

programme.desc: Broccoli song - (children's program, Croatia) A witty song will reveal why broccoli is a real little vegetable heroine on our plate. Her green crown - full of vitamins, helps us to be strong and healthy. Dance and sing along to the new Juhuhu song!... / Pjesmica Brokula - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Duhovita pjesmica otkrit će nam zašto je brokula prava mala povrtna heroina na našem tanjuru. Njezina zelena kruna - vitamina puna, pomaže nam da budemo jaki i zdravi. Zaplešite i zapjevajte uz novu Juhuhu pjesmicu!...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E03, TV series, Australia) Bluey is an adorable and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E03, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E14, feature series, England, 2024) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E14, igrana serija, Engleska, 2024) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu - (S01, E22, cartoon series, Croatia, 2022) Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. They live in a village that has a train station. In it, in each sequel, they welcome travelers from different countries: Japan, France, Australia... From each of them they learn something about the world they don't know and because of that they become smarter and better. Director: Vjekoslav Živković... / Hu Hu - (S01, E22, crt. serija, Hrvatska, 2022) Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško. Oni žive u selu koje ima željezničku stanicu. U njoj u svakom nastavku dočekuju putnike iz različitih zemalja: Japana, Francuske, Australije... Od svakog od njih oni nešto nauče o svijetu koji ne poznaju i zbog čega postaju pametniji i bolji. R.: Vjekoslav Živković...

programme.title: Hu Hu song / Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu song - (children's program, Croatia) Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Numberblocks - (S01, E29, drama series, England) The series "Number Blocks" follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily... / Numberblocks - (S01, E29, igrana serija, Engleska) Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke...

programme.title: I love animals / Volim životinje
programme.desc: I love animals - (E02, doc. series, Croatia) Dora is 9 years old and trains to ride. She started on a pony and is now learning to ride big horses. She especially bonded with the young horse Flipper because together they prepare in daily training for the "riding test". Dora learns about horses, but also enjoys hanging out with this big animal. A special challenge for them will be to practice jumping over obstacles in the final part of the exam... / Volim životinje - (E02, dok. serija, Hrvatska) Dora ima 9 godina i trenira jahanje. Počela je na poniju, a sada uči jahati na velikim konjima. Posebno se povezala s mladim konjem Fliperom jer se zajedno pripremaju na svakodnevnim treninzima za "jahački ispit". Dora uči o konjima, ali i uživa u druženju s tom velikom životinjom. Poseban izazov za njih bit će uvježbati preskakanje preko prepreka u završnom dijelu ispita...

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E21, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with the vitality of childhood. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. Director: Julien Cayot Street: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)... / Simon - (S02, E21, igrana serija, Francuska) Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. R.: Julien Cayot Ul.: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)...

This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. R.: Yvonne Ng Yuwen Ul.: Amir El Ghouch (Numero / Tim), Archie Fletcher (Billy), Lois Sefton (Paula)... / 123 Number Squad - (E36, igrana serija, Singapur, 2021) Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. programme.title: Pablo / Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo - (E08, feature series, England, 2017) The award-winning children's series "Pablo" was shot in 2D animation combined with feature parts. The main character, Pablo, is an artistically gifted five-year-old boy on the autism spectrum. His imaginative drawings come to life and allow him to face the real world with more confidence. With magic crayons, he bravely transforms his life challenges into fantastic adventures, and his feelings into picturesque, talking characters. With the help of his friends from the world of his drawings - Ljam, Noasaur, Misha, Rafi, Tango and Palča - Pablo understands his real world as a five-year-old more easily. "Pablo" pays tribute to individuality and thinking in a different way, as the first children's series in the world with an autistic main character. Each story depicts the real-life experiences of children with autism, who participated in creating the stories and writing the screenplay. R.: David McGrath Ul.: Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Oliver Burns (Pablo), William Burns (Pablo), Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus)... / Pablo - (E08, igrana serija, Engleska, 2017) Nagrađivana serija za djecu "Pablo" snimljena je 2D animacijom u kombinaciji s igranim dijelovima. programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: Grizzy et les Lemmings - (S03, E28, Drama Series, France) Grizzly Bear and the Lemmings is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the lemmings, who live in the log cabin of a forest ranger while he is away. The ranger's log cabin is the only trace of human civilization amidst the untamed wilderness of Canada's great nature reserve. As the ranger escapes, the grizzly bear claims her, because after all, bears are at the top of the food chain. After moving into the house, Grizzly enjoys all the benefits of a modern way of living - a comfortable bed, an air-conditioned space and a fully equipped kitchen. But he is not alone. A group of small creatures, lemmings, also move into it. Since Grizzlies and lemmings are not civilized enough for a peaceful coexistence, they try to outwit each other with various tricks and complete madness reigns in the house. Street: Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (Grizzy), Josselin Charier (Lemmings)... / Grizzy et les Lemmings - (S03, E28, igrana serija, Francuska) "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti - leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan. Rendžerova brvnara jedini je trag ljudske civilizacije usred neukroćene divljine velikog kanadskog rezervata prirode. Dok rendžer izbiva, medvjed Grizli je prisvaja, jer ipak su medvjedi na vrhu hranidbenog lanca. Nakon što se useli u kuću, Grizli uživa u svim blagodatima suvremenog načina stanovanja - udobnom ležaju, klimatiziranom prostoru i potpuno opremljenoj kuhinji. No nije sam. U nju se useljava i skupina malih stvorenja, leminga. Kad Tango shvati da je zanemarila Miguela, ona i Aroo pohitaju mu u pomoć, a prije nego što se svo troje može zabavljati, pomognu mu dovršiti posao sa sijenom. programme.desc: Notes on language - (educational program, Croatia) Etymology is a branch of linguistics that studies the origin of words. In our country it is also called prehistory. Academician Ranko Matasović tells us about the beginnings of research into the origin of words, about our commonality with other languages ​​of the Indo-European group, about why the words brother, frater, brother have the same origin. We also learn how the origin of words that are difficult to determine where they come from, for example the word sedge, raga, etc., is shed light on. R.: Goran Ribarić... / Bilješke o jeziku - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Etimologija je grana lingvistike koja proučava podrijetlo riječi. U nas se zove i iskonoslovlje. Akademik Ranko Matasović govori nam o počecima istraživanja podrijetla riječi, o našem zajedništvu s ostalim jezicima indoeuropske skupine, o tome zašto su riječi brat, frater, bhrata istog podrijetla. Saznajemo i kako se rasvjetljava podrijetlo riječi kojima je teško utvrditi od kuda dolaze, primjerice riječ šaš, raga, i sl. R.: Goran Ribarić...

programme.title: Great shipwrecks of the Adriatic / Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: Great shipwrecks of the Adriatic - (E06, doc. series, Croatia, 2007) At the beginning of June 1866, Italy declared war on Austria, deciding to take control of the island of Vis, a key point for the control of the entire Adriatic. After several days of cruising around Vis and bombarding Austrian positions, the Italian fleet decides to conquer the island by landing. However, at dawn on June 20, an Austrian squadron arrived at Vis and a great naval battle began. With a deft maneuver, the Austrian ship sank the Italian admiral ship, the battleship Re d'Italia, and the battle ended very quickly. Legend has it that Re d'Italia was transporting gold coins worth several million euros intended for the establishment of Italian rule on Vis and in Dalmatia. Therefore, the search for the location of the sinking of the Re d'Italie continued for more than a hundred years, until a special Croatian-French expedition found it in May 2005. The last episode of Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic brings a successful search for the location of the Battle of Vis, as well as the reconstruction of that battle, one of the most famous naval battles on the Adriatic. Director: Davor Šarić... / Veliki brodolomi Jadrana - (E06, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2007) Početkom lipnja 1866. Italija je objavila rat Austriji, odlučivši od nje preuzeti nadzor nad otokom Visom, ključnom točkom za nadzor cijelog Jadrana. Nakon nekoliko dana krstarenja oko Visa i bombardiranja austrijskih položaja talijanska flota odlučuje osvojiti otok iskrcavanjem. No, u zoru 20. lipnja do Visa stiže austrijska eskadra i započinje velika pomorska bitka. Spretnim manevrom austrijski brod potopio je talijanski admiralski brod, oklopnjaču Re dItalia, te je bitka okončana vrlo brzo. Legenda govori da je Re dItalia prevozila zlatnike vrijedne nekoliko milijuna eura namijenjene uspostavi talijanske vlasti na Visu i u Dalmaciji. Stoga se više od stotinu godina odvijala potraga za lokacijom potonuća Re dItalie, sve dok je u svibnju 2005. ne pronalazi posebna hrvatsko-francuska ekspedicija. Posljednja epizoda Velikih brodoloma Jadrana donosi uspješnu potragu za lokacijom Viške bitke, ali i rekonstrukciju te bitke, jedne od najpoznatijih pomorskih bitaka na Jadranu. R.: Davor Šarić...

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative break and space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon... / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona...

programme.title: It happened one night / Dogodilo se jedne noći
programme.desc: It Happened One Night - (romantic comedy, USA, 1934) Spoiled Ellen "Ellie" Andrews (C. Colbert) is a young and slightly conceited rich woman, the daughter of strict millionaire Alexander Andrews (W. Connolly) who, against her father's will, wants to marry dowry hunter and playboy "King" Westley (J. Thomas). When she escapes from a yacht in Miami, where her father is holding her "prisoner" for her own good, Ellie hops on a bus and takes a night drive to New York where Westley is waiting for her. During the trip, she sits next to her a bit rough and irresponsible, unemployed journalist Peter Warne (C. Gable), an ambitious guy who wants to get back to work after a drinking problem. When he learns from the newspaper that his companion is a runaway heiress, Peter suggests that Ellie let him write an exclusive report on the event, and he will help her in return. Although they can hardly stand each other at first, the relationship between Ellie and Peter will gradually begin to change. R.: Frank Capra Ul.: Clark Gable (Peter Warne), Claudette Colbert (Ellie Andrews), Walter Connolly (Alexander Andrews), Roscoe Karns (Oscar Shapeley), Alan Hale (Danker)... / It Happened One Night - (romant. komedija, SAD, 1934) Razmažena Ellen "Ellie" Andrews (C. Colbert) mlada je i pomalo umišljena bogatašica, kći strogog milijunaša Alexandera Andrewsa (W. Connolly) koja se protivno očevoj volji želi udati za lovca na miraz i plejboja "Kinga" Westleya (J. Thomas). Kad pobjegne s jahte u Miamiju, gdje ju otac za njezino dobro drži "zatočenu", Ellie uskoči u autobus i krene na noćnu vožnju do New Yorka gdje ju čeka Westley. Tijekom putovanja do nje sjedi pomalo grubi i neodgovorni, nezaposleni novinar Peter Warne (C. Gable), ambiciozan momak koji se nakon problema s alkoholom želi vratiti na posao. Kad iz novina dozna da mu je suputnica odbjegla nasljednica, Peter predloži Ellie da mu omogući pisanje ekskluzivne reportaže o događaju, a on će joj zauzvrat pomoći. Iako isprva teško podnose jedno drugo, odnos između Ellie i Petera postupno će se početi mijenjati. R.: Frank Capra Ul.: Clark Gable (Peter Warne), Claudette Colbert (Ellie Andrews), Walter Connolly (Alexander Andrews), Roscoe Karns (Oscar Shapeley), Alan Hale (Danker)...
