programme.title: Book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Knjiga ili život - (artistic program, Croatia) Zastave, Gabrijela Rukelj Kraškovič and Robert Međurečan As fans of Miroslav Krleža, we attended the performance of Zastave at Zagreb's HNK, directed and adapted by Ivan Planinić. From that pleasant evening out came, of course, a contribution - to be more precise, a review. There were many flowers in the house and garden is the title of Gabriela Rukelj Kraškovič's first book, which might lead the reader to think that it is a warm, nostalgic prose. But for such prose, this title would be - too much. "Nothing was ever right in those houses", we read at the very beginning of the book whose author is a guest of our show. After the conversation in the studio, another interesting intervention follows - in the workspace of this year's winner of the "Gjalski" award, Robert Međurečan. His award-winning novel is set in Judea at the time of Christ, hence the title of the work, which, according to the author, was found by the editor Jadranka Pintarić. She opened the Bible and found a suitable title in Psalm 89: So be it... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Zastave, Gabrijela Rukelj Kraškovič i Robert Međurečan Kao poštovatelji Miroslava Krleže, bili smo na predstavi Zastave u zagrebačkom HNK-u, u režiji i adaptaciji Ivana Planinića. Iz tog ugodnog večernjeg izlaska proizišao je, naravno, i prilog - točnije rečeno, osvrt. U kući i vrtu bilo je mnogo cvijeća naslov je prve knjige Gabrijele Rukelj Kraškovič, koji bi čitatelja mogao navesti na pomisao da je riječ o toploj, nostalgičnoj prozi. No za takvu prozu ovakav bi naslov bio - previše. "U tim kućama nikada ništa nije bilo u redu", čitamo već na samom početku knjige čija je autorica gošća naše emisije. Nakon razgovora u studiju slijedi još jedna zanimljiva intervencija - u radnom prostoru ovogodišnjeg dobitnika nagrade "Gjalski", Roberta Međurečana. Njegov nagrađeni roman smješten je u Judeju u Kristovo vrijeme, pa otuda i naslov djela koji je, prema autorovim riječima, pronašla urednica Jadranka Pintarić. Otvorila je Bibliju i u Psalmu 89 pronašla prigodan naslov: Tako neka bude...

programme.title: from the soul / Animatik
programme.desc: Animatik - (cultural magazine, Croatia, 2025) The show is dedicated to artistic short and feature-length animated films by Croatian and foreign authors, which will be shown in their entirety. Animatik also, through contributions and conversations with guests in the studio, thematizes certain aspects of working on an animated film, showing both new and classic works of Croatian and international animation. The aim of the show is to regularly show animated films in the context of the theme so that viewers have the opportunity to see these titles in their full duration. Authors of animated films, members of film crews, film critics and filmologists, as well as organizers of festivals where animated films are shown, will participate in Animatik through presentations and studio discussions, depending on the central theme of the show... / Animatik - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Emisija je posvećena umjetničkim kratkometražnim, ali i dugometražnim animiranim filmovima hrvatskih i inozemnih autora, koji će se prikazivati u cijelosti. Animatik, također, kroz priloge i razgovore s gostima u studiju tematizira pojedine aspekte rada na animiranom filmu prikazujući i nova i klasična djela hrvatske i svjetske animacije. Cilj je emisije redovito prikazivati animirane filmove u kontekstu teme kako bi gledatelji imali prigodu vidjeti ove naslove u njihovu punom trajanju. U Animatiku će kroz priloge i studijske razgovore sudjelovati autori animiranih filmova, članovi filmskih ekipa, filmski kritičari i filmolozi te organizatori festivala na kojima se prikazuju animirani filmovi, i to ovisno o središnjoj temi emisije...

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E10, doc. series, Germany, 2021) How can a man best meet strangers even though he does not speak their language? He will sit in the car with them. That's exactly what Samuel Hade did. In two months, this filmmaker hitchhiked across Japan in search of adventure. His motto is: I don't refuse any invitation and I accept everything new. Hitchhiking through Japan is a special trip with overnight stays in a coin laundromat or, secretly, in a university library. It's a journey with cold days, lonely roads and bathing in the hot springs of Noboribetsu... / Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E10, dok. serija, Njemačka, 2021) Kako će čovjek najbolje upoznati strance iako ne govori njihov jezik? Sjest će k njima u automobil. Upravo to učinio je Samuel Hade. Ovaj je filmaš sam za dva mjeseca autostopom proputovao Japan u potrazi za pustolovinama. Njegovo geslo glasi: ne odbijam nijedan poziv i prihvaćam sve novo. Autostopom kroz Japan poseban je izlet s noćenjima u praonici rublja na kovanice ili, potajno, u sveučilišnoj knjižnici. Putovanje je to s hladnim danima, samotnim cestama i kupanjem u vrućim izvorima Noboribetsua...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It's time for jazz - (music show, Croatia) Brings recordings of Croatian and foreign jazz concerts and festivals, reportage overviews of current events on the Croatian jazz scene... / Vrijeme je za jazz - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni...

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: ART - (art program, Croatia) Art - your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music... / ART - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Art - vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Outside the format - (artistic program, Croatia) Choreography for the final line is the name of the 60th Zagreb Salon of Visual Arts. The jubilee edition of one of the most important and long-standing manifestations of contemporary art in Croatia, organized by the Croatian Society of Fine Artists, presented more than 25 works of art, interventions in public space, lectures and performances at more than 20 locations. Zagreb thus became an open-air gallery, and the reaction of the public was not absent. The curatorial concept of the 60th Zagreb salon is signed by the young collective KUĆĆA. In the studio, we talk with Salon curators Luja Šimunović and Klara Petrović, and artists Silvio Vujičić, Vladimir Novak, Andrej Beštak, Anja Leko and Nina Kurtela talk about their works. The show also features the third member of the KUĆĆA curatorial collective, Jurica Mlinarec, and the director of the HDLU, Ivana Andabaka Vujičić... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Koreografija za završnu liniju naziv je 60. zagrebačkog salona vizualnih umjetnosti. Jubilarno izdanje jedne od najvažnijih i najdugovječnijih manifestacija suvremene umjetnosti u Hrvatskoj, u organizaciji Hrvatskog društva likovnih umjetnika, predstavilo je više od 25 umjetničkih radova, intervencija u javnom prostoru, predavanja i performansa na više od 20 lokacija. Zagreb je tako postao galerija na otvorenom, a reakcija javnosti nije izostala. Kustoski koncept 60. zagrebačkog salona potpisuje mladi kolektiv KUĆĆA. U studiju razgovaramo s kustosicama Salona Lujom Šimunović i Klarom Petrović, a o svojim radovima govore umjetnici Silvio Vujičić, Vladimir Novak, Andrej Beštak, Anja Leko i Nina Kurtela. U emisiji sudjeluje i treći član kustoskog kolektiva KUĆĆA, Jurica Mlinarec, te ravnateljica HDLU-a Ivana Andabaka Vujičić...

programme.title: Fever / Groznica
programme.desc: Rush! - (E05, show magazine, Australia, 2024) The episode explores the very essence of life - water. From the earliest civilizations to modern-day societies, water is a key thread that shapes our lives, cities and cultures. As we explore the life cycle of water, the rise of ancient civilizations, and the role of water in driving industrialization and sustaining livelihoods, we delve into the cultural, economic, and existential importance of water—exploring why it's aptly called the driving force of civilizations. R.: Rob Perry St.: Mark Backes (Commentary)... / Rush! - (E05, show magazin, Australija, 2024) Epizoda istražuje samu esenciju života - vodu. Od najranijih civilizacija do društava modernog doba, voda je ključna nit koja oblikuje naše živote, gradove i kulture. Dok otkrivamo životni ciklus vode, uspon drevnih civilizacija te ulogu vode u pokretanju industrijalizacije i održavanju sredstava za život, dubinski ispitujemo kulturnu, ekonomsku i egzistencijalnu važnost vode - istražujući zašto je prikladno nazivaju pokretačkom snagom civilizacija. R.: Rob Perry Ul.: Mark Backes (Kommentar)...

programme.title: The Eternal Cycle of Comedy: Wonder Woman / Vječni ciklus komedije: Čudesna djevojka
programme.desc: Something Wild - (comedy, USA, 1986) In a New York restaurant, the attractive wanderer Lulu (M. Griffith) and the hardened businessman Charles Driggs (J. Daniels) meet by chance. Charles leaves without paying the bill and Lulu assures him that such "outbursts" are his way of satisfying his otherwise deeply hidden natural desires, for example sexual. Attractive, imaginative and wild, the girl persuades him to go on an adventure with her. Lulu, actually Audrey Hankel, intends to take the confused Charles to the tenth anniversary of his graduation to present him as her successful husband. The journey to Audrey's hometown turns into a real adventure, where Charles is shocked, but also attracted by each new outburst of the unusual companion: from unconventional sex to incidental theft. However, the couple in love will run into real trouble when they are met at their destination by the psychotic Ray (R. Liotta), Audrey's ex-husband recently released from prison, who desperately wants Audrey back... Director: Jonathan Demme St.: Melanie Griffith (Audrey Hankel), Jeff Daniels (Charles Driggs), Ray Liotta (Ray Sinclair), Margaret Colin (Irene), Leib Lensky (Frenchy)... / Something Wild - (komedija, SAD, 1986) U jednom newyorškom restoranu slučajno se susretnu atraktivna lutalica Lulu (M. Griffith) i uštogljeni poslovni čovjek Charles Driggs (J. Daniels). Charles je otišao ne plativši račun i Lulu ga uvjerava da su takvi "ispadi" način na koji on zadovoljava svoje inače duboko skrivene prirodne želje, na primjer seksualne. Privlačna, maštovita i divlja, djevojka ga nagovara da s njom krene u pustolovinu. Lulu, zapravo Audrey Hankel, namjerava odvesti zbunjenog Charlesa na desetogodišnjicu mature kako bi ga predstavila kao svoga uspješnog supruga. Put do Audreynog rodnog kraja pretvori se u pravu pustolovinu pri čemu Charlesa šokira, ali i privuče svaki novi ispad neobične suputnice: od nekonvencionalnog seksa do usputne krađe. Međutim, zaljubljeni će par upasti u prave nevolje kad ih na odredištu dočeka psihotični Ray (R. Liotta), Audreyn bivši suprug nedavno pušten iz zatvora, koji očajnički želi da mu se Audrey vrati... R.: Jonathan Demme Ul.: Melanie Griffith (Audrey Hankel), Jeff Daniels (Charles Driggs), Ray Liotta (Ray Sinclair), Margaret Colin (Irene), Leib Lensky (Frenchy)...

programme.title: The Simpsons / Simpsoni
programme.desc: The Simpsons - (S33, E18, cartoon series, USA, 2022) The Simpsons, the longest-running animated series, a cultural institution with an extremely loyal and dedicated fan base. Intelligently written, subversively humorous and endearingly witty, the series makes fun of the environment, but also itself. She is the winner of numerous awards. In addition, The Simpsons are the current owners of two Guinness records, as the longest-running animated series and the series with the most guest stars. The Simpson family consists of: father Homer, who works as a safety inspector at the local nuclear power plant, mother Marge, who tries to keep the peace in the family, mischievous ten-year-old Bart, intelligent saxophonist eight-year-old Lisa, and the youngest Maggie, who expresses her emotions by blowing. Over time, viewers got to know and love the remaining rich and often unusual world of characters living in Springfield. The Simpsons, created by animator Matt Groening, first appeared in 1987 as a series of 30-second short stories produced by Groening for The Tracy Ullman Show. They soon got their own series, first airing in a Christmas special on December 17, 1989, and then in regular time on January 14, 1990. They have their own star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, and on May 1, 2005, America's Funniest Family celebrated its then-record 350th episode. R.: Rob Oliver Ul.: Dan Castellaneta (Santas Little Helper / Homer Simpson), Julie Kavner (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Nelson Muntz / Bart Simpson), Yeardley Smith (Lisa Simpson), Hank Azaria (Kirk Van Houten / Coach Krupt / Superintendent Chalmers)... / The Simpsons - (S33, E18, crt. serija, SAD, 2022) Simpsoni, animirana serija s najduljim stažem emitiranja, kulturne institucije s izuzetno odanim i predanim krugom obožavatelja. Inteligentno pisana, subverzivno humoristična i simpatično duhovita, serija ismijava okolinu, ali i samu sebe. Dobitnica je brojnih nagrada. Simpsoni su uz to trenutačni vlasnici dva Guinnesova rekorda i to kao najdulje emitirana animirana serija i serija s najviše ugošćenih zvijezda. Obitelj Simpson čine: otac Homer, koji radi kao inspektor zaštite na radu u mjesnoj nuklearnoj elektrani, majka Marge, koja pokušava zadržati mir u obitelji, nestašni desetogodišnjak Bart, inteligentna saksofonistica osmogodišnja Lisa i najmanja Maggie, koja emocije izražava dudanjem. Gledatelji su s vremenom upoznali i zavoljeli preostali bogati i nerijetko neobični svijet likova koji žive u Springfieldu.Simpsoni, koje je osmislio animator Matt Groening, prvi su se put pojavili 1987. kao serija kratkih priča u 30 sekunda koje je Groening producirao za The Tracy Ullman Show. Uskoro su dobili vlastitu seriju emitiravši se prvi put u božićnom specijalu 17. prosinca 1989., a zatim i u redovnom terminu 14. siječnja 1990. Posjeduju svoju zvijezdu na holivudskoj Stazi slavnih, a 1. svibnja 2005. američka najzabavnija obitelj proslavila je tada rekordnu 350. epizodu. R.: Rob Oliver Ul.: Dan Castellaneta (Santas Little Helper / Homer Simpson), Julie Kavner (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Nelson Muntz / Bart Simpson), Yeardley Smith (Lisa Simpson), Hank Azaria (Kirk Van Houten / Coach Krupt / Superintendent Chalmers)...

programme.title: Munir Vejzović / Munir Vejzović
programme.desc: Munir Vejzović - (doc. film, Croatia, 2017) Biographical film about the painter Munir Vejzović and his work on the occasion of a large retrospective exhibition staged in the Modern Gallery in Zagreb in the spring of 2017. Director: Milan Bešlić... / Munir Vejzović - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2017) Biografski film o slikaru Muniru Vejzović i njegovom stvaralaštvu u povodu velike retrospektivne izložbe postavljene u Modernoj galeriji u Zagrebu u proljeće 2017. godine. R.: Milan Bešlić...

programme.title: Nora / Nora
programme.desc: Nora - (drama, Ireland, 2000) In Dublin, 1904, James Joyce is walking down the street and meets Nora Barnacle, a young woman from Galway. She charms him with her honest, uninhibited behavior and he soon persuades her to come with him to Trieste... Director: Pat Murphy Street: Ewan McGregor (James Joyce), Susan Lynch (Nora Barnacle), Peter McDonald (Stanislaus Joyce), Roberto Citran (Roberto Prezioso), Andrew Scott (Michael Bodkin)... / Nora - (drama, Irska, 2000) U Dublinu, 1904., James Joyce šeta ulicom i susreće Noru Barnacle, mladu ženu iz Galwaya. Ona ga očara svojim iskrenim, nesputanim ponašanjem i on je ubrzo nagovori da pođe s njim u Trst... R.: Pat Murphy Ul.: Ewan McGregor (James Joyce), Susan Lynch (Nora Barnacle), Peter McDonald (Stanislaus Joyce), Roberto Citran (Roberto Prezioso), Andrew Scott (Michael Bodkin)...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It's time for jazz - (music show, Croatia) Brings recordings of Croatian and foreign jazz concerts and festivals, reportage overviews of current events on the Croatian jazz scene... / Vrijeme je za jazz - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni...

programme.title: The World As It Was: Klonimir's Film Records / Svijet kakav je nekad bio: Klonimirovi filmski zapisi
programme.desc: The world as it once was: Klonimir's film records - (E01, nature film, Croatia) After making the documentary "All Klonimir's Decades" about the navigator and flight engineer Klonimir Seršić (Baška, Krk, 1925 - Zagreb, 2021), director Mladen Santrić decided to process his unusual film legacy. It is about a selection of film recordings that Klonimir recorded all over the world in the period from 1960 to 1980. Considering the passage of time, the cycle is a valuable testimony of "the world as it once was", and it consists of sixty short films from Europe, Australia, Canada, the USA, Africa and Asia. This peculiar "time machine" is a valuable film document about a time that new generations would otherwise not be able to experience... / Svijet kakav je nekad bio: Klonimirovi filmski zapisi - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska) Nakon što je o navigatoru i inženjeru letenja Klonimiru Seršiću (Baška, Krk, 1925. - Zagreb, 2021.) snimio dokumentarni film "Sva Klonimirova desetljeća", redatelj Mladen Santrić odlučio je obraditi njegovu neobičnu filmsku ostavštinu. Riječ je o izboru filmskih zapisa koje je Klonimir snimao po cijelom svijetu u razdoblju od 1960. do 1980. godine. Ciklus je s obzirom na protok vremena dragocjeno svjedočanstvo o "svijetu kakav je nekad bio", a čini ga šezdesetak kratkih filmova iz Europe, Australije, Kanade, SAD-a, Afrike i Azije. Ovaj osebujan "vremeplov" vrijedan je filmski dokument o vremenu koje nove generacije inače ne bi mogle doživjeti...

programme.title: Tern around the world / Čigrom oko svijeta
programme.desc: A tern around the world - (E01, nature film, Croatia, 2002) Croatian tern and Mladen Šutej sail the seas of the world. In the first five episodes, we will follow the sailing from Biograd, through the Mediterranean, Gibraltar, Portugal, Tenerife, the Atlantic Ocean, the Caribbean, the Panama Canal and the Galapagos. With the help of good winds, self-sacrificing crews and experienced skippers, the Croatian Tern sailed to some of the most interesting parts of the world. In addition to the sailboat built in the shipyard in Kraljevica, we will also see Gibraltar and the port of Tangier in Morocco. We will see what it means to sail across the ocean, when for 25 days there is nothing but wind, sun and endless open sea. After a short stay in the Caribbean, Tern passed through the architectural wonder - the Panama Canal, and we will also see two faces of Panama City and experience a stay on one of the most interesting natural phenomena - the Galapagos Islands. In the first episode of "Doors of the Atlantic", the Croatian tern left Biograd, sailed across the Mediterranean and takes us to Gibraltar, Tangier in Morocco and the port of Cadiz, which was the main Spanish starting point for conquests in America. In Villamoura, a fashionable Portuguese resort on the Costa Algarve, Čigraši hung out with the future winner of the non-stop regatta "The Race", and we will also see one of the most beautiful Portuguese cities, Cascais, in the suburbs of Lisbon. R.: Tanja Kanceljak... / Čigrom oko svijeta - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2002) Hrvatska čigra i Mladen Šutej jedre svjetskim morima. U prvih pet epizoda pratit ćemo plovidbu od Biograda, preko Sredozemlja, Gibraltara, Portugala, Teneriffa, Atlantskog oceana, Kariba, Panamskog kanala i Galapagosa. Uz pomoć dobroga vjetra, požrtvovnih posada i iskusnih skipera, Hrvatska čigra doplovila je do nekih od najzanimljivijih dijelova svijeta. Osim jedrilice izgrađene u brodogradilištu u Kraljevici, vidjet ćemo i Gibraltar i luku Tanger u Maroku. Vidjet ćemo što znači plovidba preko oceana, kada 25 dana nema ničeg drugog osim vjetra, sunca i beskraja pučine. Nakon kratkog boravka na Karibima, Čigra je prošla kroz graditeljsko čudo - Panamski kanal, a vidjet ćemo i dva lica grada Paname te doživjeti boravak na jednom od najzanimljivijih prirodnih fenomena - otočju Galapagos. U prvoj epizodi "Vrata Atlantika" Hrvatska čigra napustila je Biograd, prejedrila Sredozemlje i vodi nas u Gibraltar, Tanger u Maroku te luku Cadiz koja je bila glavno španjolsko polazište za osvajačke pohode u Ameriku. U Villamouri, mondenom portugalskom ljetovalištu na Costi Algarve, Čigraši su se družili s budućim pobjednikom non-stop regate "The Race", a vidjet ćemo i jedan od najljepših portugalskih gradova Cascais, u predgrađu Lisabona. R.: Tanja Kanceljak...

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: Notes on language - (educational program, Croatia) We talk about the history of Esperanto, the people who created it, the reasons why it was created. It was well received in Croatia. From the beginning, enthusiasts have advocated learning that language of hope (which is the translation of the word Esperanto). The Zagreb school for learning Esperanto is also famous. Literature was born on it, it was a bridge for the translation of works of small literature such as ours, you can pray on it, you can also sing. This is exactly what opera singer Neven Mrzlečki does in our show, who translated some of our famous songs into Esperanto. Prof. Ph.D. Velimir Piškorec talks inspiredly about his experiences in learning and speaking Esperanto, about the history of that language and the people who marked its history. Director: Goran Ribarić... / Bilješke o jeziku - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Govorimo o povijesti esperanta, o ljudima koji su ga stvorili, razlozima zašto je nastao. U Hrvatskoj je naišao na dobar prijem. Od početka su se entuzijasti zauzimali za učenje toga jezika nade (što je prijevod riječi esperanto). Poznata je i zagrebačka škola učenja esperanta. Na njemu je nastala književnost, bio je most za prevođenje djela malih književnosti kakva je naša, na njemu se može i moliti, može se i pjevati. Upravo to u našoj emisiji radi operni pjevač Neven Mrzlečki koji je na esperanto preveo neke naše poznate pjesme. Prof. dr. sc. Velimir Piškorec nadahnuto govori o svojim iskustvima u učenju i govorenju esperanta, o povijesti toga jezika i ljudima koji su njegovu povijest obilježili. R.: Goran Ribarić...

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: Juhuhu - (children's program, Croatia) JUHUHU is a children's morning program that includes cartoons, domestic and foreign shows for children of early school and kindergarten age. Through the morning and cheerful content, the Juhuhu people are led by actor-hosts who are there to tell a story, be a company for morning exercise, brush their teeth with a magical Juhuhu toothbrush or to teach their viewers some new, so far unknown things about the universe, chickens, sheep, refrigerators, trumpets, cabbage, broccoli and the secrets of Juhuhu plushies. Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: Sound collector / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sound Collector - (E55, feature series, Croatia) Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little being spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are most often the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle... / Skupljač zvukova - (E55, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte...

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: PAW Patrol - (S09, E10, animated series, USA, 2022) The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. Each dog has special skills associated with emergency service professions, so members of the family include a firefighter, a policeman and an airman. They all live in doghouses that transform into vehicles adapted to their tasks. They are also equipped with special "dog backpacks" in which they carry all the tools needed for "dog jobs". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Christian Corrao (Marshall), Lucien Duncan Reid (Rubble), Kai Harris (Ryder), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase)... / PAW Patrol - (S09, E10, anim. serija, SAD, 2022) Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay. Svaki pas ima posebne vještine povezane s profesijama hitne službe, pa su članovi družine vatrogasac, policajac i zrakoplovac. Svi žive u psećim kućicama koje se preoblikuju u vozila prilagođena njihovim zadacima. Također su opremljeni posebnim "psećim ruksacima" u kojima nose sve alate potrebne za "pseće poslove". programme.title: Hi Day / Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Hey Duggee - (S03, E12, cartoon series, England) Get ready for laughter, learning and exciting activities in an adventure-filled club that every child will want to join! Meet Duggee, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages kids to have fun, be full of energy and most of all, do anything! Each episode of this colorful, fun and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Duggee welcoming the Chipmunks, a group of little curios left at the club by their parents. Then there's laughter and learning as the Chipmunks discover something new about the world around them, and Duggee watches over them patiently. Their adventures are often funny and comical, which will certainly attract young viewers (as well as adults) and encourage them to solve problems actively and on the move, running and jumping. Duggee rewards club members with an activity badge each time, which they proudly show off to the parents who pick them up at the end of each episode. Introducing... Squirrels! Betty, a cheerful octopus who loves to read and is very intelligent, wants to be the first to answer every question. Vrcko, a hyperactive hippopotamus who approaches everything with enthusiasm, is loud and doesn't like listening. Lucky, a small, happy and undemanding crocodile, will use every opportunity to get wet. Nora, thoughtful and smart muscle, is sensitive, curious and gentle. Svaka epizoda ove šarene, zabavne i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Duggee dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Njihove pustolovine često su šaljive i komične, što će zasigurno privući mlade gledatelje (ali i odrasle) i potaknuti ih da probleme rješavaju aktivno i u pokretu, trčeći i poskakujući. Duggee svaki put članove kluba nagradi značkom za aktivnost, što oni ponosno pokazuju roditeljima koji dođu po njih na kraju svake epizode. Predstavljamo... Vjeverice! Piko, malen i dobrodušan nosorog, nježna duša koja se često zalijeće u stvari oko sebe! Beti, vesela hobotnica koja voli čitati i vrlo je inteligentna, želi odgovoriti prva na svako pitanje. Vrcko, hiperaktivan vodenkonj koji svemu pristupa s oduševljenjem, glasan je i ne ide mu slušanje. Srećko, malen, sretan i nezahtjevan krokodil, iskoristit će svaku priliku da se smoči. Nora, zamišljena i pametna mišica, osjećajna je, radoznala i nježna. programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Pig - (S02, E50, feature series, England) "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human traits, and there are also her family and friends. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother George, their parents and the other animal families that live in their town. Each family represents a different animal species, so Peppa's friends are the rabbit Rebecca, the sheep Suzy and the cat Candy. In each episode, the cheerful group experiences new adventures, and the plot often helps children cope with new feelings and experiences that come with growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human characteristics. Along with her, there are her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her own age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plots of the episodes are related to the children's daily activities - going to kindergarten, swimming, visiting grandparents or other relatives, playing on the playground or riding bicycles. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in houses and drive cars, but they also show some characteristics of the animals on which they are based. R.: Mark Baker St.: John Sparkes (Narrator)... / Peppa Pig - (S02, E50, igrana serija, Engleska) "Praščić Peppa" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s mnogo ljudskih osobina, a tu su još i njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georgea, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu. Svaka obitelj predstavlja drugu životinjsku vrstu pa su tako Peppini prijatelji zečica Rebecca, ovca Suzy i mačka Candy. U svakoj epizodi vesela družina doživljava nove avanture, a radnja često pomaže djeci da se nose s novim osjećajima i iskustvima koje sa sobom donosi odrastanje. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E22, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. Director: Julien Cayot Street: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)... / Simon - (S02, E22, igrana serija, Francuska) Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: Dino Ranch - (S02, E35, Drama, Canada, 2023) Tango is celebrating her birthday, and Miguel and the Dinoranchers have prepared a series of her favorite activities. Convinced that everyone cares more about Tonko than she does, Tango runs off to Breakwater Gorge to have fun smashing rocks, but Tonko, who adores Tango, follows her and ends up trapped in a rockfall! Tango immediately calls the Dinoranchers for help, realizing that this time she will have to be gentle in order to save her friend. R.: Bill Speers Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)... / Dino Ranch - (S02, E35, igrana serija, Kanada, 2023) Tango slavi rođendan, a Miguel i Dinorančeri pripremili su niz njezinih omiljenih aktivnosti. No planovi se poremete kada spase malog triceratopsa kojem daju ime Tonko. Sve Tangine omiljene igre su glasne i žestoke, ali nažalost prežestoke za malog Tonka, pa Dinorančeri odluče prilagoditi proslavu i učiniti je nježnijom, što uzruja Tango. Uvjerena da svima više stalo do Tonka nego do nje, Tango pobjegne u Lomni klanac da se zabavi razbijajući stijene, ali Tonko, koji obožava Tango, krene za njom i završi zarobljen u odronu kamenja! Tango odmah pozove Dinorančere u pomoć, shvaćajući da će ovaj put morati biti nježna kako bi spasila prijatelja. Kada je Tonko ponovno na sigurnom, Tango shvaća koliko je ovaj živahni mali triceratops poseban i uspijeva zajedno s njim uživati u rođendanskoj proslavi. R.: Bill Speers Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)...

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: The Furchester Hotel - (S03, E12, Drama, England) Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (a BBC pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel... / The Furchester Hotel - (S03, E12, igrana serija, Engleska) Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela...

programme.title: The song GREEN / Pjesmica ZELENA
programme.desc: Pjesmica ZELENA - (children's program, Croatia) We bring fun and educational musical moments that your little ones will endlessly enjoy!... / Pjesmica ZELENA - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Donosimo zabavne i edukativne glazbene trenutke u kojima će vaši najmlađi beskrajno uživati!...

programme.title: Daniel the tiger's neighborhood / Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: Daniel Tigers Neighborhood - (S02, E23, Drama, USA) "Daniel Tigers Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." The series tells inspiring stories about the lives of preschoolers, using musical strategies rooted in Fred Rogers' famous social-emotional learning. Through imagination, creativity and music, Daniel and his friends learn important social skills, necessary for school and life. The main character of the series is Tigrić Daniel (son of Mama Tigrica and Papa Tigra). Along with him, the series also features other children, characters from the Neighborhood of Imagination, such as Maca Katarina (daughter of Maca Henrietta), Miss Elena (daughter of Lady Elena Fairchilda and Niko Musician), Owl O (nephew of Owl X) and Prince Wednesday (youngest son of King Friday and Queen Saturday, younger brother of Prince Tuesday). Each episode consists of two parts connected by a common social-emotional theme, such as disappointment and sadness or anger and gratitude. Each of the stories is accompanied by appropriate musical numbers, in order to bring the theme and different life situations as close as possible to the youngest viewers. Street: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)... / Daniel Tigers Neighborhood - (S02, E23, igrana serija, SAD) "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa". Serija pripovijeda poticajne priče o životu predškolske djece, služeći se glazbenim strategijama ukorijenjenim u poznatom socijalno-emotivnom učenju Freda Rogersa. Kroz maštu, kreativnost i glazbu, Daniel i njegovi prijatelji uče važne društvene vještine, neophodne za školu i život. Glavni lik serije je Tigrić Daniel (sin Mame Tigrice i Tate Tigra). Uz njega, u seriji se također pojavljuju druga djeca, likovi iz Susjedstva Mašte, kao što su Maca Katarina (kći Mace Henrijete), gospođica Elena (kći ledi Elene Fairchilde i Nika Glazbenika), Sova O (nećak Sove X) i Princ Srijeda (najmlađi sin Kralja Petka i Kraljice Subote, mlađi brat Princa Utorka). Svaka epizoda sastoji se iz dva dijela povezana zajedničkom socijalno-emotivnom temom, kao što su razočarenje i tuga ili bijes i zahvalnost. Svaku od priča prate i prigodni glazbeni brojevi, kako bi se najmlađim gledateljima što bolje približila tema i različite životne situacije. Ul.: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)...

programme.title: Broccoli song / Pjesmica Brokula
programme.desc: Broccoli song - (children's program, Croatia) A witty song will reveal why broccoli is a real little vegetable heroine on our plate. Her green crown - full of vitamins, helps us to be strong and healthy. Dance and sing along to the new Juhuhu song!... / Pjesmica Brokula - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Duhovita pjesmica otkrit će nam zašto je brokula prava mala povrtna heroina na našem tanjuru. Njezina zelena kruna - vitamina puna, pomaže nam da budemo jaki i zdravi. Zaplešite i zapjevajte uz novu Juhuhu pjesmicu!...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E04, Drama, Australia) Bluey is an adorable and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E04, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E15, feature series, England, 2025) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E15, igrana serija, Engleska, 2025) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu - (S01, E14, cartoon series, Croatia, 2022) Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. They live in a village that has a train station. In it, in each sequel, they welcome travelers from different countries: Japan, France, Australia... From each of them they learn something about the world they don't know and because of that they become smarter and better. Director: Vjekoslav Živković... / Hu Hu - (S01, E14, crt. serija, Hrvatska, 2022) Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško. Oni žive u selu koje ima željezničku stanicu. U njoj u svakom nastavku dočekuju putnike iz različitih zemalja: Japana, Francuske, Australije... Od svakog od njih oni nešto nauče o svijetu koji ne poznaju i zbog čega postaju pametniji i bolji. R.: Vjekoslav Živković...

programme.title: Hu Hu song / Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu song - (children's program, Croatia) Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a happy society in which the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško... / Hu Hu pjesmica - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško...

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Numberblocks - (S01, E30, drama series, England) The series "Number Blocks" follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily... / Numberblocks - (S01, E30, igrana serija, Engleska) Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke...

programme.title: I love animals / Volim životinje
programme.desc: I love animals - (doc. series, Croatia) Six-year-old Vid is a big animal lover. He has many pets in his home - two happy dogs, two parrots, Pipi the rabbit, 3 aquariums with warm and cold water fish and a terrarium with praying mantises. Playing and caring for animals is a big part of the boy's life, and besides learning about them, Vid learns with them and because of them. One of those lessons is going out on your own to get food and toys for his many pets... / Volim životinje - (dok. serija, Hrvatska) Šestogodišnji Vid je veliki ljubitelj životinja. U svojem domu ima mnoge ljubimce - dva vesela psa, dvije papige, kunića Pipija, 3 akvarija s toplovodnim i hladnovodnim ribicama i terarij s bogomoljkama. Igra i briga oko životinja velik je dio dječakova života, a osim što uči o njima, Vid uči uz njih i zbog njih. Jedna od takvih lekcija je i samostalan odlazak u nabavu hrane i igračaka za njegove brojne ljubimce...

programme.title: The song Medo, everything is going well / Pjesmica Medo, sve ide redom
programme.desc: Song Medo, everything goes in order - (children's program, Croatia) Medo, everything goes in order A cheerful and fun song that introduces us to the rules of good behavior. With the help of Aunt Cow and forest friends, an impatient bear will learn why it's not polite to push yourself over the line. Even when he wants something - honey or ice cream, he should be nice and stand in line!... / Pjesmica Medo, sve ide redom - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Medo, sve ide redom Vesela i zabavna pjesmica koja nas upoznaje s pravilima lijepog ponašanja. Uz pomoć tete Krave i šumskih prijatelja, jedan nestrpljivi medo naučit će zašto nije pristojno gurati se preko reda. Već kada nešto želi - med ili sladoled, treba biti fin i stati u red!...

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Pig - (S02, E50, feature series, England) "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human traits, and there are also her family and friends. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother George, their parents and the other animal families that live in their town. Each family represents a different animal species, so Peppa's friends are the rabbit Rebecca, the sheep Suzy and the cat Candy. In each episode, the cheerful group experiences new adventures, and the plot often helps children cope with new feelings and experiences that come with growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human characteristics. Along with her, there are her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her own age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plots of the episodes are related to the children's daily activities - going to kindergarten, swimming, visiting grandparents or other relatives, playing on the playground or riding bicycles. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in houses and drive cars, but they also show some characteristics of the animals on which they are based. R.: Mark Baker St.: John Sparkes (Narrator)... / Peppa Pig - (S02, E50, igrana serija, Engleska) "Praščić Peppa" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s mnogo ljudskih osobina, a tu su još i njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georgea, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu. Svaka obitelj predstavlja drugu životinjsku vrstu pa su tako Peppini prijatelji zečica Rebecca, ovca Suzy i mačka Candy. U svakoj epizodi vesela družina doživljava nove avanture, a radnja često pomaže djeci da se nose s novim osjećajima i iskustvima koje sa sobom donosi odrastanje. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s puno ljudskih osobina. Uz nju, tu su još njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Peppini prijatelji su njezinih godina, dok su prijatelji njezinog mlađeg brata njegovi vršnjaci. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. Likovi u seriji nose odjeću, žive u kućama i voze automobile, no pokazuju i neke osobine onih životinja na kojima su temeljeni. R.: Mark Baker Ul.: John Sparkes (Narator)...

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E22, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. Director: Julien Cayot Street: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)... / Simon - (S02, E22, igrana serija, Francuska) Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. R.: Julien Cayot Ul.: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)...

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: 123 Number Squad - (E37, drama series, Singapore, 2021) Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. R.: Goh Hong Wei Alex St.: Owen Crouch (Maurice / Redbeard), Amir El Ghouch (Numero / Tim), Archie Fletcher (Billy), Lois Sefton (Paula)... / 123 Number Squad - (E37, igrana serija, Singapur, 2021) Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. Ova jedinstvena serija predškolcima donosi brze i duhovite pustolovine uz koje mogu učiti i smijati se te također istraživati teme ključne za društveni i emocionalni razvoj poput važnosti dijeljenja, otpornosti, timskog rada i prijateljstva. Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123. R.: Goh Hong Wei Alex Ul.: Owen Crouch (Maurice / Redbeard), Amir El Ghouch (Numero / Tim), Archie Fletcher (Billy), Lois Sefton (Paula)...

programme.title: Pablo / Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo - (E09, feature series, England, 2017) The award-winning children's series "Pablo" was shot in 2D animation combined with feature parts. The main character, Pablo, is an artistically gifted five-year-old boy on the autism spectrum. His imaginative drawings come to life and allow him to face the real world with more confidence. With magic crayons, he bravely transforms his life challenges into fantastic adventures, and his feelings into picturesque, talking characters. With the help of his friends from the world of his drawings - Ljam, Noasaur, Misha, Rafi, Tango and Palča - Pablo understands his real world as a five-year-old more easily. "Pablo" pays tribute to individuality and thinking in a different way, as the first children's series in the world with an autistic main character. Each story depicts the real-life experiences of children with autism, who participated in creating the stories and writing the screenplay. R.: David McGrath Ul.: Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Oliver Burns (Pablo), William Burns (Pablo), Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus)... / Pablo - (E09, igrana serija, Engleska, 2017) Nagrađivana serija za djecu "Pablo" snimljena je 2D animacijom u kombinaciji s igranim dijelovima. Glavni lik, Pablo, umjetnički je nadaren petogodišnji dječak u spektru autizma. Njegovi maštoviti crteži oživljavaju i omogućuju mu da se s više pouzdanja suočava sa stvarnim svijetom. Čarobnim bojicama on svoje životne izazove hrabro pretvara u fantastične pustolovine, a osjećaje u slikovite likove koji govore. Uz pomoć prijatelja iz svijeta svojih crteža - Ljamu, Noasaura, Mišu, Rafija, Tanga i Palči - Pablo lakše poima svoj stvarni svijet petogodišnjaka. "Pablo" odaje počast individualnosti i razmišljanju na drukčiji način, kao prva dječja serija na svijetu s autističnim glavnim likom. Svaka priča oslikava stvarna životna iskustva djece s autizmom, koja su sudjelovala u osmišljavanju priča i pisanju scenarija. R.: David McGrath Ul.: Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Oliver Burns (Pablo), William Burns (Pablo), Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus)...

programme.title: Bitz i Bob / Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bob - (E42, feature series, England, 2018) In the children's series Bitz and Bob, we follow the adventures of the girl inventor Bitz and her younger brother Bob. She embodies the new strong girl and is fascinated by all innovative things and activities related to science, technology, art and mathematics. The goal of this series is to encourage girls and boys to do their own research, to be ambitious and to come up with different ways to solve any problem. Cilj ove serije je poticanje djevojčica i dječaka da sami istražuju, da budu ambiciozni i osmišljavaju razne načine s ciljem da riješe bilo koji problem. R.: Kitty Taylor Ul.: Rob Delaney (Bevel)...

Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: Grizzy et les Lemmings - (S03, E29, Drama, France) Grizzly Bear and the Lemmings is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the lemmings, who live in the log cabin of a forest ranger while he is away. The ranger's log cabin is the only trace of human civilization amidst the untamed wilderness of Canada's great nature reserve. As the ranger escapes, the grizzly bear claims her, because after all, bears are at the top of the food chain. After moving into the house, Grizzly enjoys all the benefits of a modern way of living - a comfortable bed, an air-conditioned space and a fully equipped kitchen. But he is not alone. A group of small creatures, lemmings, also move into it. Since Grizzlies and lemmings are not civilized enough for a peaceful coexistence, they try to outwit each other with various tricks and complete madness reigns in the house. Street: Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (Grizzy), Josselin Charier (Lemmings)... / Grizzy et les Lemmings - (S03, E29, igrana serija, Francuska) "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti - leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan. Rendžerova brvnara jedini je trag ljudske civilizacije usred neukroćene divljine velikog kanadskog rezervata prirode. Dok rendžer izbiva, medvjed Grizli je prisvaja, jer ipak su medvjedi na vrhu hranidbenog lanca. Nakon što se useli u kuću, Grizli uživa u svim blagodatima suvremenog načina stanovanja - udobnom ležaju, klimatiziranom prostoru i potpuno opremljenoj kuhinji. No nije sam. U nju se useljava i skupina malih stvorenja, leminga. Budući da Grizli i leminzi nisu dovoljno civilizirani za miran suživot, nastoje raznoraznim trikovima nadmudriti jedni druge te kućom zavlada potpuno ludilo. Ul.: Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (Grizzy), Josselin Charier (Lemmings)...

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: Dino Ranch - (S02, E35, Drama, Canada, 2023) Tango is celebrating her birthday, and Miguel and the Dinoranchers have prepared a series of her favorite activities. But the plans are disrupted when they rescue a small triceratops, whom they name Tonko. All of Tango's favorite games are loud and fierce, but unfortunately too intense for little Tonko, so the Dinoranchers decide to adapt the celebration and make it gentler, which upsets Tango. Convinced that everyone cares more about Tonko than she does, Tango runs off to Breakwater Gorge to have fun smashing rocks, but Tonko, who adores Tango, follows her and ends up trapped in a rockfall! Tango immediately calls the Dinoranchers for help, realizing that this time she will have to be gentle in order to save her friend. Once Tonko is safe again, Tango realizes how special this lively little triceratops is and manages to enjoy the birthday party with him. R.: Bill Speers Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)... / Dino Ranch - (S02, E35, igrana serija, Kanada, 2023) Tango slavi rođendan, a Miguel i Dinorančeri pripremili su niz njezinih omiljenih aktivnosti. No planovi se poremete kada spase malog triceratopsa kojem daju ime Tonko. Sve Tangine omiljene igre su glasne i žestoke, ali nažalost prežestoke za malog Tonka, pa Dinorančeri odluče prilagoditi proslavu i učiniti je nježnijom, što uzruja Tango. Uvjerena da svima više stalo do Tonka nego do nje, Tango pobjegne u Lomni klanac da se zabavi razbijajući stijene, ali Tonko, koji obožava Tango, krene za njom i završi zarobljen u odronu kamenja! Tango odmah pozove Dinorančere u pomoć, shvaćajući da će ovaj put morati biti nježna kako bi spasila prijatelja. Kada je Tonko ponovno na sigurnom, Tango shvaća koliko je ovaj živahni mali triceratops poseban i uspijeva zajedno s njim uživati u rođendanskoj proslavi. R.: Bill Speers Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)...

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: PAW Patrol - (S09, E10, animated series, USA, 2022) The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. Each dog has special skills associated with emergency service professions, so members of the family include a firefighter, a policeman and an airman. They all live in doghouses that transform into vehicles adapted to their tasks. They are also equipped with special "dog backpacks" in which they carry all the tools needed for "dog jobs". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Christian Corrao (Marshall), Lucien Duncan Reid (Rubble), Kai Harris (Ryder), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase)... / PAW Patrol - (S09, E10, anim. serija, SAD, 2022) Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay. Svaki pas ima posebne vještine povezane s profesijama hitne službe, pa su članovi družine vatrogasac, policajac i zrakoplovac. Svi žive u psećim kućicama koje se preoblikuju u vozila prilagođena njihovim zadacima. Također su opremljeni posebnim "psećim ruksacima" u kojima nose sve alate potrebne za "pseće poslove". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Christian Corrao (Marshall), Lucien Duncan Reid (Rubble), Kai Harris (Ryder), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase)...

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: Juhuhu - (children's program, Croatia) JUHUHU is a children's morning program that includes cartoons, domestic and foreign shows for children of early school and kindergarten age. Through the morning and cheerful content, the Juhuhu people are led by actor-hosts who are there to tell a story, be a company for morning exercise, brush their teeth with a magical Juhuhu toothbrush or to teach their viewers some new, so far unknown things about the universe, chickens, sheep, refrigerators, trumpets, cabbage, broccoli and the secrets of Juhuhu plushies. Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: The worst witch / Najgora vještica

Nothing has been the same for Mildred since that day, and after joining the Cackle School for Witches, she strives to improve her knowledge and skills. R.: Dirk Campbell Ul.: Bella Ramsey (Mildred Hubble), Megan Hughes (Maud Spellbody), Kelsey Calladine-Smith (Indigo Moon), Renee Castle (Adult Indigo Moon), Clare Higgins (Miss Cackle)... / The Worst Witch - (S04, E03, dječji program, Engleska, 2020) Mildred Hubble živi s majkom i vodi pomalo jednostavan i prilično uobičajen život. Sve dok jednog dana ne doživi neočekivani posjet od vještice po imenu Maud Spellbody. Ona je upoznaje sa svijetom čaranja. Od tog dana za Mildred ništa nije isto, a nakon pridruživanja školi za vještice Cackle, trudi se poboljšati svoje znanje i vještine. R.: Dirk Campbell Ul.: Bella Ramsey (Mildred Hubble), Megan Hughes (Maud Spellbody), Kelsey Calladine-Smith (Indigo Moon), Renee Castle (Adult Indigo Moon), Clare Higgins (Miss Cackle)...

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: Notes on language - (educational program, Croatia) We talk about the history of Esperanto, the people who created it, the reasons why it was created. It was well received in Croatia. From the beginning, enthusiasts have advocated learning that language of hope (which is the translation of the word Esperanto). The Zagreb school for learning Esperanto is also famous. Literature was born on it, it was a bridge for the translation of works of small literature such as ours, you can pray on it, you can also sing. This is exactly what opera singer Neven Mrzlečki does in our show, who translated some of our famous songs into Esperanto. Prof. Ph.D. Velimir Piškorec talks inspiredly about his experiences in learning and speaking Esperanto, about the history of that language and the people who marked its history. Director: Goran Ribarić... / Bilješke o jeziku - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Govorimo o povijesti esperanta, o ljudima koji su ga stvorili, razlozima zašto je nastao. U Hrvatskoj je naišao na dobar prijem. Od početka su se entuzijasti zauzimali za učenje toga jezika nade (što je prijevod riječi esperanto). Poznata je i zagrebačka škola učenja esperanta. Na njemu je nastala književnost, bio je most za prevođenje djela malih književnosti kakva je naša, na njemu se može i moliti, može se i pjevati. Upravo to u našoj emisiji radi operni pjevač Neven Mrzlečki koji je na esperanto preveo neke naše poznate pjesme. Prof. dr. sc. Velimir Piškorec nadahnuto govori o svojim iskustvima u učenju i govorenju esperanta, o povijesti toga jezika i ljudima koji su njegovu povijest obilježili. R.: Goran Ribarić...

programme.title: Tern around the world / Čigrom oko svijeta
programme.desc: A tern around the world - (E01, nature film, Croatia, 2002) Croatian tern and Mladen Šutej sail the seas of the world. In the first five episodes, we will follow the sailing from Biograd, through the Mediterranean, Gibraltar, Portugal, Tenerife, the Atlantic Ocean, the Caribbean, the Panama Canal and the Galapagos. With the help of good winds, self-sacrificing crews and experienced skippers, the Croatian Tern sailed to some of the most interesting parts of the world. In addition to the sailboat built in the shipyard in Kraljevica, we will also see Gibraltar and the port of Tangier in Morocco. We will see what it means to sail across the ocean, when for 25 days there is nothing but wind, sun and endless open sea. After a short stay in the Caribbean, Tern passed through the architectural wonder - the Panama Canal, and we will also see two faces of Panama City and experience a stay on one of the most interesting natural phenomena - the Galapagos Islands. In the first episode of "Doors of the Atlantic", the Croatian tern left Biograd, sailed across the Mediterranean and takes us to Gibraltar, Tangier in Morocco and the port of Cadiz, which was the main Spanish starting point for conquests in America. In Villamoura, a fashionable Portuguese resort on the Costa Algarve, Čigraši hung out with the future winner of the non-stop regatta "The Race", and we will also see one of the most beautiful Portuguese cities, Cascais, in the suburbs of Lisbon. R.: Tanja Kanceljak... / Čigrom oko svijeta - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2002) Hrvatska čigra i Mladen Šutej jedre svjetskim morima. U prvih pet epizoda pratit ćemo plovidbu od Biograda, preko Sredozemlja, Gibraltara, Portugala, Teneriffa, Atlantskog oceana, Kariba, Panamskog kanala i Galapagosa. Uz pomoć dobroga vjetra, požrtvovnih posada i iskusnih skipera, Hrvatska čigra doplovila je do nekih od najzanimljivijih dijelova svijeta. Osim jedrilice izgrađene u brodogradilištu u Kraljevici, vidjet ćemo i Gibraltar i luku Tanger u Maroku. Vidjet ćemo što znači plovidba preko oceana, kada 25 dana nema ničeg drugog osim vjetra, sunca i beskraja pučine. Nakon kratkog boravka na Karibima, Čigra je prošla kroz graditeljsko čudo - Panamski kanal, a vidjet ćemo i dva lica grada Paname te doživjeti boravak na jednom od najzanimljivijih prirodnih fenomena - otočju Galapagos. U prvoj epizodi "Vrata Atlantika" Hrvatska čigra napustila je Biograd, prejedrila Sredozemlje i vodi nas u Gibraltar, Tanger u Maroku te luku Cadiz koja je bila glavno španjolsko polazište za osvajačke pohode u Ameriku. U Villamouri, mondenom portugalskom ljetovalištu na Costi Algarve, Čigraši su se družili s budućim pobjednikom non-stop regate "The Race", a vidjet ćemo i jedan od najljepših portugalskih gradova Cascais, u predgrađu Lisabona. R.: Tanja Kanceljak...

programme.title: The World As It Was: Klonimir's Film Records / Svijet kakav je nekad bio: Klonimirovi filmski zapisi
programme.desc: The world as it once was: Klonimir's film records - (E01, nature film, Croatia) After making the documentary "All Klonimir's Decades" about the navigator and flight engineer Klonimir Seršić (Baška, Krk, 1925 - Zagreb, 2021), director Mladen Santrić decided to process his unusual film legacy. It is about a selection of film recordings that Klonimir recorded all over the world in the period from 1960 to 1980. Considering the passage of time, the cycle is a valuable testimony of "the world as it once was", and it consists of sixty short films from Europe, Australia, Canada, the USA, Africa and Asia. This peculiar "time machine" is a valuable film document about a time that new generations would otherwise not be able to experience... / Svijet kakav je nekad bio: Klonimirovi filmski zapisi - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska) Nakon što je o navigatoru i inženjeru letenja Klonimiru Seršiću (Baška, Krk, 1925. - Zagreb, 2021.) snimio dokumentarni film "Sva Klonimirova desetljeća", redatelj Mladen Santrić odlučio je obraditi njegovu neobičnu filmsku ostavštinu. Riječ je o izboru filmskih zapisa koje je Klonimir snimao po cijelom svijetu u razdoblju od 1960. do 1980. godine. Ciklus je s obzirom na protok vremena dragocjeno svjedočanstvo o "svijetu kakav je nekad bio", a čini ga šezdesetak kratkih filmova iz Europe, Australije, Kanade, SAD-a, Afrike i Azije. Ovaj osebujan "vremeplov" vrijedan je filmski dokument o vremenu koje nove generacije inače ne bi mogle doživjeti...

programme.title: Eagle vs. Shark / Orao protiv morskog psa
programme.desc: Eagle vs. Shark - (comedy, New Zealand, 2007) Lilly is a shy and somewhat unusual waitress. She falls in love with Jarrod, a video game geek. After bonding at a "favorite animal" themed party, Lilly follows Jarrod to his hometown, where he wants to confront a former school bully. During this journey, both discover their own insecurities and what it means to accept yourself and others. The film is known for its distinctive humor and style. Director: Taika Waititi Actor: Loren Horsley (Lily), Jemaine Clement (Jarrod), Joel Tobeck (Damon), Brian Sergent (Jonah), Craig Hall (Doug)... / Eagle vs. Shark - (komedija, Novi Zeland, 2007) Lilly je sramežljiva i pomalo neobična konobarica. Zaljubljuje se u Jarroda, mahera za videoigre. Nakon što se zbliže na zabavi na temu "omiljene životinje", Lilly prati Jarroda u njegov rodni grad, gdje se on želi suočiti s nekadašnjim školskim zlostavljačem. Tijekom tog putovanja oboje otkrivaju vlastite nesigurnosti i što znači prihvatiti sebe i druge. Film je poznat po osebujnom humoru i stilu. R.: Taika Waititi Ul.: Loren Horsley (Lily), Jemaine Clement (Jarrod), Joel Tobeck (Damon), Brian Sergent (Jonah), Craig Hall (Doug)...

programme.title: Stone Story - Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquities / Priča od kamena - Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine
programme.desc: A Story of Stone - The Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquity - (doc. film, Croatia, 2008) The Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquity celebrated its 55th anniversary in 2007. As a non-profit company, it has been taking care of the city walls and other Dubrovnik historical and cultural monuments for decades, preserving the values ​​that testify to the rich tradition and culture. The members of the Society are volunteers who take care of the city with care and expertise in times when it is increasingly difficult to preserve the true face of the stone city. In the show, we recall the past actions, we recall the recent ones in the maintenance of the Dubrovnik and Ston walls and the walls in Molunt and Cavtat, the restoration of the Sokol fortress and mills on the river Ljutoj, and more. The Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquity is a kind of civic consciousness and the conscience of Dubrovnik and still actively participates in the life of the City. R.: Tonko Jović... / Priča od kamena - Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2008) Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine godine 2007. obilježilo je 55. obljetnicu djelovanja. Kao neprofitabilno društvo, desetljećima skrbi o gradskim zidinama i drugim dubrovačkim povijesno-kulturnim spomenicima, čuvajući vrednote koje svjedoče o bogatoj tradiciji i kulturi. Članovi Društva su volonteri koji brižno i stručno skrbe o gradu u vremenima kada je sve teže sačuvati pravo lice kamenog grada. U emisiji se prisjećamo proteklih akcija, podsjećamo na novije u održavanju dubrovačkih i stonskih zidina te zidina u Moluntu i Cavtatu, obnovu tvrđave Sokol i mlinica na rijeci Ljutoj i drugo. Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine svojevrsna je građanska svijest i savjest Dubrovnika i još uvijek aktivno sudjeluje u životu Grada. R.: Tonko Jović...

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: ART - (art program, Croatia) Art - your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music... / ART - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Art - vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Outside the format - (art program, Croatia) We open topics that are not talked about enough in our cultural and public space. In the studio and through reports, we will shed light on intriguing events that change the traditional view of Croatian art and culture... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Otvaramo teme o kojima se u našem kulturnom i javnom prostoru ne govori dovoljno. U studiju i kroz reportaže osvijetlit ćemo intrigantne događaje koji mijenjaju uvriježeni pogled na hrvatsku umjetnosti i kulturu...

programme.title: Fever / Groznica
programme.desc: Rush! - (E05, show magazine, Australia, 2024) The episode explores the very essence of life - water. From the earliest civilizations to modern-day societies, water is a key thread that shapes our lives, cities and cultures. As we explore the life cycle of water, the rise of ancient civilizations, and the role of water in driving industrialization and sustaining livelihoods, we delve into the cultural, economic, and existential importance of water—exploring why it's aptly called the driving force of civilizations. R.: Rob Perry St.: Mark Backes (Commentary)... / Rush! - (E05, show magazin, Australija, 2024) Epizoda istražuje samu esenciju života - vodu. Od najranijih civilizacija do društava modernog doba, voda je ključna nit koja oblikuje naše živote, gradove i kulture. Dok otkrivamo životni ciklus vode, uspon drevnih civilizacija te ulogu vode u pokretanju industrijalizacije i održavanju sredstava za život, dubinski ispitujemo kulturnu, ekonomsku i egzistencijalnu važnost vode - istražujući zašto je prikladno nazivaju pokretačkom snagom civilizacija. R.: Rob Perry Ul.: Mark Backes (Kommentar)...

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E11, doc series, Germany, 2023) The wild west of France is surrounded by the sea. Brittany, with its often stormy weather and harsh climate, has a peculiar charm. Inland are deep forests and hilly wasteland, on the coast rugged steep slopes with extremely unusual rock formations, and in between beaches with white sand similar to the Caribbean. No place is more than 80 km from the coast. Most Bretons live from the sea and with the sea... / Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E11, dok. serija, Njemačka, 2023) Surovi zapad Francuske okružen je morem. Bretanja s često olujnim vremenom i oštrom klimom ima osebujan šarm. U unutrašnjosti se prostiru duboke šume i brežuljkasta pustopoljina, na obali krševite strme padine s krajnje neobičnim formacijama stijena, a između toga plaže s bijelim pijeskom nalik na karipske. Nijedno mjesto nije udaljeno od obale više od 80 km. Većina Bretonaca živi od mora i s morem...
