programme.title: Soloists, Ave Chamber Choir, Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT conducted by Ivo Lipanović - KD V. Lisinski / Solisti, Komorni zbor Ave, Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Ive Lipanovića - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Soloists, Ave Chamber Choir, Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT under the direction of Ivo Lipanović - KD V. Lisinski - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) Maestro Ivo Lipanović is one of our most outstanding conductors, and he comes to the Kanconijer cycle to conduct a symphonic program with soloists and choir. Opera music is represented by the famous orchestral fragment - Dance with Seven Veils from Salome by Richard Strauss, which musicologist and Strauss biographer Ernst Krause claimed "establishes a modern musical formula for the representation of ecstatic sensual desire and brings it to perfection". In 1927, Krešimir Baranović, a composer whose music is woven into the foundations of the national direction of Croatian music in the 20th century, reached for the verses of Fran Galović from the collection Z mojih bregov. The poems from that collection are considered the beginning of new Kajkavian poetry, and Baranović chose three poems - Pozdravlenje, Međaš and Kum Martin. Lavishly set to music for baritone and orchestra, they evoke a wide range of images: from village idylls, customs and atmosphere, through the actions and feelings of individuals, to hidden expressions of nostalgia, anxiety, loneliness and transience. Baritone Matija Meić, who is building a successful career in Germany, will be joined in the second part of the concert by soprano Valentina Fijačko Kobić, champion of the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, and tenor Filip Filipović, soloist of the same theater company. Their collaboration will also be the highlight of this program, which brings the monumental symphony Bells by Sergei Rachmaninoff. The work contains verses of the poem of the same name by E. A. Poe in a free translation into Russian, and is also a dedication to Russian church bells and the way they accompany human life. The expanded composition of the orchestra vividly evokes campanological symbols for different types of bells: Christmas bells, wedding bells, alarm bells and funeral bells. Director: Vesna Fijačko Fodor... / Solisti, Komorni zbor Ave, Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Ive Lipanovića - KD V. Lisinski - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Maestro Ivo Lipanović jedan je od naših najistaknutijih dirigenata, a u ciklus Kanconijer dolazi kako bi ravnao simfonijskim programom uz soliste i zbor. Operna glazba zastupljena je glasovitim orkestralnim ulomkom - Plesom sa sedam velova iz Salome Richarda Straussa, za koji je muzikolog i Straussov biograf Ernst Krause ustvrdio da "uspostavlja modernu glazbenu formulu za prikaz ekstatične senzualne želje te ju dovodi do savršenstva". Skladatelj čija je glazba utkana u temelje nacionalnog smjera hrvatske glazbe 20. stoljeća, Krešimir Baranović, 1927. posegnuo je za stihovima Frana Galovića iz zbirke Z mojih bregov. Pjesme iz te zbirke smatraju se začetkom novije kajkavske poezije, a Baranović je izabrao tri pjesme - Pozdravlenje, Međaš i Kum Martin. Raskošno uglazbljene za bariton i orkestar evociraju široku paletu slika: od seoske idile, običaja i ozračja, preko postupaka i osjećaja pojedinaca, do skrovitih izraza nostalgije, tjeskobe, samoće i prolaznosti. Baritonu Matiji Meiću, koji gradi uspješnu karijeru u Njemačkoj, u drugome dijelu koncerta pridružit će se sopranistica Valentina Fijačko Kobić, prvakinja Hrvatskog narodnog kazalište u Zagrebu, i tenor Filip Filipović, solist iste kazališne kuće. Njihova suradnja bit će ujedno vrhunac ovoga programa koji donosi monumentalna simfonija Zvona Sergeja Rahmanjinova. Djelo sadrži stihove istoimene pjesme E. A. Poea u slobodnom prijevodu na ruski jezik te je ujedno posveta ruskim crkvenim zvonima i načinu na koji prate ljudski život. Prošireni sastav orkestra slikovito dočarava kampanološke simbole za različite tipove zvona: božićne zvončiće, svadbena zvona, zvona za uzbunu i pogrebna zvona. R.: Vesna Fijačko Fodor...

programme.title: A conversation with a reason / Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Conversation with a reason - (art program, Croatia) The guest of the show Conversation with a reason is sociologist and political scientist Dražen Lalić. He will discover why his family history became an obsession that he could not let go of, but had to dive into it and write the book Two Houses Above the Sea. We will discuss the differences between the different levels of memory culture - private, family and collective - and why Lalić believes that the traumas of the Second World War are still unhealed. How should we as a society deal with divisions and why is empathy even for victims "on the other side" important? The book, which tells about all of us through the story of two Dalmatian families, is the reason for this conversation with Dražen Lalić. R.: Siniša Hajduk... / Razgovor s razlogom - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je sociolog i politolog Dražen Lalić. Otkrivat će zašto mu je obiteljska povijest postala opsesija koju nije mogao pustiti, već je morao zaroniti u nju i napisati knjigu Dvije kuće iznad mora. Razgovarat ćemo o razlikama između različitih razina kulture sjećanja - privatne, obiteljske i kolektivne - te o tome zašto Lalić smatra da su traume iz Drugog svjetskog rata i dalje neizliječene. Kako se kao društvo trebamo nositi s podjelama i zašto je važna empatija čak i prema žrtvama "s druge strane"? Knjiga, koja kroz priču o dvjema dalmatinskim obiteljima govori o svima nama, razlog je za ovaj razgovor s Draženom Lalićem. R.: Siniša Hajduk...

programme.title: Messi from Baghdad / Messi iz Bagdada
programme.desc: Baghdad Messi - (drama, Belgium, 2023) In war-torn Baghdad in 2009, eleven-year-old Hammoudi lives for football and dreams of one day becoming a football champion like his idol Lionel Messi. His world collapses when he loses his leg in an attack, and with it the possibility to play the way he always dreamed. Despite the tragedy, the guilt of his parents and the dangers of everyday life in a war-torn city, Hamudi does not lose his passion for football. His fight for a dream becomes a story of courage, hope and an indestructible love for the game that guides him through the darkest moments. Director: Sahim Omar Kalifa Street: Atheer Adel (Kadhim), Zahraa Ghandour (Salwa), Hussein Hassan Ali (Bahoz), Errol Trotman-Harewood (Duncan), Saman Mustefa (Issmet)... / Baghdad Messi - (drama, Belgija, 2023) U ratom razorom Bagdadu 2009. godine, jedanaestogodišnji Hamudi živi za nogomet i sanja o tome da jednog dana postane nogometni prvak poput svog idola Lionela Messija. Njegov svijet se urušava kada u napadu gubi nogu, a s njom i mogućnost da igra onako kako je oduvijek sanjao. Unatoč tragediji, krivnji roditelja i opasnostima svakodnevnog života u ratom pogođenom gradu, Hamudi ne gubi strast prema nogometu. Njegova borba za san postaje priča o hrabrosti, nadi i neuništivoj ljubavi prema igri koja ga vodi kroz najmračnije trenutke. R.: Sahim Omar Kalifa Ul.: Atheer Adel (Kadhim), Zahraa Ghandour (Salwa), Hussein Hassan Ali (Bahoz), Errol Trotman-Harewood (Duncan), Saman Mustefa (Issmet)...

programme.title: The Simpsons / Simpsoni
programme.desc: The Simpsons - (S33, E19, cartoon series, USA, 2022) The Simpsons, the longest-running animated series, a cultural institution with an extremely loyal and dedicated fan base. Intelligently written, subversively humorous and endearingly witty, the series makes fun of the environment, but also itself. She is the winner of numerous awards. In addition, The Simpsons are the current owners of two Guinness records, as the longest-running animated series and the series with the most guest stars. The Simpson family consists of: father Homer, who works as a safety inspector at the local nuclear power plant, mother Marge, who tries to keep the peace in the family, mischievous ten-year-old Bart, intelligent saxophonist eight-year-old Lisa, and the youngest Maggie, who expresses her emotions by blowing. Over time, viewers got to know and love the remaining rich and often unusual world of characters living in Springfield. The Simpsons, created by animator Matt Groening, first appeared in 1987 as a series of 30-second short stories produced by Groening for The Tracy Ullman Show. They soon got their own series, first airing in a Christmas special on December 17, 1989, and then in regular time on January 14, 1990. They have their own star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, and on May 1, 2005, America's Funniest Family celebrated its then-record 350th episode. R.: Matthew Nastuk Ul.: Dan Castellaneta (Party Guy / Squeaky Voiced Teen / Homer Simpson), Julie Kavner (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Maggie Simpson / Bart Simpson), Yeardley Smith (Lisa Simpson), Hank Azaria (Instrumental Crowd / Barfing Belgian Munk / Johnny Joe / Chief Wiggum / Superintendent Chalmers)... / The Simpsons - (S33, E19, crt. serija, SAD, 2022) Simpsoni, animirana serija s najduljim stažem emitiranja, kulturne institucije s izuzetno odanim i predanim krugom obožavatelja. Inteligentno pisana, subverzivno humoristična i simpatično duhovita, serija ismijava okolinu, ali i samu sebe. Dobitnica je brojnih nagrada. Simpsoni su uz to trenutačni vlasnici dva Guinnesova rekorda i to kao najdulje emitirana animirana serija i serija s najviše ugošćenih zvijezda. Obitelj Simpson čine: otac Homer, koji radi kao inspektor zaštite na radu u mjesnoj nuklearnoj elektrani, majka Marge, koja pokušava zadržati mir u obitelji, nestašni desetogodišnjak Bart, inteligentna saksofonistica osmogodišnja Lisa i najmanja Maggie, koja emocije izražava dudanjem. Gledatelji su s vremenom upoznali i zavoljeli preostali bogati i nerijetko neobični svijet likova koji žive u Springfieldu.Simpsoni, koje je osmislio animator Matt Groening, prvi su se put pojavili 1987. kao serija kratkih priča u 30 sekunda koje je Groening producirao za The Tracy Ullman Show. Uskoro su dobili vlastitu seriju emitiravši se prvi put u božićnom specijalu 17. prosinca 1989., a zatim i u redovnom terminu 14. siječnja 1990. Posjeduju svoju zvijezdu na holivudskoj Stazi slavnih, a 1. svibnja 2005. američka najzabavnija obitelj proslavila je tada rekordnu 350. epizodu. R.: Matthew Nastuk Ul.: Dan Castellaneta (Party Guy / Squeaky Voiced Teen / Homer Simpson), Julie Kavner (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Maggie Simpson / Bart Simpson), Yeardley Smith (Lisa Simpson), Hank Azaria (Instrumental Crowd / Barfing Belgian Munk / Johnny Joe / Chief Wiggum / Superintendent Chalmers)...

programme.title: Minority mosaic / Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: Minority mosaic - (educational film, Croatia) They came from Bosnia for work. In the blazing dawn, they entered the facilities of the Sisak Ironworks and built a better tomorrow. That tomorrow has long been in the past that Sajo, Edo, Mirsad remember... All of them in Caprago, that workers' settlement next to the ironworks, lived through both the most beautiful years of the industrial boom and the most difficult moments of the collapse of the ironworks. Today, Caprag is at a new beginning. There is no industry, but there is a desire for this multinational city within the city to breathe again. Author: Mario Beganović Cinematographer: Ivan Brezovec Editor: Nina Koletić Project editor: Mario Beganović... / Manjinski mozaik - (obrazovni film, Hrvatska) Dolazili su iz Bosne za poslom. U plamenim zorama ulazili su u pogone željezare Sisak i gradili neko bolje sutra. To sutra odavno je već prošlost koje se prisjećaju Sajo, Edo, Mirsad... Svi su oni u Capragu, tom radničkom naselju uz željezaru, proživjeli i najljepše godine industrijskog uzleta i najteže trenutke raspada željezare. Danas je Caprag na nekom novom početku. Industrije nema, ali ima želje da taj multinacionalni grad u gradu ponovno prodiše punim plućima. Autor: Mario Beganović Snimatelj: Ivan Brezovec Montažerka: Nina Koletić Urednik projekta: Mario Beganović...

With Haifa’s reappearance, Youssef decides to reconcile his calculations, marry her, and forgive her, while fire breaks out between Dima and Majed and they divorce, and Sahar decides to take revenge on everyone who caused her son’s death. / ما بين ليلة وضحاها تتبدل الأحوال في هذ الجزء، فمع عودة هيفاء للظهور مرة أخرى يقرر يوسف إعادة حساباته والزواج منها ومسامحتها، في حين تشتعل النيران بين ديما وماجد ويقع الطلاق بينهما، وتقرر سحر الانتقام من كل من تسبب في وفاة ابنها.

programme.title: To be jealous / Kıskanmak
programme.desc: The events revolve around Siniha, who grew up in a wealthy family devoid of affection. She finds herself forced to confront her past while seeking to determine her destiny, identity, and being. However, envy and jealousy creep into all of her relationships, turning her life upside down. / تدور الأحداث حول (سينيهة)، التي نشأت في عائلة ثرية خالية من المودة، وتجد نفسها مضطرة لمواجهة ماضيها بينما تسعى لتحديد مصيرها وهويتها وكيانها، لكن الحسد والغيرة يتسللان إلى كل علاقاتها، ويقلبان حياتها رأسًا على عقب.

programme.title: His eyes are Black Sea / Gozleri Karadeniz
programme.desc: A young man from the Black Sea discovers that he is the heir to a powerful and influential Turkish family, and as he delves into the dark depths of Istanbul in search of answers about his past, he encounters a complex web of familial rivalry and forbidden romance. / يكتشف شاب من البحر الأسود أنه وريث عائلة تركية قوية وذات نفوذ، وبينما يغوص في أعماق إسطنبول المظلمة باحثًا عن إجابات حول ماضيه، يواجه شبكة معقدة من التنافس العائلي والرومانسية المحرمة.

programme.title: Far City / Uzak Sehir
programme.desc: A woman arrives with her son to her late husband's homeland to bury his body and leave in peace, but his influential family prevents her from leaving and fights occur that reveal many dark secrets. / تصل امرأة مع ابنها إلى موطن زوجها الراحل لدفن جثمانه والمغادرة بسلام، لكن عائلته ذات النفوذ تمنعها من المغادرة وتحدث معارك تُظهر الكثير من الأسرار المظلمة.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets
programme.desc: The work takes place in a dramatic context, as a lawyer and a prosecutor must work together to investigate a murder to find the killer, which creates an irreversible breaking point in their lives. / يدور العمل في إطار درامي، حيث يتعين على محامي ومدعي العام العمل معًا بالتحقيق في جريمة قتل للعثور على القاتل، مما يخلق نقطة انهيار لا رجعة فيها في حياتهما.

programme.title: Mother forty-four / أم أربعة وأربعين
programme.desc: Eight 44-year-old women face many life challenges together, on the familial, emotional, and professional levels, and each one of them seeks to enhance stability in her life at all levels, and achieve her ambitions before it is too late. / تخوض ثماني نساء في الرابعة والأربعين من العمر العديد من التحديات الحياتية معًا، على المستوى الأسري والعاطفي والمهني، وتسعى كل واحدة منهن لتعزيز الاستقرار في حياتها على كافة الأصعدة، وتحقيق طموحاتها قبل فوات الأوان.

programme.desc: Eight 44-year-old women face many life challenges together, on the familial, emotional, and professional levels, and each one of them seeks to enhance stability in her life at all levels, and achieve her ambitions before it is too late. / تخوض ثماني نساء في الرابعة والأربعين من العمر العديد من التحديات الحياتية معًا، على المستوى الأسري والعاطفي والمهني، وتسعى كل واحدة منهن لتعزيز الاستقرار في حياتها على كافة الأصعدة، وتحقيق طموحاتها قبل فوات الأوان.

programme.title: Nothing But Thirty / Nothing But Thirty
programme.desc: The events of the series follow the story of three women and the pressures and responsibilities they face in life as their ideas change at the age of thirty. / تتبع أحداث المسلسل قصة ثلاث سيدات وما يواجهن من ضغوطات ومسئوليات في الحياة مع تغير أفكارهن في سن الثلاثين.

programme.title: Far City / Uzak Sehir
programme.desc: A woman arrives with her son to her late husband's homeland to bury his body and leave in peace, but his influential family prevents her from leaving and fights occur that reveal many dark secrets. / تصل امرأة مع ابنها إلى موطن زوجها الراحل لدفن جثمانه والمغادرة بسلام، لكن عائلته ذات النفوذ تمنعها من المغادرة وتحدث معارك تُظهر الكثير من الأسرار المظلمة.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets
programme.desc: The work takes place in a dramatic context, as a lawyer and a prosecutor must work together to investigate a murder to find the killer, which creates an irreversible breaking point in their lives. / يدور العمل في إطار درامي، حيث يتعين على محامي ومدعي العام العمل معًا بالتحقيق في جريمة قتل للعثور على القاتل، مما يخلق نقطة انهيار لا رجعة فيها في حياتهما.

programme.title: To be jealous / Kıskanmak
programme.desc: The events revolve around Siniha, who grew up in a wealthy family devoid of affection. She finds herself forced to confront her past while seeking to determine her destiny, identity, and being. However, envy and jealousy creep into all of her relationships, turning her life upside down. / تدور الأحداث حول (سينيهة)، التي نشأت في عائلة ثرية خالية من المودة، وتجد نفسها مضطرة لمواجهة ماضيها بينما تسعى لتحديد مصيرها وهويتها وكيانها، لكن الحسد والغيرة يتسللان إلى كل علاقاتها، ويقلبان حياتها رأسًا على عقب.

programme.title: His eyes are Black Sea / Gozleri Karadeniz
programme.desc: A young man from the Black Sea discovers that he is the heir to a powerful and influential Turkish family, and as he delves into the dark depths of Istanbul in search of answers about his past, he encounters a complex web of familial rivalry and forbidden romance. / يكتشف شاب من البحر الأسود أنه وريث عائلة تركية قوية وذات نفوذ، وبينما يغوص في أعماق إسطنبول المظلمة باحثًا عن إجابات حول ماضيه، يواجه شبكة معقدة من التنافس العائلي والرومانسية المحرمة.

programme.title: Zahra Salon / صالون زهرة
programme.desc: Incorrectly, chairs arrive instead of other chairs for “Zahra Salon” from a furniture store, and inside these chairs are smuggled dollars, so Anas, the owner of the furniture store, seeks to enter the neighborhood to get the money. / بشكل خاطئ تصل كراسي بدلاً عن كراسي أخرى لـ "صالون زهرة" من محّل مفروشات، ويكون داخل الكراسي هذه دولارات مهرّبة، فيسعى أنس صاحب محل المفروشات الدخول إلى الحي للحصول على الأموال.

programme.title: Except me, part 2 / إلا أنا ج2
programme.desc: A drama inspired by life stories. Each story is presented in ten episodes that discusses issues of concern to society in general and women’s issues in particular, and revolves around several stories, including (The House of Glory), (My Story with Time), and (A Taste of the World). / دراما مستوحاة من قصص الحياة، كل قصة تقدم في عشر حلقات تناقش قضايا تهم المجتمع بصفة عامة وقضايا المرأة بصفة خاصة، وتدور في عدة حكايات منها (بيت العز) و(حكايتي مع الزمان) و(طعم الدنيا).

programme.title: Far City / Uzak Sehir
programme.desc: A woman arrives with her son to her late husband's homeland to bury his body and leave in peace, but his influential family prevents her from leaving and fights occur that reveal many dark secrets. / تصل امرأة مع ابنها إلى موطن زوجها الراحل لدفن جثمانه والمغادرة بسلام، لكن عائلته ذات النفوذ تمنعها من المغادرة وتحدث معارك تُظهر الكثير من الأسرار المظلمة.

programme.title: Rock Paper Scissors / Tas Kagit Makas
programme.desc: In a dramatic context, a cleaner who suffers from Alzheimer's is accused of murder, and his son, who has an uncanny memory, must help him, because he has become his last hope of survival and proving his innocence in the face of a family that has great influence in Istanbul. / في إطار درامي، يتعرض عامل نظافة مريض بالزهايمر لاتهام بالقتل، ويجب على ابنه صاحب الذاكرة الخارقة أن يساعده، لأنه أصبح أمله الأخير في النجاة، وإثبات براءته في مواجهة عائلة لديها نفوذ كبير في إسطنبول.

programme.title: Birth certificate part 2 / شهادة ميلاد ج2
programme.desc: In the second season, Narges discovers that Kulthum and Qasim are not her real parents, and that she was replaced with another child when she was born. Then there are dramatic consequences as a result of this, and events follow. / في الموسم الثاني، تكتشف (نرجس) بأن (كلثوم) و(قاسم) ليسا أبويها الحقيقيين، وأنه تم تبديلها بمولود آخر حين ولادتها. ثم تحدث تبعات مثيرة نتيجة لهذا الأمر وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Apartment works / أشغال شقة
programme.desc: Hamdi Abdel Rahim, a forensic medicine specialist, and his wife are giving birth to twins after a while of their marriage. They decide to hire a house manager to care for the twins, but they suffer greatly in their search for a house manager to care for the two children. / يُرزق (حمدي عبدالرحيم) أخصائي الطب الشرعي وزوجته بتوأمين بعد فترة من زواجهما، ويقرران اﻻستعانة بمديرة منزل لرعاية التوأمين، ولكنهما يعانيان بشدة في رحلة البحث عن مديرة منزل لرعاية الطفلين.

programme.title: Dirty Laundry / Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: Within a comedy-drama framework, the series deals with the lives of the richest and most powerful families in Istanbul, and their maids who are exposed to the secrets, mysteries, and crimes hidden behind the closed doors of these homes, and often become parts of them. / في إطار درامي كوميدي، يتناول المسلسل حياة أغنى وأقوى العائلات في إسطنبول، وخادماتهم اللاتي يتعرضن للأسرار والألغاز والجرائم المخبأة خلف أبواب هذه المنازل المغلقة، وغالبًا ما يصبحن أجزاء منها.

programme.title: Dream team / فريق الحلم
days / أيام
programme.desc: In a dramatic context, the series deals with the story of (Abeer) who lives in the house of her uncle (Riyad Abu Al-Dahab) and in his care after she became an orphan, but (Riyad)’s wife tries to keep (Abeer) away from her uncle’s house, hoping to seize his wealth. / في إطار درامي، يتناول المسلسل قصة (عبير) التي تعيش في بيت عمها (رياض أبو الدهب) وفي رعايته بعدما أصبحت يتيمة، لكن زوجة (رياض) تحاول إبعاد (عبير) عن بيت عمها طمعًا في اﻻستيلاء على ثروته.

programme.title: Birth certificate part 2 / شهادة ميلاد ج2

programme.title: Who is this? / Woh Toh Hai Albelaa
programme.desc: (Krishna) is a cheerful brother who loves his two brothers and always stands by them, especially his older brother (Chiru), who does his best to keep him safe and protect him from any harm. Then his life turns upside down when circumstances force him to marry his lover (Chiru). / (كريشنا) هو أخ مرح محب لشقيقيه ويقف بجانبهما دائمًا، وبالأخص شقيقه الأكبر (تشيرو) الذي يبذل قصارى جهده للحفاظ على سلامته وحمايته من أي مكروه، ثم تنقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب عندما تجبره الظروف على الزواج من حبيبة (تشيرو).

programme.title: The Unfaithful S2 / The Unfaithful S2
programme.desc: In the second part, Asya decides to move away from Tekirdag and travel to Istanbul to build a new life with her son, Ali, after what happened with her husband, but she meets Aras, who is involved in an accident on his way to Tekirdag. / في الجزء الثاني، تقرر (آسيا) الابتعاد عن (تيكيرداغ) والسفر إلى إسطنبول لبناء حياة جديدة مع ابنها (علي) بعد ما حدث مع زوجها، ولكنها تلتقي بـ(أراس) الذي يتعرض لحادث في طريقه إلى (تيكيرداغ).

programme.desc: After years of suffering, Rahma finds herself stuck in a toxic marriage. programme.title: Kaf Waduf / كف ودفوف
programme.desc: A social drama that takes place during the 1980s, in which Salima leads a women's singing group, but is forced to retire after the death of her husband, as hallucinations control her, and she believes that there is a jinn following her and putting her life and the life of her family at stake. / دراما اجتماعية تدور خلال ثمانينيات القرن الماضي، حيث سليمة التي تقود فرقة غنائية نسائية، ولكن تضطر للاعتزال بعد وفاة زوجها، حيث تُسيطر عليها الهلاوس، وتعتقد بوجود جن يتبعها ويجعل حياتها وحياة أسرتها على المحك.

programme.title: Gamma Island / جزيرة غمام
programme.desc: Khaldoun and Al-Ayqa Al-Ghajariya settle on Gammam Island and try to control the people of the island, thinking that it contains a treasure and a big secret that no one knows. They try to extend their influence to implement their plan. Will the people of the island confront them, led by Arafat, Al-Ajmi, and Muhareb? / يستقر خلدون والعايقة الغجرية في جزيرة غمام ويحاولان السيطرة على أهل الجزيرة ظنًا منهم أنها تحوي كنز وسر كبير لا يعلمه أحد ويحاولان بسط نفوذهم لتنفيذ مخططهم، فهل يتصدى أهل الجزيرة لهما بقيادة عرفات والعجمي ومحارب.

programme.title: Strange house / دار غريب
programme.desc: Gharib fights everyone, marries Asma, gives birth to his two daughters, Salwa and Nada, and lives happily with his family, until things change for him following the death of his wife, the marriage of his daughter Nada to Hamad without his knowledge, and the loss of all his money. / يحارب غريب الجميع ويتزوج من أسما، وينجب ابنتيه سلوى وندى، ويعيش في هناء مع أسرته، إلى أن تتبدل به الأحوال عقب وفاة زوجته، وزواج ابنته ندى دون علمه من حمد، وضياع كل أمواله.

programme.title: Hidden worlds / عوالم خفية
programme.desc: Coincidence leads veteran journalist Hilal Kamel to find the memoirs of an actress who was killed years ago, and the incident was recorded as a suicide. By reviewing the details of her memoirs, he was certain that she was killed by the corruption mafia, for fear of revealing their secrets through her memoirs that she decided to write in her last days, after the spotlight and fame moved away from her. programme.desc: Majed works as a principal at a private school for his grandmother, Laila, but he sees that he is not doing anything at school, so he seeks change, as well as in his private life because of the problems between him and his wife, Nora, and upon getting to know Layal, who works as a dog trainer and a musician in a restaurant, a number of paradoxes and situations begin between them. / يعمل ماجد مدير مدرسة خاصة عند جدته ليلى، لكنه يرى أنه لا يقوم بشيء في المدرسة فيسعى للتغيير، وكذلك في حياته الخاصة بسبب المشاكل التي بينه وبين زوجته نورا، وبتعرفه على ليال التي تعمل مدربة كلاب وعازفة في مطعم، تبدأ بينهما عدد من المفارقات والمواقف.

programme.title: Hidden worlds / عوالم خفية

programme.title: Habs / Habs
programme.desc: The events revolve around a young man and a young woman from two different social and cultural classes. programme.title: Strange house / دار غريب

programme.desc: In a context of crime and drama, after the death of their father, his three daughters must confront the richest man in their village who wants to buy their fields by force and by offering several temptations. / في إطار من الجريمة والدراما، وبعد وفاة والدهن، يتعين على بناته الثلاث مواجهة أغنى رجل في قريتهم الذي يريد شراء حقولهم بالقوة ومن خلال تقديم عدة مغريات.

programme.title: Gamma Island / جزيرة غمام
programme.desc: Khaldoun and Al-Ayqa Al-Ghajariya settle on Gammam Island and try to control the people of the island, thinking that it contains a treasure and a big secret that no one knows. They try to extend their influence to implement their plan. Will the people of the island confront them, led by Arafat, Al-Ajmi, and Muhareb? / يستقر خلدون والعايقة الغجرية في جزيرة غمام ويحاولان السيطرة على أهل الجزيرة ظنًا منهم أنها تحوي كنز وسر كبير لا يعلمه أحد ويحاولان بسط نفوذهم لتنفيذ مخططهم، فهل يتصدى أهل الجزيرة لهما بقيادة عرفات والعجمي ومحارب.

programme.title: Profa / بروفا
programme.desc: Majed works as a principal at a private school for his grandmother, Laila, but he sees that he is not doing anything at school, so he seeks change, as well as in his private life because of the problems between him and his wife, Nora, and upon getting to know Layal, who works as a dog trainer and a musician in a restaurant, a number of paradoxes and situations begin between them. / يعمل ماجد مدير مدرسة خاصة عند جدته ليلى، لكنه يرى أنه لا يقوم بشيء في المدرسة فيسعى للتغيير، وكذلك في حياته الخاصة بسبب المشاكل التي بينه وبين زوجته نورا، وبتعرفه على ليال التي تعمل مدربة كلاب وعازفة في مطعم، تبدأ بينهما عدد من المفارقات والمواقف.

programme.title: Hidden worlds / عوالم خفية
programme.desc: Coincidence leads veteran journalist Hilal Kamel to find the memoirs of an actress who was killed years ago, and the incident was recorded as a suicide. By reviewing the details of her memoirs, he was certain that she was killed by the corruption mafia, for fear of revealing their secrets through her memoirs that she decided to write in her last days, after the spotlight and fame moved away from her. By following up on the details of the written lines, letters, and symbols, Hilal decided to seek the help of a work team, especially after the corruption cases became widespread, the crimes varied, and the names increased, most of them belonging to highly influential figures, which put him personally in danger. / تقود الصُّدفة الصحفي المُخضرم هلال كامل إلى العثور على مذكرات ممثلة قُتلت منذ سنوات، وقُيّد الحادث على أنه حادث انتحار، وبمطالعته لتفاصيل مُذكراتها، تأكد من أنها قُتلت بيد مافيا الفساد، خوفًا من إفشاء أسرارهم من خلال مُذكراتها التي قررت كتابتها في أيامها الأخيرة، بعدما ابتعدت عنها الأضواء والشهرة. ومن خلال متابعته لتفاصيل السطور والحروف والرموز المكتوبة، قرر هلال الاستعانة بفريق عمل، خاصة بعدما تشعّبت قضايا الفساد، وتنوعت الجرائم، وكثرت الأسماء، وأغلبها لشخصيات ذات نفوذ كبير، ما يعرضه هو شخصيًا للخطر.

programme.title: Habs / Habs
programme.desc: The events revolve around a young man and a young woman from two different social and cultural classes. After their marriage, the differences between them increase due to interference from some parties, and bring them closer to divorce. / تدور الأحداث حول شاب وشابة من طبقتين اجتماعيتين وثقافيتين مختلفتين، وبعد زواجهما، تزيد بينهما الخلافات بسبب تدخلات من بعض الأطراف، وتجعلهما يقتربان من الطلاق.

programme.title: Strange house / دار غريب
programme.desc: Gharib fights everyone, marries Asma, gives birth to his two daughters, Salwa and Nada, and lives happily with his family, until things change for him following the death of his wife, the marriage of his daughter Nada to Hamad without his knowledge, and the loss of all his money. / يحارب غريب الجميع ويتزوج من أسما، وينجب ابنتيه سلوى وندى، ويعيش في هناء مع أسرته، إلى أن تتبدل به الأحوال عقب وفاة زوجته، وزواج ابنته ندى دون علمه من حمد، وضياع كل أمواله.

programme.title: Eviction order / أمر إخلاء
programme.desc: A family is exposed to a major disaster when the father loses his property. The family gradually declines and their lives are turned upside down in their new position, and they must deal with the new situation. / تتعرض عائلة لكارثة كبيرة، حينما يخسر الأب ممتلكاته، لتنحدر العائلة رويدًا رويدًا وتنقلب حياتهم رأسًا على عقب في مكانتهم الجديدة، وعليهم التعامل مع الوضع الجديد.

programme.title: Love game / لعبة حب
programme.desc: A rich young man falls in love with a poor girl, then later discovers that his relative and grandfather were the ones who paid money to the girl, taking advantage of her need, so that she could trap him in her net and marry her, and events continue. / يقع شاب ثري في حب فتاة فقيرة، ثم يكتشف لاحقًا أن قريبته وجده هما من دفعا المال إلى الفتاة استغلالًا لاحتياجها، لكي توقعه في شباكها ويتزوجها، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: I have the right to love / من حقي أحب
programme.desc: A romantic drama that revolves around an engineer and his wife who live a tense and unstable life to the point that they get into many disagreements together, and their lives become more disturbed after their friends interfere in it. / دراما رومانسية تدور حول مهندس وزوجته يعيشان حياة متوترة وغير مستقرة لدرجة دخولهما في خلافات كثيرة معا، وتضطرب حياتهما أكثر بعد تدخل أصدقاءهما فيها.

programme.title: Lost in Someones Love / Lost in Someones Love
programme.desc: In a dramatic context, Sai Joshi lives with her father and is a brave, honest and fair girl who aspires to become a doctor, but she finds herself in a family dilemma during which she is forced to marry a police officer. / في إطار درامي، تعيش ساي جوشي مع والدها وهي فتاة شجاعة وصادقة ونزيهة تطمح لأن تصبح طبيبة، ولكنها تجد نفسها في معضلة عائلية مجبرة خلالها على الزواج من ضابط شرطة.

programme.title: surplus / نوف
programme.desc: Nouf's family was killed in her childhood by Al-Sati, and she was raised by him until she became one of his knights, while Ghiyath seeks revenge on Al-Sati for his family, which was killed at his hands. Ghiyath soon falls in love with Nouf without knowing that she is the daughter of his fallen cousin. / تُقتل أسرة نوف في طفولتها على يد الساطي، وتتربى على يديه حتى تصير فارسة من فرسانه، فيما يسعى غياث للثأر من الساطي ﻷسرته التي قُتلت على يديه، وسرعان ما يقع غياث في حب نوف دون أن يدري أنها ابنة عمه الصريع.

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic setting, the wealthy and reckless businessman (Ashraf) falls in love with (Roya), whom he has been searching for a person like her all his life, but what he does not know is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

programme.title: Dirty Laundry / Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: Within a comedy-drama framework, the series deals with the lives of the richest and most powerful families in Istanbul, and their maids who are exposed to the secrets, mysteries, and crimes hidden behind the closed doors of these homes, and often become parts of them. / في إطار درامي كوميدي، يتناول المسلسل حياة أغنى وأقوى العائلات في إسطنبول، وخادماتهم اللاتي يتعرضن للأسرار والألغاز والجرائم المخبأة خلف أبواب هذه المنازل المغلقة، وغالبًا ما يصبحن أجزاء منها.

programme.title: Wild Bees / Wild Bees
programme.desc: In a context of crime and drama, after the death of their father, his three daughters must confront the richest man in their village who wants to buy their fields by force and by offering several temptations. / في إطار من الجريمة والدراما، وبعد وفاة والدهن، يتعين على بناته الثلاث مواجهة أغنى رجل في قريتهم الذي يريد شراء حقولهم بالقوة ومن خلال تقديم عدة مغريات.

programme.title: Take care Zizi / خلي بالك من زيزي
programme.desc: After her attempt to give birth again fails, disagreements arise between Zainab and her husband, Hisham, and the matter quickly develops into court and Zainab is in danger of losing everything besides motherhood. / بعد فشل محاولتها للإنجاب مجددا، تضرب الخلافات بين زينب وزوجها هشام، وسرعان ما يتطور الأمر لساحات القضاء وتصبح زينب في خطر بفقدان كل شيء بجانب الأمومة.

programme.title: Take care Zizi / خلي بالك من زيزي

programme.title: I have the right to love / من حقي أحب
programme.desc: A romantic drama that revolves around an engineer and his wife who live a tense and unstable life to the point that they get into many disagreements together, and their lives become more disturbed after their friends interfere in it. / دراما رومانسية تدور حول مهندس وزوجته يعيشان حياة متوترة وغير مستقرة لدرجة دخولهما في خلافات كثيرة معا، وتضطرب حياتهما أكثر بعد تدخل أصدقاءهما فيها.

programme.title: Lost in Someones Love / Lost in Someones Love

programme.title: surplus / نوف
programme.desc: Nouf's family was killed in her childhood by Al-Sati, and she was raised by him until she became one of his knights, while Ghiyath seeks revenge on Al-Sati for his family, which was killed at his hands. programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic setting, the wealthy and reckless businessman (Ashraf) falls in love with (Roya), whom he has been searching for a person like her all his life, but what he does not know is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

programme.title: Good morning, Egyptian / صباحك مصري
programme.desc: A daily program, concerned with everything that happens in Egypt daily, by presenting all types of political, economic, as well as social and artistic news, and trying to highlight and display positive models in society, and hosting an elite of decision makers in (Egypt) to discuss the problems and negatives of society, and how to solve them. / برنامج يومي، يهتم بكل ما يحدث في مصر يومياً، من خلال عرض جميع أنواع الأخبار سياسية، واقتصادية، وكذلك اجتماعية، وفنية، ومحاولة إبراز وعرض النماذج اﻹيجابية في المجتمع، واستضافة نخبة من صناع القرار في (مصر) لمناقشة المشكلات، وسلبيات المجتمع، وكيفية حلها.

programme.title: Heart to heart / من القلب للقلب
programme.desc: A social program that talks about topics related to charitable work and opens the door for viewers to participate through social networking sites. / برنامج اجتماعي، يتحدث عن موضوعات متعلقة بالأعمال الخيرية وفتح باب لمشاركة المشاهدين من خلال مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي.

programme.title: One hundred rejections / صد رد
programme.desc: The events of the series revolve around a comedy about three young friends (Kuno, Horus, and Bacteria) who live in a popular neighborhood. They try to get rid of the daily problems they face, but they fall into bigger problems again. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار كوميدي حول ثلاثة أصدقاء شباب (كونو وحورس وبكتيريا) يقيمون في حارة شعبية، يحاولون التخلص من المشاكل اليومية التي تواجههم، لكنهم يقعون مرة أخرى فى مشكلات أكبر.

programme.title: Dynasty / Vanshaj
programme.desc: The events of the series revolve around Yuvika, a girl who disagrees with her family over the issue of inheritance of the family business for male members and demands inheritance for the most worthy. / تدور احداث المسلسل حول (يوفيكا) الفتاة التي تختلف مع عائلتها حول مسألة وراثة أعمال العائلة للأعضاء الذكور وتطالب بالوراثة للأجدر.

programme.title: The price / الثمن
programme.desc: The widow Sarah resorts to her only remaining option to cover the costs of treating her son Ibrahim for cancer, so she agrees to spend one night with the company director, Zain, in exchange for a sum of money. / تلجأ الأرملة سارة لخيارها الوحيد المتبقي لتغطية تكاليف علاج ابنها إبراهيم من السرطان، فتوافق على قضاء ليلة واحدة مع مدير الشركة زين مقابل مبلغ من المال.

programme.title: Omar law / قانون عمر
programme.desc: The events revolve around a mechanical engineer named (Omar) who works in a car maintenance center. He falls in love with (Iman Al-Assi), the daughter of the owner of the maintenance center. Then he has an accident that turns his life upside down and puts him behind iron bars. However, he manages to escape and begins to prove his innocence. / تدور الأحداث حول مهندس ميكانيكي يٌدعى (عمر) يعمل في مركز صيانة سيارات، ويقع في حب (إيمان العاصي) ابنة صاحب مركز الصيانة، ثم يقع له حادث يقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب، ويزج به خلف القضبان الحديدية؛ إلا أنه يتمكن من الهرب، ويبدأ في إثبات برائته.

programme.title: The box / الصندوق
programme.desc: Reem celebrates her birthday, and she receives a gift: a box containing strange and incomprehensible contents and letters asking to save a person before he is killed. Curiosity drives the three friends Youssef, Reem, and Yassin to search and uncover the mystery of this box, so events continue in a context of suspense and mystery. / تحتفل ريم بيوم ميلادها، وتصلها هدية وهي صندوق بداخله محتويات غريبة وغير مفهومة ورسائل تطلب إنقاذ شخص قبل مقتله. يدفع الفضول الأصدقاء الثلاثة يوسف وريم وياسين للبحث وكشف غموض هذا الصندوق، لتتوالى الأحداث في إطار من التشويق والغموض.

programme.title: Parineetii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic context, as fate leads two close friends to marry the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and events follow one another. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Hello ladies / أهلا بالستات
programme.desc: A program broadcast on Sunday and Thursday on MBC Egypt, discussing everything related to modern women, and trying to find an answer to the well-known question: What are the things that women want? / برنامج يذاع الأحد والخميس على قناة إم بي سي مصر، يناقش كل ما يخص المراه العصرية، ومحاولة إيجاد إجابة السؤال المعروف، ما هي الأمور التي تريدها النساء؟.

programme.title: And she meets Habib / وتقابل حبيب
programme.desc: A wealthy woman discovers that her husband has betrayed her and married her. She decides to separate from him and search for a new love relationship, but she gets involved in various conflicts that she did not expect, and her life gradually changes. / تكتشف امرأة ثرية خيانة زوجها لها والزواج عليها، فتقرر الانفصال عنه وتبحث عن علاقة حب جديدة، لكنها تتورط في صراعات مختلفة لم تكن تتوقعها، وتتغير معها حياتها تدريجيًا.

programme.title: Selma / سلمى
programme.desc: The series deals with the story of Salma, a young mother facing life alone after her husband, Jalal, disappears under mysterious circumstances. She finds herself forced to raise her two children amid poverty, trauma, and loneliness, and her journey embodies a deeply human example of the suffering of Arab mothers who face the harshness of life with steadfastness. / يتناول المسلسل قصة سلمى، وهي أم شابة تواجه الحياة بمفردها بعد اختفاء زوجها جلال في ظروف غامضة. تجد نفسها مضطرة لتربية طفليها وسط الفقر والصدمات والوحدة، فتجسد رحلتها نموذجًا إنسانيًا عميقًا لمعاناة الأمهات العربيات اللواتي يواجهن قسوة الحياة بثبات.

programme.title: Tash return / طاش العودة
programme.desc: Within a satirical comedy-drama framework, the events of the series revolve around the issues and problems of Saudi society in particular, through separate, connected episodes that include envy, blackmail, and the corruption that occurs in government departments. / في إطار درامي كوميدي ساخر، تدور أحداث المسلسل عن قضايا ومشاكل المجتمع السعودي بشكل خاص، من خلال حلقات منفصلة متصلة تتضمن الحسد والابتزاز، وما يحدث في المصالح الحكومية من فساد.

programme.title: Mira and Salim / ميرا وسليم
programme.desc: Divorce threatens the lives of Mira and Selim, but Selim discovers that his wife is ill, prompting him to work to reignite their love relationship. As the love and secrets of the past return, their fragile relationship between love, loyalty and a second chance at life together is tested. / يهدد الطلاق حياة ميرا وسليم، لكن اكتشاف سليم مرض زوجته يدفعه للعمل على إعادة إشعال علاقة الحب بينهما. ومع عودة حب الماضي وأسراره، تُختبر علاقتهما الهشة بين الحب والوفاء وفرصة ثانية للحياة معًا.

programme.title: Our club program / برنامج نادينا
Anchorage / المرسى
programme.desc: Captain Sultan Al-Nahil works at sea and travels for long periods, which keeps him away from his wife and children for long periods. During one of his trips, he meets a woman named Nawal with whom he enters into a romantic relationship, and major conflicts arise between his love for her and his commitment to his wife, Khawla. Nawal tries to separate the captain from his family, and asks him to give up his past and his family. When he returns to his family, events begin to explode with clashes of duty. Family and emotional desire. / يعمل القبطان سلطان الناهل، في البحر ويسافر لفترات طويلة، ما يبعده عن زوجته وأولاده لفترات طويلة، خلال إحدى رحلاته، يلتقي بامرأة تُدعى نوال يدخل معها في علاقة عاطفية، فتُثار صراعات كبيرة بين حبه لها وبين التزامه تجاه زوجته خولة، تحاول نوال فصل القبطان عن عائلته، وتطلب منه التخلي عن ماضيه وعن أسرته، حين يعود إلى عائلته، تبدأ الأحداث تنفجر بصدامات بين الواجب العائلي والرغبة العاطفية.

programme.title: And she meets Habib / وتقابل حبيب
programme.desc: A wealthy woman discovers that her husband has betrayed her and married her. programme.title: My aunt's return / عودة خالتي
programme.desc: After Hamida devotes her life in the fashion world to creating her own empire, she is forced to face a new and dangerous world to save her sister Dalia's children from the problems they are involved in. / بعد أن كرست حميدة حياتها في عالم الموضة لتكوين إمبراطوريتها الخاصة، تضطر على تواجه عالما جديدا وخطيرا لإنقاذ أولاد شقيقتها داليا من المشاكل التي تورطوا فيها.

programme.title: Less than normal / أقل من عادي
programme.desc: Karim, the owner of a luxury hotel in Beirut, invites his daughter, Maya, from a previous marriage, to spend New Year's with his family, but his current wife, Sama, opposes her presence and plans to keep her away. Maya discovers her father's true intentions behind his invitation. / يدعو كريم، وهو صاحب فندق فخم في بيروت، ابنته مايا - من زواج سابق لقضاء رأس السنة مع عائلته، ولكن تعارض زوجته الحالية سما وجودها وتخطط لإبعادها، وتكتشف مايا نوايا والدها الحقيقة وراء دعوته تلك.

programme.desc: A daily morning program that discusses social problems that concern the Arab citizen. programme.title: Tears in the eyes of a slut / دموع في عيون وقحة
programme.desc: A story based on real events from the Egyptian spy files of one of the Egyptian intelligence operations against the Israeli Mossad, whose hero was in fact (Ahmed Muhammad Abd al-Rahman al-Hawan), who in the series became (Jumaa al-Shawan)... He is an Egyptian young man who grew up in a miserable social environment, carrying a heavy burden, which is to support his poor family, which consists of his kind, elderly mother, his blind wife, and his playboy brother.. while he was (Juma al-Shawan) He works in the port of Suez, and when he receives a tempting offer, he discovers that its source is the Israeli Mossad and the regular intelligence services, which aspire to recruit him to work as a spy for his homeland. Motivated by his patriotism and Egyptian affiliation, Jumaa Al-Shawan rushes to inform the Egyptian security services, and they ask him to continue playing the same role. To dictate to the enemy intelligence information, some of it true, some of it false, and events follow as he continues to work with the Israeli Mossad as a double agent for them inside Egypt for a full six years, until he is finally able to obtain the rarest and most dangerous broadcast transmitters in the world during that time, to write, with his intelligence and patriotism, one of the most wonderful chapters of Egyptian patriotism, directing a strong slap at the Israeli enemy. / قصة مبنية على أحداث حقيقية من ملفات الجاسوسية المصرية لإحدى عمليات المخابرات المصرية ضد الموساد الإسرائيلي، والتي كان بطلها في الحقيقة (أحمد محمد عبد الرحمن الهوان)، والذي أصبح في المسلسل (جمعة الشوان).. وهو شاب مصري نشأ في ظل بيئة اجتماعية بائسة، يحمل حملًا ثقيلًا، وهو إعالة عائلته الفقيرة، والتي تتكون من أمه الطيبة المسنة، زوجته الكفيفة، وشقيقه المستهتر.. بينما كان (جمعة الشوان) يعمل في ميناء (السويس) وإذا به يتلقى عرضًا مغريًا يكتشف أن مصدره هو الموساد الإسرائيلي وأجهزة المخابرات العادية، والتي تطمح في تجنيده ليعمل جاسوسًا على وطنه، وبدافع من وطنيته وانتمائه المصري يسارع (جمعة الشوان) إلى إبلاغ أجهزة الأمن المصرية، فيطلبون منه الاستمرار في لعب نفس الدور؛ ليُملي على مخابرات العدو معلومات بعضها صحيح، وبعضها زائف، وتتوالى الأحداث حيث يستمر في العمل مع الموساد الإسرائيلي كعميل مزدوج لهم داخل مصر لمدة ست سنوات كاملة، حتى يتمكن في النهاية من الحصول على أندر وأخطر أجهزة إرسال البث في العالم خلال ذلك الوقت، ليكتب بذكائه ووطنيته واحداً من أروع فصول الوطنية المصرية، موجهًا للعدو الإسرائيلي صفعة قوية.

programme.title: The driller / الحفار
programme.desc: After the occupation of the Sinai Peninsula by Israeli forces in 1967 and the outbreak of the War of Attrition, Israel announced that it would undertake expanded operations to explore for oil in Sinai and rent a rig to carry out this task. This matter has only one purpose, which is to show the Egyptian authorities as helpless and powerless in the face of what Israel is doing, which prompted Egyptian intelligence to plan to deal with the rig before it reaches Bab al-Mandab. / بعد احتلال شبه جزيرة سيناء من قبل القوات الإسرائيلية في عام 1967 واندلاع حرب الاستنزاف، أعلنت إسرائيل عن قيامها بعمليات موسعة للتنقيب عن البترول في سيناء وتأجير حفار للقيام بهذه المهمة، وهذا الأمر ليس له سوى غرض واحد، وهو إظهار السلطات المصرية بمظهر العاجز قليل الحيلة أمام ما تقوم به إسرائيل، وهو ما دفع المخابرات المصرية للتخطيط من أجل التعامل مع الحفار قبل وصوله إلى باب المندب.

programme.title: Tomorrow's World Program / برنامج العالم غدًا
The fall in Beersheba / السقوط في بئر سبع
programme.desc: The series revolves around a true story from the Egyptian intelligence files, about the recruitment of an Egyptian and his wife to spy for Israel. The story is based on the novel (Ibrahim and Inshrah) by journalist Abdel Rahman Fahmy. / يدور المسلسل حول قصة حقيقية من ملفات المخابرات المصرية، حول تجنيد مصري وزوجته للتجسس لصالح إسرائيل، القصة نقلًا عن رواية (إبراهيم وانشراح) للكاتب الصحفي عبدالرحمن فهمي.

programme.title: Third bulletin / نشرة الثالثة
Economics Program 24 / برنامج الاقتصاد 24
use / بكار
programme.desc: Bakkar is a Nubian child from southern Egypt. He lives with his mother in a Nubian village, and with his goat, Rashida. In each episode of the series, Bakkar embarks on a new adventure every time with his peers at school, whether inside or outside his village. / (بكار) طفل نوبي من جنوب (مصر)، يعيش مع والدته في إحدى قرى النوبة، ومع عنزته (رشيدة)، وفي كل حلقة من حلقات المسلسل يخوض (بكار) في كل مرة مغامرة جديدة مع أقرانه في المدرسة، سواء داخل قريته، أو خارجها.

programme.desc: Abdul Aziz goes through many of the ups and downs that any young man goes through at the beginning of his life, including joining one of the Islamic groups, then leaving it to join the leftist political movement, and finally working on Abdul Aziz Street, then he is able to achieve wealth as he becomes one of the largest shop merchants there. / يمر عبد العزيز بالعديد من التقلبات التي يمر بها أي شاب في بداية حياته مرورًا بانضمامه إلى إحدى الجماعات اﻹسلامية ثم يتركها لينضم إلى التيار السياسي اليساري ويعمل في النهاية بشارع عبد العزيز ثم يتمكن من تحقيق الثراء حيث يصبح أحد اكبر تجار المحال هناك.

programme.desc: In a dramatic context, the events of the series take place in Upper Egypt, around a story that actually happened, in which the mayor (Faramawi) and the rebellious young man (Abdul Hai) enter into several crises due to the tyranny of his parents. The work also addresses the issue of women’s rights. / في إطار درامي، تدور أحداث المسلسل في الصعيد، حول قصة حدثت بالفعل، حيث العمدة (فرماوي)، والشاب المتمرد (عبدالحي) الذي يدخل في عدة أزمات بسبب تسلط والديه، كما يتطرق العمل إلى قضية حقوق المرأة.

programme.title: Basketball / Basketball
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend. / The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera Division) is the mens top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.title: That horse has to go / Ten kůň musí pryč
programme.desc: A story for everyone who likes animals and especially horses. / Příběh pro všechny, kdo mají rádi zvířata a zvláště koně .

programme.title: Smart princess / Chytrá princezna
programme.desc: A fairy tale about how the princess outwitted the devil. / Pohádka o tom, jak princezna přelstila čerta.

programme.title: About bad and good water / O zle a dobre vodě
programme.desc: A fairy tale about the eternal battle between good and evil. / Pohádka o věčnem souboji dobra a zla.

programme.title: About the proud monarch / O pyšnem panovníkovi
programme.desc: Ondřej Vetchý in a fairy tale about the correction of a proud and ruthless king. / Ondřej Vetchý v pohádce o napravení pyšneho a bezohledneho krále.

programme.title: The truth and the lie / Pravda a lež
programme.desc: Simon, called the Righteous, once saw a beautiful girl behind a frosty window. He suddenly fell in love and even though he wasn't sure if she just seemed to him, he set off on a long journey to pursue his dream. Except for the edge of the world, where two noble sisters, Truth and Lie, ruled, indistinguishable from each other. But how to find a girl whose name and where she lives? / Šimon, řečený Spravedlivý, jednou zahledl za mrazivým oknem překrásnou dívku. Rázem se zamiloval a i když si nebyl jistý, zda se mu jen nezdála, vydal se na dalekou pouť za svým snem. Až na kraj světa, kde vládly dvě urozene sestry Pravda a Lež, k nerozeznání si podobne. Jenže jak najít dívku, o níž neví ani, jak se jmenuje a kde bydlí?

programme.title: The examples stretch / Příklady táhnou
programme.desc: A comedy about a grandmother who brings up her granddaughter Jarmila according to the rules of the old days. Only her second granddaughter, university student Jiřina, makes the dignified old lady not only change her views on youth, but also teaches her to tramp, to say "Hello!" and shoot a bow. In the end, however, circumstances force the grandmother to leave her slightly eccentric life behind and return to her old ways... / Komedie o babičce, která vychovává svou vnučku Jarmilu podle pravidel starých časů. Teprve její druhá vnučka, vysokoškolačka Jiřina, důstojnou starou dámu přiměje nejen ke změně názorů na mládež, ale take ji naučí trampovat, říkat "Ahoj!" a střílet z luku. Nakonec však okolnosti přinutí babičku, aby zanechala lehce výstředního života a vrátila se do starých kolejí...

programme.title: About the suspicious king / O podezíravem králi
programme.desc: The fact that King Philip of Spain chose a poor girl Charlotte from England as his bride was not too much to the taste of his mother - Queen Victoria. And so she started scheming behind her son's back. As soon as the king had to travel, she began to denigrate her daughter-in-law in her letters. She even accused her of infidelity! This scandal could have divided the royal couple forever. If this did not happen in the end, it was mainly due to the young queen and her faithful love for the suspicious king. / To, že si španělský král Filip vyvolil za nevěstu chudou dívku Charlottu z Anglie, nebylo příliš po chuti jeho matce – královně Viktorii. A tak začala za zády sveho syna všemožně intrikovat. Jakmile musel král odcestovat, začala v dopisech snachu očerňovat. Dokonce ji obvinila z nevěry! Tato pomluva mohla královskou dvojici navždy rozdělit. Jestliže se tak nakonec přece jen nestalo, měla na tom zásluhu především mladá královna a její věrná láska k podezíravemu králi.

programme.title: About three sleepy princesses / O třech ospalých princeznách
programme.desc: Screenwriter Jana Knitlová wrote a fairy tale about three princesses who danced through an innumerable number of slippers based on the motifs of Charles Deulin. The king had a lot of trouble with his daughters, Princess Maria, Klara and Lina. They got up before noon, complained of fatigue, paled and withered, but at night... Only the basket maker Petřík will reveal the secret of the three dancing princesses. In the main roles of the princesses you will see Tereza Grygarová, Šárka Ullrichová, Sabina Králova, the king was played by Viktor Preiss, the guilty queen Simona Postlerová, Petřík Matěj Hádek, the mysterious Lord Boris Rosner. The cameraman of the fairy tale was Jiří Kadaňka, the director was Svatava Simonová. / Pohádku o třech princeznách, ktere protančily nespočetne množství střevíčků, napsala scenáristka Jana Knitlová na motivy Charlese Deulina. Pan král měl se svými dceruškami, princeznou Marií, Klárou a Linou, velke trápení. Vstávaly před polednem, naříkaly si na únavu, bledly a chřadly, ale v noci... Tajemství tří princezen tanečnic odhalí až košíkář Petřík. programme.title: Gardens of Paradise / Rajske zahrady
programme.desc: The development of Baroque art in Moravia was conditioned by several peculiarities – there was no main artistic center, the country was located at the crossroads between Vienna, northern Italy and other Central European regions. The meeting of different currents of thought contributed to the variety of emerging works of art. Aristocratic families used to have a palace in Vienna, but they built family residences in the areas of their land holdings. Most of the Moravian residences were located in the south of the country within reach of the Viennese court. The monumental baroque castle from the beginning of the 18th century was only one part of the generously designed area. His opponent was the architecture of the monastery and the Loreto chapel. The task of combining these objects into a harmonious whole fell to the garden. And it is still really beautiful today, despite all the changes. / Rozvoj barokního umění byl na Moravě podmíněn několika zvláštnostmi – chybělo hlavní umělecke centrum, země se nacházela na křižovatce mezi Vídní, severem Itálie a ostatními středoevropskými regiony. Střetávání různých myšlenkových proudů přispívalo k rozmanitosti vznikajících uměleckých děl. Aristokraticke rodiny mívaly palác ve Vídni, ale rodová sídla budovaly v oblastech svých pozemkových držav. Většina moravských rezidencí se nacházela na jihu země v dosahu vídeňskeho dvora. Monumentální barokní zámek z počátku 18. století byl jen jednou ze součástí velkoryse koncipovaneho areálu. Protihráčem mu byla architektura kláštera a loretánske kaple. Úkol spojit tyto objekty v harmonický celek připadl zahradě. A ta je dodnes, i přes všechny změny, opravdu nádherná.

programme.title: Donated children / Darovane děti
programme.desc: Viktorie and Dominika entered the world through the door of the baby box. How much did the heated metal box change the trajectory of their lives? Is it good that baby boxes exist? What does their existence mean for the identity of the child who finds himself in it? Do baby boxes save lives or just offer a convenient way out for women who would otherwise remain mothers? The world of baby boxing is not black and white. Both their advocates and opponents have strong arguments, and it is up to each of us to make up our own minds. What is certain is that babybox stories do not end when the child is handed over to the mailbox - on the contrary, they begin. With a new mom and a new dad behind them, baby boxers acquire a new identity, which brings with it a large portion of joy and unexpected difficulties. / Viktorie i Dominika vstoupily na svět dvířky babyboxu. Nakolik vyhřívaná kovová schránka změnila trajektorii jejich životů? Je dobře, že babyboxy existují? Co jejich existence znamená pro identitu dítěte, ktere se v něm ocitne? Zachraňují babyboxy životy, nebo jen nabízejí pohodlne východisko pro ženy, ktere by jinak zůstaly matkami? Babyboxový svět není černobílý. Jejich obhájci i odpůrci mají pádne argumenty a je na každem z nás, abychom si udělali vlastní úsudek. Jiste je, že odevzdáním dítěte do schránky babyboxove příběhy nekončí – naopak jsou na začátku. S novou mámou a novým tátou za zády získávají babyboxátka novou identitu, což s sebou nese velkou porci radosti i nečekaných úskalí.

programme.title: Our countryside / Náš venkov
programme.desc: Young men, Petr and Lukáš, one a former art curator and the other a sailor, are today engaged in planting fruit trees in Široka Niva in the Jeseníky foothills. They manage the elderly on an old farm, where their life has acquired a completely different rhythm and charge, as well as a new mission. They live modestly, but self-sufficiently. They give young fruit trees to people - either for free or in exchange for necessary things for everyday life. So they find time to spread ecological awareness and explain their actions to people. How do you live with two handsome men in one house? / Mladí muži, Petr a Lukáš, jeden coby bývalý kurátor umění a druhý mořeplavec, se dnes v Široke Nivě v podhůří Jeseníků zabývají sázením ovocných stromků. Hospodaří postaru na starem statku, kde jejich život získal zcela jiný rytmus i náboj a take nove poslání. Žijí skromně, ale soběstačně. Mlade ovocne stromky rozdávají lidem – buď zdarma, nebo výměnou za potřebne věci pro každodenní život. Take si najdou čas, aby šířili ekologickou osvětu a vysvětlovali lidem sve počínání. Jak se žije dvěma sverázným mužům v jednom domě?

Oblast na pomezí Spojených států a Kanady má sve specificke mikroklima a ukrývá neskutečne přírodní bohatství, ale i mnohá tajemství. Koprodukční dokument

programme.title: Insights from elsewhere / Postřehy odjinud
programme.sub-title: Slovinsko očima Jaroslava Skalickeho - Češi na Soče
programme.desc: When Italy declared war on Austria-Hungary in May 1915, a new front was established on the then Italian-Austrian border, along the Sochi River. Its southern section stretched from the peaks of the Julian Alps to the Adriatic coast, mainly through areas of the limestone Karst mountain range. The monarchy moved most of the Czech infantry and artillery regiments of the Austro-Hungarian army to Soča. Over 40,000 men from the lands of the Czech Crown fought on the Soča front, which can be considered the largest military deployment of Czech soldiers in the entire history of the country. In the inhospitable conditions of the limestone massif, soldiers were killed not only by enemy bullets and shrapnel, but also by hunger and thirst. Austria-Hungary finally asked Germany for help, and together with the victorious Austrian army, Czech soldiers also pursued the retreating enemy. The fighting on the Soča front is documented by the museum in Kobarid. It exhibits military equipment, weapons and equipment of soldiers from both sides of the front, as well as hundreds of their personal belongings. And a lot of photos that speak eloquently about... / Když Itálie v květnu 1915 vyhlásila Rakousku-Uhersku válku, vznikla na pomezí tehdejší italsko-rakouske hranice, podel řeky Soči, nová fronta. Její jižní úsek se táhl od vrcholů Julských Alp až k pobřeží Jadranu, převážně oblastmi vápencoveho pohoří Kras. Monarchie k Soče přesunula většinu českých pěších a dělostřeleckých pluků rakousko-uherske armády. Na sočske frontě bojovalo přes 40 tisíc mužů ze zemí Koruny česke, což lze považovat za největší válečne nasazení českých vojáků v cele historii země. V nehostinných podmínkách vápencoveho masivu vojáky zabíjely nejen nepřátelske kulky a šrapnely, ale take hlad a žízeň. Rakousko-Uhersko nakonec požádalo o pomoc Německo a s vítězící rakouskou armádou pronásledovali ustupujícího nepřítele i čeští vojáci. Boje na sočske frontě dokumentuje muzeum v Kobaridu. Vystavuje vojenskou techniku, výzbroj a výstroj vojáků z obou stran fronty, ale i stovky jejich osobních věcí. A take spoustu fotografií, ktere výmluvným způsobem vypovídají o...

programme.title: Legion 100 / Legie 100
programme.desc: The Bolshevik revolution made an inauspicious entry into the fate of the Czechoslovak legionnaires who formed their army in Russia. Russia betrayed all its fighting allies and made a separate peace with the enemy. The chance of an early return home was thus closed for the legionnaires, and they had only one hope left - a retreat in the eastern direction. The journey of the Czechoslovak legions to Siberia, which was filled with bloody battles with the Bolsheviks and immeasurable heroism, became one of the greatest war adventures, which the whole world watched with amazement. This theme is still alive today, as the actor Jiří Dvořák will confirm. Together with the members of the Czechoslovak legionary community, he went to Russia to see with his own eyes the places where our ancestors died. Together with him, we will also be present at the narration of some of the descendants of the legionnaires of that time. How does the actor Ivan Trojan or the grandson of the legendary artist Zdenek Štěpánek remember his relative? / Do osudu československých legionářů, kteří zformovali sve vojsko v Rusku, neblaze vstoupila bolševická revoluce. Rusko zradilo sve bojující spojence a uzavřelo s nepřítelem separátní mír. Legionářům se tak uzavřela šance na brzký návrat domů a zbyla jim jediná naděje – ústup ve východním směru. Cesta československých legií Sibiří, která byla vyplněná krvavými boji s bolševiky a nezměrným hrdinstvím, se stala jedním z největších válečných dobrodružství, jež s úžasem sledoval celý svět. Dodnes je toto tema žive, jak se přesvědčí herec Jiří Dvořák. Společně se členy Československe obce legionářske se vypravil do Ruska, aby na vlastní oči spatřil místa, kde umírali naši předkove. Společně s ním budeme přítomni take vyprávění některých potomků tehdejších legionářů. Jak na sveho příbuzneho vzpomíná třeba herec Ivan Trojan nebo vnuk legendárního umělce Zdeňka Štěpánka?

programme.title: Subcarpathian Ruthenia / Podkarpatske Rusínsko
programme.desc: The documentary wants to refresh half-forgotten facts through a historian and specialist in modern Czech history - Charles University professor Jan Rychlík - author of the book Subcarpathian Rus in the History of Czechoslovakia. At the same time, he wants to shed light on the emergence of the Czech nation, which - unlike the Ruthenians - arose in the 19th century from a mass of semi-literate peasants. Not every human community can overcome itself, maintain and grow its level. This challenge is still relevant today! / Dokument chce osvěžit polozapomenutá fakta prostřednictvím historika a specialisty na moderní česke dějiny – profesora Univerzity Karlovy Jana Rychlíka – autora knihy Podkarpatská Rus v dějinách Československa. Zároveň chce osvětlit vznik českeho národa, který – na rozdíl od Rusínů – v 19. století povstal z masy pologramotných sedláků. Ne každe lidske společenství totiž dokáže překonat sebe sama, udržet si a pěstovat svou úroveň. Tato výzva je aktuální i dnes!

programme.title: Divnopis / Divnopis
programme.desc: If we put together all the expressions hiding the base "kom", we can assume that Komňa was named either according to the type of soil that was present in the given place (cloddy earth) or according to its location on the hillside. A chimney is the opposite of a plane. Komňa means from the hill. Although linguists add that this interpretation is not quite reliable, it seems to have some connection. Already because Komňa really lies on the slopes. That's why a lot of cattle have probably always been raised here. How else to explain that this village was a well-known bastion of animal pincers throughout Europe. That is why you will find a small knife in the symbol of the village, reminiscent of the famous era of this craft in Komni. Komňa is a village located near Světlov u Bojkovice, where the real father of the teacher of the nations - the nobleman Václav Tetaur from Tetovo - was allegedly the lord of the castle. It is said that he paid for the schools and studies of Jeníček's son, who later took the church name Amos and whom we call Comenius today. Who knows what it was like back then. / Když si dáme dohromady všechny výrazy skrývající v sobě základ "kom", můžeme předpokládat, že Komňa byla pojmenována buď podle typu půdy, který se na danem místě vyskytoval (hrudovitá země), nebo podle polohy na stráni. Komina je opak roviny. Komňa znamená s kopce. Přestože jazykovědci dodávají, že tento výklad docela spolehlivý není, nějakou souvislost zřejmě má. Už proto, že Komňa skutečně na stráních leží. Proto se tu snad odjakživa chovalo hodně dobytka. Jak jinak si vysvětlit, že tato obec byla celoevropsky vyhlášenou baštou zvěrokleštičů. Ve znaku obce proto najdete malý nožík připomínající slavnou eru tohoto řemesla v Komni. Komňa je ves ležící nedaleko Světlova u Bojkovic, kde byl zámeckým pánem údajně skutečný otec učitele národů – šlechtic Václav Tetaur z Tetova. Vypráví se, že synu Jeníčkovi, který později přijal církevní jmeno Amos a jemuž dnes říkáme Komenský, platil školy a studia. Kdo ví, jak to tehdy bylo.

programme.title: Our countryside / Náš venkov
programme.desc: Not far from Sokolov above the village of Hřebeny, Hartenberg Castle has been standing for eight centuries, which its current owner says is a chronicle of humanity. It was plundered, conquered, rebuilt, torn down, burned, destroyed. However, the lord of the castle, Bedřich Loos, is a very charismatic figure. Years ago, he brought something that is very rare to the small village - quixoticism. And that drove him to the seemingly crazy idea of ​​bringing the monument back to life and thereby lending a helping hand to the people of the undercastle. / Kousek od Sokolova nad vesnicí Hřebeny stojí už osm století hrad Hartenberg, o kterem jeho současný majitel říká, že je kronikou lidstva. Byl pleněn, dobýván, přestavován, bourán, vypalován, ničen. Hradní pán Bedřich Loos je však velmi charismatickou postavou. Do male obce před lety přinesl něco, co je velmi vzácne – donkichotství. A to jej hnalo do zdánlivě potrhleho nápadu památku znovu vzkřísit k životu a tím podat pomocnou ruku i lidem z podhradí.

When news of the deserters of a brutally cruel, looting band spreads through the countryside, Baron Fontenac, the lord of Somszedvár, sees a new opportunity to cause loss to Mespech Castle. / S01E02 Isabelle nem tud megbekulni a helyzettel, hogy ferje magához fogadta torvenytelen fiát, Samsont, akit új vegrendeleteben ráadásul meg torvenyest is. programme.desc: S03E04 Seven years have passed. Riario is always working to destroy the Medici. Lorenzo wants to organize a conference in Florence with the letter of the French king and the Pope. At Botticelli, he succeeded in meeting IV. With Sixtus, who apologizes to him, but Lorenzo does not return the gesture. Lucrezia confesses to Clarice that she is very ill and that she has to take over the bank account. And he did it just in time, because not much later, running after his grandson, the revenge-hungry Giulio, he collapses and dies. The conference is finally held in Bagnolo, where Lorenzo finally receives the Pope's pardon. / S03E04 Het ev telt el. Riario meg mindig azon munkálkodik, hogy tonkretegye a Medicieket. Lorenzo bekekonferenciát szeretne szervezni Firenzeben a francia király es a Pápa reszvetelevel. Botticellin keresztul sikerul is találkoznia IV. Szixtusszal, aki bocsánatot ker tőle, de Lorenzo nem viszonozza a gesztust. Lucrezia bevallja Claricenek, hogy nagyon beteg, es neki kell átvennie a bank konyveleset. Meg eppen időben tette, mert nem sokkal kesőbb unokája, a bosszúszomjas Giulio után rohanva osszeesik es meghal. A bekekonferenciát vegul Bagnoloban rendezik meg, ahol Lorenzo vegul elnyeri a Pápa bocsánatát.

programme.title: Agape / Agape
programme.desc: How to deal with the pain of losing a spouse? What is happening in front of us in the eyes of ourselves and others? What are the consequences if this happens at a young age, at the beginning of a dirty life, or when we have many, many years pushed together behind us? We are looking for answers to these questions at the Agape table. The dirty thinking of a particular table company about social skulduggery, honestly, with Christian eyes. Identical order of events, but even different ones. Artists, experts, priests and enthusiasts sit at a table every week to discuss the questions that define our everyday lives - there are no taboos. / Hogyan lehet szembenezni a házastárs elvesztesenek fájdalmával? Mikent ertekelődik át eletunk magunk es mások szemeben? Milyen kovetkezmenyekkel jár, ha ez fiatalon, egy kozos elet kezdeten tortenik, vagy akkor, amikor sok-sok egyutt toltott ev van a hátunk mogott? Az Agape asztalánál ezekre a kerdesekre keressuk a válaszokat. Egy kulonleges asztaltársaság kozos gondolkodása társadalmi kerdesekről, őszinten, kereszteny szemmel. Azonos ertekrend, de akár elterő velemenyek. Műveszek, szakertők, papok es lelkeszek ulnek hetről hetre egy asztalhoz, hogy megvitassák a mindennapi eletunket meghatározo kerdeseket - tabuk nelkul.

In front of our camera, he spoke honestly about how he lives his faith in the hustle and bustle of everyday life, during his many-responsible working years. / Schneller Domonkos a Magyar Kerekpáros Szovetseg elnokekent es a Magyar Műszaki es Kozlekedesi Múzeum főigazgatojakent is a fenntarthato kozlekedesert es a sport nepszerűsíteseert fáradozik. Az egykori fasori diák jelenleg a Budapest-Fasori Evangelikus Gimnázium igazgatotanácsának is tagja es a budavári evangelikus gyulekezet mindennapjaiban is reszt vesz lelkesz felesegevel es negy gyermekevel egyutt. programme.title: Szekelyfold legendarium / Szekelyfoldi legendárium
programme.desc: In this part, Zete and Rika meet Mano Szőr, who is an omniscient and ancient mano who lives in Mesefa. Csetlik and Botlik want to get the magic key, but with the help of Zete and Rika Szőrmano, they outwit them and run away from the cave to put the key in a safer place in Mesefa. / Ebben a reszben ismerkedik meg Zete es Rika Szőr Manoval, aki egy mindent tudo es orok eletű mano es a Mesefában lakik. Csetlik es Botlik meg akarják szerezni a mágikus kulcsot, ám Zete es Rika Szőrmano segítsegevel túljárnak az eszukon es elmenekulnek a barlangbol, hogy a kulcsot biztonságosabb helyre tegyek a Mesefába.

programme.title: Jano mano and the lost dewdrops / Jano mano es az elveszett harmatcseppek
programme.desc: Jano Mano, the caretaker of the forest, prepares potions and elixirs in the trunk of a pedunculated oak and in a laboratory in the Csupalomb Forest. His most important magic potion is fenymanna, which he produces from a mixture of morning dew and the sap of an old oak tree. One morning, however, the dew is nowhere to be found, which completely upsets the usual life of the inhabitants of the forest. Jano goes on a journey with Zizgő Zizzencc to find the lost dewdrops. Traveling along the roots of the 1000-year-old tree, a toad stands in their way and only lets them go if they play a game of questions and answers with him. Janoek defeats the toad so they can continue on their way to find the secret of the lost dewdrops... / Jano Mano, az erdő gondnoka a Csupalomb Erdőben el egy kocsányos tolgy torzseben es egy laboratoriumban gyogyitalokat es elixíreket keszít. Legfontosabb varázsitala a fenymanna, amit a reggeli harmat es az oreg tolgyfa nedvenek elegyeből állít elő. Egyik reggel azonban a harmatot sehol sem lelik, ami teljesen felborítja az erdő lakoinak megszokott eletet. Jano útnak indul Zizgő Zizzenccsel, hogy megtalálják az elveszett harmatcseppeket. Az 1000 eves fa gyokere menten utazva egy varangy állja az útjukat es csak akkor engedi tovább őket, ha kerdezz-feleleket játszanak vele. Janoek legyőzik a varangyot, így tovább haladhatnak az úton, hogy megleljek az elveszett harmatcseppek titkát...

programme.title: Eden / Éden
programme.desc: Éva is allergic to chemicals, pollution, radio waves and electric fields. He has to live in complete isolation, he cannot interact with his surroundings. Even the slightest inattention can cause your death. He only has a relationship with his father and the doctors who constantly examine him. One day a psychiatrist comes to find out if Éva's illness is real or just a figment of her imagination. Is love enough to save Eva? / Éva allergiás a kemiai anyagokra, a legszennyezesre, a rádiohullámokra es az elektromos mezőre. Teljes elszigeteltsegben kell elnie, kornyezetevel nem erintkezhet. Akár a legaprobb figyelmetlenseg is a halálát okozhatja. Kizárolag occsevel es a rajta állandoan kíserletező orvosokkal van kapcsolata. Egy napon pszichiáter erkezik, hogy kiderítse, Éva betegsege valodi vagy csak a kepzeletenek szulemenye. Vajon eleg-e a szeretet, hogy Évát megmentse?

programme.title: Hungarian women / Magyar nők
programme.desc: Erzsebet Torok, considered one of the greatest Hungarian nepdale dancers of all time, was a phenomenon. His voice has been preserved on numerous radio recordings and records, and his work still has a lively effect and provides inspiration to fans of beautiful music. She became a dramatic actress or a sanzone singer. But when he got to know Kodály and Bartok's nepdal followers, he couldn't resist. It was with this style that he made it all the way to the Kossuth prize. With her voice, gaze and movements, Erzsebet Torok brought the world of the family home, the farm, the village to the stage. / A minden idők egyik legnagyobb magyar nepdalenekesenek tartott Torok Erzsebet egy jelenseg volt. Hangját számos rádiofelvetel, lemezek sokasága őrzi, műveszete ma is elevenen hat es elmenyt nyújt a szep muzsika híveinek. Drámai színesznőnek, vagy sanzonenekesnek keszult. Ám amikor megismerkedett Kodály es Bartok nepdalátkolteseivel, nem tudott ellenállni. Ennek a stílusnak a kepviseletevel jutott el egeszen a Kossuth-díjig. Torok Erzsebet hangjával, tekintetevel, mozdulataival a szulőfold, a tanya, a falu világát varázsolta a színpadra.

Although Ági vehemently opposes the plan, the family votes it down... / Az egesz család aggodik Ádám miatt, akit szerelmi bánat gyotor. Csak fekszik es a párnája csucsket rágja. programme.title: Família Kft. / Família Kft.
programme.desc: S01E80 The family is barely born, but Ádám is already feverishly planning and organizing. He is about to become an important announcer: a determined supporter of conservatism, he was close to Professor Pocsai, who took him on as an assistant. He forbids his parents or siblings to carry out any environmentally damaging activities from now on. No more use of electric razors, telephones or gas, only candles can be lit in the evening, and watching television is strictly prohibited. Szepek are divided into two camps, a family war threatens... / S01E80 Meg alig ebredezik a család, de Ádám már lázasan intezkedik-rendezkedik. Fontos bejelentesre keszul: a kornyezetvedelem elszánt híveve szegődott Pocsai professzor mellett, aki magához vette őt asszisztensnek. Megtiltja ezert, hogy szulei vagy testverei ezentúl bármifele kornyezetkárosíto tevekenyseget vegezzenek. Nincs tobbe villanyborotva-, telefon- es gázhasználat, este csak gyertya eghet, a televíziozás pedig vegkepp ki van zárva. Szepek ket táborra szakadnak, családi háború fenyeget...
